paras: Addressing his closest disciple and successor, Ziaul Huq Chalapi, upon whose pleading, Rumi was obliged to write the Math(s)navi, Rumi said: Bring forth this volume three of this Math(s)navi. Number three has a special significance as the Prophet used to perform routine acts like ablution thrice. Open up the treasure of secrets in the third volume and avoid all excuses.

Your energy that enthuses you to act is from the energy of God and not from the warmth of your muscles. This great lamp of the Sun burning bright is not due to the wick and oil. The canopy the sky which engulfs the world for ever is not supported on poles and fastened by ropes and pegs. Might of Jibra’iil is not as a result of food but as a result of the sighting of the Creator of all things.

Similarly, the power of the ABDALS who have converted vicious human instincts into virtues is not due to food and eating but is provided by God. Their bodies are made of light in such a manner that they have become lighter in weight than the soul and angels.

As you are attributed with the attributes of grandeur, pass on through the fire of Nimrod like Ibrahim. Fire will go cold upon you and secure you, as happened in the case of Ibrahim, as the four elements: earth, water, fire and air of which you are made are the obedient slaves of your potentialities. Every element has its own potentiality, but your potentiality is far above them all. This potentiality of yours spreads over in the vast expanse of the world has assumed uniqueness, which can pick up anything it wants.

sections.heading: Throat and Food: Gift of God to All
paras: But the field of the understanding of the people is so limited in extent that it has no throat to swallow. But O Ziaul Huq, with the smartness of your expression, you can provide throat even to a stone to swallow your sweets. You know that Mount Sinai got a throat with the striking of the lightening of God and drank so much wine (of the gnosis of God), that it could not remain stable. It shattered and broke into two pieces. It started dancing like a camel, which very rarely happens. Everyone can give food to everyone but giving of a throat is entirely by God. He has provided throat to the bodies and the spirits. He gives throat to every part of your body. This, He gives to you when you attain greatness by shedding all mischiefs and treacheries and become capable of hiding the secrets of the Lord from all except the deserving ones; and not for scattering like the grains of sugar before the flies. Secrets of God can be heard by that man who remains dumb inspite of having all occasions to talk.

sections.heading: Throat of the Mud and Leaves
paras: God has been benevolent to provide throat to mud so that it drinks water, and as a result, grows grass upon itself. He has provided lips and throat to the animals to enable them to eat grass. Then, they become fat and become the food of man. Then mud comes forward and swallows man, when his soul and eyesight vanish from him. I have seen even particles with open mouths to swallow others. It is a very long matter to speak of the devouring by the particles.

Providing of leaves to the trees is a great gift of God like the providing of milk by the mother. He provides food even to the food as the grains which you eat do not become your food without getting food for themselves from other sources. There is no end to the explanation of all this. I have given one example for you to think of more. Consider all thing of the world as food and seekers of food which are destroying each other. Only those remain alive who are fortunate and dear ones to God.

sections.heading: People of This and That World
paras: This world and its residents are all scattered, but that world is one where the residents are brought together. This world and its lovers are to be lost and cut off but those of that world are together and everlasting. Therefore, only he is wise who provides to himself the water of life so as to live forever. Those noble honourables who live forever (BAQIYATUS-SALIHAAT) are protected from hundreds of troubles and dangers as stated in the Quran (Kahaf.18: 46). Thousands of others are not superior to one of them and their numbers are of no account as your thoughts are. Those who eat and are eaten away have throats and gullets, just as victors and the vanquished have their own reasonings.

sections.heading: Throat of Musa’s Staff and Souls
paras: God provided throat to the staff of justice in the hands of Musa, which swallowed so many clubs and ropes. Inspite of eating so much it did not grow fat, as its body and eating were not like those of living beings. Just as God gave throat to Musa’s staff, so also He has given a throat to certainty of faith (YAQEEN) so that it swallowed all other thoughts. Similarly, just as there are throats to swallow the meanings of the visible physical things, God alone provides throats for inner meanings of the meanings of things. From the fish swimming in water to the moon shining in the sky, every creature has a throat to swallow whatever is required by it. If the throat of human soul (NAFS) remains without unverifiable thoughts (insinuations), it becomes the guest for the revelations from God. When the throat of the soul is not bothered about the feeding of the body, it gets its provisions for life from God Himself. When the throat of wisdom and feelings remains empty of worries of the body, it gets its food without the anxiety of the digestion by the stomach. But be sure, it is dependent upon the condition of the changing of your taste, as it is the taste for bad things that causes death of bad people. When man develops a taste for mud eating, he becomes yellowish, dark, sick and degraded. When he changes his taste, his sicknesses go and his face shines like a lamp. The wet nurse, while feeding a baby, is not the one to provide good varieties of food. She provides only milk; and that is the only means for the baby. When the ways of his milk from her breasts are closed for him, gates of hundreds of gardens open for him. Her breasts were a curtain for this weakling preventing him from thousands of food items, dishes and tastes. Thus, our pleasurable life depends upon our getting prevented from milk. You may think, one after one on these points and do not depend upon breast feeding come out of the lap of wet nurse and eat other things.

So long as man was in the womb, blood was his food. He was like a blood sucker. His very existence and the growth of his body was upon blood. Upon getting out of the womb, his food was milk and after leaving this, he started eating varieties of food. And, if he stops eating this food, he becomes one like Luqman the outstanding wise man. He becomes a seeker of hidden meanings.

sections.heading: Comparison to This and That World
paras: If he were to be told when he was in the womb that there is a grand organised world outside; there is a long and wide pleasing earth with innumerable foods and grants; mountains, meadows and rivers; gardens and farmlands; a high aloft bright sky; sun, moon and millions of stars; southern winds and northern winds; fresh fruit giving orchards; and many such wonders which cannot be explained; and asked as to why are you imprisoned in this dark prison; you are living upon blood in the midst of filth and trials in a prison, he would refuse to agree with this observation, and object to this message and reject, saying: “what you say in treacherous, misunderstood and impossible”, like a blind man who would not understand the meaning of what all is said. As such things are not seen by him, his mind cannot perceive them and refuse even to hear of them. Therefore, the ABDALS consider the common people of the world as similar to the baby in the womb, who refuses to believe in the affairs of the other world.

This world is like a deep, dark, narrow abyss deprived of the outside world of colours and fragrances; and those living in it cannot understand the affairs of the other world. Their greed for it has become like a dark thick curtain. Greed closes the ears and deprives them of hearing; and shuts the eyes from getting information’s. In like manner that baby’s greed for blood in the womb does the same. So also, to the lowly people in the countryside for their greed for food. The facts of the other world remain hidden from them, and they give greater importance to the blood in their bodies than to the information’s of the soul. That baby is deprived of the pleasures of so many gifts of the world and it knows nothing other than the pleasures of blood sucking. And the greed of these worldly pleasures becomes a curtain for you depriving you of the eternal pleasures.

sections.heading: Greed Causes Blindness to Life
paras: Greed and the taste of this misinformed life have blinded you to deprive you of the sight of true life. Thus, greed blinds you and you consider good as bad and certainties and truths as doubtful. Greed shows truth as falsehood to you and goes on increasing your blindness. Therefore, give up your greed like the truth-knowing right ones have done, so as to be able to step into the abode of truth. And once you put your step into it, you take out your steps from the feeling of sorrows and happiness. The eyes of your soul become bright, and observe the truth without the darkness of rejection, but with the light of faith. Take the advice of the great men so that you may become fearless and feel safe.
Hear this narrative as an example in this regard so that you may see the light of the truth of life.

chapters.title: Harms Caused by Greed
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the eaters of the flesh of baby elephant due to greed, ignoring the advice of the well-wishers Craze for Elephant’s flesh Back to the Narrative

paras: Have you heard of this incident from India that a wise man saw a group of friends, hungry, tired, without clothing’s and other materials. They had come here after long journey from a distant place. His benevolence rose up enthusiastically and he was highly pleased. He saluted them and said: “I know you are hungry, and your stomach is empty, and you are in great sufferings. But for God’s sake, my honourable community, do not ever eat the flesh of a baby elephant. There are elephants on the path of your journey; and take my advice regarding them very seriously. There are a large number of baby elephants, whom you would love to prey upon. They are very beautiful to look at, very clean and fleshy, but their mothers would be looking at them from a distance. They love their young ones so much that they would seen crying and wailing from long distances for them if any wrong occurs to them. Fire and smoke emanate from their trunks. Therefore, be very careful about any harm to the baby elephants.”

sections.heading: Prophets and Saints
paras: AULIA (friends of God) are like the babies of God; and He is well aware of them whether they are in front of Him or otherwise. Do not consider their absence from your sight, as a loss for them, as God avenges any trouble caused to them. He says that they are like His babies, whether they are far away or nearby and busy in their engagements. He says: “For the sake of trial they are kept in distress as orphans, but I am with them as a protector. They have full faith in My protection for them as though they are a part of Myself. Be careful: these wearers of torne old-patched-clothes belong to Me. They are in thousands but are one in their status.”

Had that not been so, how could Musa and Haroon, with that staff which was not trained for any job set Pharaoh upside down. How could with one curse, Noah put the east to west in the deluge. And with one prayer, Lot rendered the city of Sodom of the rejecters go topsy-turvy to protect his guests. Their city that resembled Paradise turned into a land of black water. If you do not believe in this, go and see it for yourself. You can see its relics on the route to Syria while going towards the Holy City. There have come thousands of prophets preaching truth in all these centuries and there have been calamities. It will be a long discourse if I go on narrating all these events by hearing which not only you liver but also a rock would turn into blood.

sections.heading: God Makes Men Dance
paras: Mountains turn into blood and then solidify. But you cannot see their conversion into blood, as you pass on over them like a blind man. You are a strange blind man, though inspite of having sharp and telescopic eyes, you do not see anything other than wool in a camel.

Man’s greed makes hair-splitting accounting of his expenses; and he dances without purpose like the bear. Man in his greed sees everything with keen eyes and jumps at gains. But his jumps have nothing good but are only full of mischiefs. You should dance to crush your pride and arrogance and remove the plaster you have put on your wounds of passions (so as to feel the pain and set yourself aright). Your dance and jumps are exhibited in battlefields to spill other men’s blood, but great men dance to spill the blood of their own passions. They beat their own palms to clap to seek their own refuge from passions. When they come out of these, they dance upon their victory. Their songsters beat their tambourines from inside, and the oceans in response to these beats, flap waves on the seashores. Have you not seen the leaves on branches of the trees clapping each other when the wind blows over them. You do not hear the clapping sound of the leaves on the tree; but the people of higher levels see and hear these sounds with the ears and eyes of their hearts. Shut the ears of your head from the hearing of nonsense and falsehood so as to see the prosperity of the city of the soul.

Though you have become old enough, my uncle, keep yourself away from nonsense and do not speak of anything other than what Rumi says. Muhammad’s ears hear the secrets behind the verbal statements as God has called him “ear in full for you: Uzune Khairullakum” and said: “he listens to what is best of you” (Tauba: 9: 61). This Prophet is an ear and eye in entirety; and his benevolence is a wet nurse and we are all babies.
There is no end to this discourse. Let us leave it and go toward to the narrative of the people and elephants.

Elephant feels the smell of every mouth and thus wander around every man’s stomach, so as to feel the odour of the roasted meet of its baby in order to inflict a hundred wounds on the body of its eater as a punishment for his acts.

sections.heading: Izraaiil and Angels of Punishment
paras: You also eat the flesh of the men of God. And you speak ill of them and get punished for the same. Take care and know that the one to smell your mouth is God. No one can be saved from His punishment except the truthful ones. Very regretful for those who regret for those the smell of whose mouths is felt by the angels, Munkir and Nakir who interrogate them for their acts in their graves. It is not possible to hide faces from these great angels nor there is scope to remove the foul smell of the mouth with any purifier. There are no colours and beauty-aids to hide the real face, nor are there scopes for pleasing, slippery vocabulary to create confusion. Their mace will cause many injuries upon the heads and hips of those blabbering nonsense. Look at the impacts of the mace of Izraiel, the angel of death, if you cannot see it in physical shape of one made of wood and steel. Yet sometimes it appears in physical shape, of which every sick man is aware. The sick man tells him: “Why do you, my friend, strike the hairline of my head with your sword”. While this is happening for the sick man, his friends sitting by his side do not see all this and say: “Uncle, we do not see anything of what you say. It is just your imagination. These are passing hallucinations”. What imagination is this that the sky has become convex. In fact, the sky has really become convex for him.

He feels the impacts of the mace and sword and his head turns aside and tilts. It is only he who sees and feels all this. The eyes of his friends and enemies do not see. The greed of the world passes off from him and his eyesight becomes sharp, but alas, at a time when the eyes have shed all blood. His eyes behave like a rooster crowing at a wrong time, as a result of his arrogance and wrath that he had all through his life. Such an untimely-crowing-cock deserves to be slaughtered for causing miscalculation of time.

sections.heading: Man’s Continuing Decline
paras: But you do not know that every moment some tissues of your body are dying. This continually dying body warns you to protect your faith continuingly. Your life is like a bag full of golden coins; and days and nights are like the accountants of your coins, which go on spending and counting the coins, when ultimately your bag is completely emptied, resulting in a total eclipse. If you go on lifting stones from a hill without replacing with other things, the hill ultimately disappears. Therefore, always keep something appropriate in place of what you take out, so that you may obtain the benefit of wa asjud wa aqtarib [Bow down in adoration and bring yourself closer (to God)], as stated in the Quran: (Iqraa: 96: 19)

Do not engage yourself entirely in all kinds of jobs other than those relating to faith, as otherwise the final result will be deficient and your gains defective. You should know that greatness of your grave does not lie in a grand building of stones, wooden frames around and spreading a silken sheets upon it. But it lies in the purity of your heart, which makes the grave clean. This can be done by making yourself one with God and burying your existence into God’s. Become a dust of God and get buried in the thoughts about Him so that your breaths may get the help of the winds, blessed with His breaths. Grand Mausoleums, tombs and niches do not have any meaning and worth in the views of wise men, who know the secrets of life and death.

sections.heading: Good Appearance with Bad Inside
paras: Look at that misinterpreting person who wears silken apparel proudly projecting himself. He is not going to get any extra awareness and status with silken apparels. His soul is in grate torture because of this. Scorpions of sorrow are biting the inside of his heart. His outside is fully decorated and beautified but, in his inside, there are plenty anxieties and worries. And you also see another man wearing worn out clothes, but his inside is free of cares, speaking sweet words.

sections.heading: Turning Back to the Narrative of the Baby Elephants
paras: The adviser said: “Take this advice from me so that your body and soul may not fall into pains. Be satisfied with the grass and leaves of this country and do not go after hunting of baby elephants. I have relieved myself of the burden of giving advice; and there is nothing other than good intention in giving advice. I have come like a missionary of prophets in order to protect you from disgrace, and to warn you that your greed may not misguide you which will spoil you like an uprooted tree”.

With this the good man said goodbye and left; but the path of scarcity and hunger took the travellers on itself. They saw on the way a fat, fresh, newly born baby elephant. They fell upon it like intoxicated wolves and ate its flesh and washed their hands. One of them did not eat and remembered the advice of that man and kept away from the roasted meet, as wisdom of the elderly provides fresh fortune.

After eating, all of them went into sleep, and that hungry man watched them like a Shepherd watching their sheep. There came over fiercely an elephant and it came close to him. It smelt his mouth in three breaths and found no smell. It walked around for some time and passes off without causing any harm to him. Then it tested the mouth of a sleeping man and found the smell of roasted meet. It crushed and tore him and finished him. Then it tore every one of them without any fear or concern. It lifted and flew every one of them in the air and he fell on the ground and get splashed.

sections.heading: Sins Do Not Go Unpunished
paras: Come back, O sucker of the people’s blood, so that their blood may not fight against and kill you. Consider their properties as their blood which keeps them alive as their property, because property comes after hard work. Mother of that baby elephant took revenge and punished its killers. O corrupt man, you are also eating the baby elephants. Remember, the protector of baby elephant will destroy you. Smell of your corrupt life spreads and puts you in disgrace; and the Protector knows the smell of His babies. One who knows the fragrance of truth cannot remain without knowing the foul smell of sins.

The Prophet had said that he felt the fragrance of Owaise Qarani from the distant Yemen. He cannot remain unaware of the smell of our mouths. He feels the good or bad odours from us and keeps quiet, but they certainly reach the heavens. You may be in sweet sleep, but the smell of your illegalities certainly reaches the blue heavens. It mingles with the expirations of your breath and reaches the heights of the skies where there are angels appointed to feel it. Odour of arrogance, of wrath and greed is like the odour of onion which emanates from your mouth when you speak, even when you swear and say that you have kept onion and garlic forbidden for yourself forever. Yet, your breath carries your tale and strikes and shatters the brains of those nearby to you to pieces.

sections.heading: Vices Cause Rejection of Prayers
paras: Your prayers and supplications get rejected due to these odours of sinful acts, and the doors of your heart open up from your foul-smelling-mouth. The answer for these supplications will be “AKHSA-OO”: (Be driven into fire with ignominy) as stated in the Quran vide Surah Muu’minuun: 23: 108 as an answer to the prayers of those gone on the wrong path. The answer to every mischief is a beating with a club of rejection and denial.

sections.heading: Intentions, Not Words, Are Considered
paras: Even those statements which are not fluent with inappropriate words, but bearing truthfulness are acceptable to God. But those very sweet in words but with wrong notions are worthless. [Hazrath Bilal the first caller for prayer (Muazzin) of Islam, used to mispronounce while reciting some words. The hypocrites complained about this to the Prophet that he being the first Mauzzin is leaving a wrong precedent, and he should be replaced with a better pronouncer of words. The noble Prophet did not agree. His mis pronouncements are corrected and taken by God. Meaning that it is not the words but intentions that are worthy of consideration].

chapters.title: Mistakes of Friends
chapters.subtitle: To say that the mistakes of Friends are Better than the correct acts of Enemies

sections.heading: H. Bilal’s Mispronunciation
paras: That truthful Bilal while calling for Prayers (Azan) used to say “Hayyi” as “Hayei” with much humility; when the hypocrites told the Prophet: O Prophet, it is not proper. This is being done at the time of laying of the foundations of the community. Please call for another muazzin, who can say more fluently. Reciting “Hayya ala alfalah” wrongly will bring about defect in the early stages of religion and goodness.

At this, eyes of the Prophet expressed resentment, and giving some hints with some hidden graces he said: “You are meanly in thinking so. His saying “Hayyi” is better than a hundred Hayei and other sayings. Do not displease me so as to compel me to reveal your secret designs and speak out from beginning to end of what you feel.”
If you do not have that clean breath with which to supplicate for blessing, you may go to those who have it, so as to supplicate for you.

chapters.title: Pray with a Sinless Mouth
chapters.subtitle: God’s command to Musa peace be upon him, to “call Me with that mouth, which has not sinned”

paras: This is for the reason that God told H. Musa: “at the time of supplication, seek my refuge first with your mouth that has not sinned.” H. Musa said: “I do not have such mouth”. And God said: “Call us through the mouth of another, as you have not sinned through that man’s mouth. Say, “my God” through another mouth”.

That is, you do such acts that others should pray for you, day in and day out. Their mouths are those through which you have not sinned. Those mouths of others become your pleaders. Or, you may make your own mouth clean and make your spirit smart and fast. Remembrance of the thoughts of God are clean, and once they come about, uncleanliness vanishes, on its own. Opposites run away from opposites, just as night vanishes when the day comes. When the clean name of God comes in the mouth, neither that uncleanliness remains nor that unclean mouth.

chapters.title: God Never Fails to Respond
chapters.subtitle: To explain that God instantly responds to the call of those desirous of Him.

paras: A person was calling the name of God at night so much that his lips became sweet. Satan told him: “Stop this you dunce! How long would you go on doing this? In fact you are doing this only as a ruse. When you have been calling Him for all these nights, has there ever been any response from Him? That being so, far how long will you call Him”

That man got heart-broken, stopped calling God and went to sleep instead. In his dream he saw H. Khizr, the ever-living prophet of God who guides those in distress in a green land and asked him as to why he stopped calling God and why he is in distress. He replied: “I called upon Him so many times but there is no response from him. I am afraid my doors towards Him are shut.”

sections.heading: Taking God’s Name Itself Is His Response
paras: H. Khizr said: “God has told me to go to you to tell you not to fall into this trial. Your calling Me itself is My response. Your humility, your pain and crying itself is Our message of response. Have I not kept you engaged in My job? Have I not kept you in My remembrance? Your inclinations and efforts were a result of Our attraction for you because of which you moved towards Us. Your fear and love for Us are Our grants; and every time you said, ‘My God’, that saying itself is Our response. A man ignorant of this keeps away from calling Us and it is not in his thoughts to call Us. His mouth and heart are locked and even when he is in pains We are not in consonance with them.

“We had given Pharaoh a large country and plenty of wealth to such an extent that, out of pride, he called himself as God. In his entire life he did not have the trouble of even a headache, so that he could call Us. This not giving of any pain was a misfortune for him. This was his misfortune that he was given so much of authority in the world but not a bit of pain. Pain is a greater wealth than authority which makes one to call upon God in privacy. This is for the reason that pain, sorrow and burden of griefs are the provisions of dear ones of God. Calling upon God when not in pains is callous and tasteless, but the same pain attracts and penetrates into the heart. Giving a call slowly under the lips with suppressed cries is the beginning of remembrance. It becomes clear and sorrowful when he says: “O God, O helpful and O reliever of griefs. Even the crying of a dog on the road is not without a feeling. Everyone on the road is a victim of some dacoit or the other.”

sections.heading: Dog of the People of the Cave
paras: A nameless, ordinary dog was a companion of the noble ‘People of Cave’ who were imprisoned in the cave and went into deep sleep over a large number of days to be protected for their faith from the cruel rulers of their country. They had woken up after a long time after their tormentors had been overrun by others, upon which, they came out of the cave and received honourable treatment. This dog in the company of these noble men having left its dirty ways of life, became so worthy as to sit with kings on their dining tables. His name is always taken along with names of those noble people eversince, as though he is sitting at the opening of the cave and drinking the water of the benevolence of the knowledge of God, so long as the world lasts. It so happens that many a times, there are many persons in shabby clothes without any name and recognition, but are not without such drinks of God’s gnosis, unknown to others.

sections.heading: Cheats Galore: Be Careful!
paras: O young reader, in order to get such a drink, you have to devote your life, as no victory comes without holding on to patience and continuous efforts. There is nothing wrong in a long waiting for such a drink. Be patient, as patience is the key to pleasure. Nobody has reached this point without patience and careful steps, because carefulness in treading a path is a practice of hands and feet themselves. Be careful in taking food as many dishes are poisonous. Patience and carefulness come out of the light and might of prophethood. Grass, out of its weakness bows down with the impacts of the wind; but you should be like a rock to divert every type of wind. All around there are witches waiting to catch you and the road advises you to be careful. Be with me on this path as I am well aware of the subtleties and intricacies of this path.

H. Yusuf did not have a guide, nor did he know of the path, and he ought not to have gone with those with the character of wolves. You should be careful that nobody cheats you with his slippery, sweet, worldly nets of words. His words are neither sweet nor fatty. He only casts magic spells in your ears. Come, my guest, in the brightness of the hospitality of my house and this home is yours and you are mine.

sections.heading: How to Avoid Cheats
paras: In your carefulness to avoid the cheats, it is better to refuse their food by telling that you are suffering from indigestion or that you are sick and injured and the precincts of graveyard. Or say that you have headache or you have been called for by our cousin. Because he will give you a little honey with a hundred stings, which upon drinking causes many wounds. Even if he gives you gold coins, you should avoid taking as these are like a flesh of bait that is stuck to the hook to catch fish. If that cheat gives you something, it is like rotten apricots. Only his tongue is sweet. Jingling of coins takes away wisdom and sense and causes failure to understand even one sensible statement out of thousands. Your own resources of food and money are real friends and rely only upon these just as the Arabian lover, Ramain never sought for anybody else other than his beloved Daleesa.

sections.heading: Care and Caution
paras: Your Daleesa and your beloved are one and the same; that is, they both are your own self, and all other things other than yourself are only troubles. Your cautiousness is in thinking upon the invitation of these mischievous people should be that they are not your sincere friends. Their invitation is like the mimicry of the hunter which he makes to catch birds, keeping himself hidden behind bushes. He keeps a dead bird nearby to cheat the birds to feel this mimicked sound as a wailing and crying of a bird in distress. Birds get confused of the situation as the seeking of help by a fellow bird and assemble there, upon which the hunter pounces and catches them. The only birds which escapes this trick is one which is bestowed with wisdom by God. Carelessness certainly brings about worries and yet never be careless. Carelessness provides the fruits of misfortune depriving one of one’s religion, and gives headache. To understand this in a proper manner, hear this narrative and its perspective to protect your religion.

chapters.title: Care and Caution to Avoid Traps
chapters.subtitle: A villager’s Developing Friendship with a City Dweller and Extending Invitation with Flattery and Humility

paras: Know this brother that once upon a time a villager was a friend of a city dweller. Whenever coming to the city, he used to stay in the street of the city dweller, staying there for two – three months, visiting his shop and dining with him at his house. The city man used to provide all required needs of those days to him, all free of cost.

One day the villager told the city man: Sir, you did not visit the village anytime for recreation. Please for, God’s sake, come over with your family as it is a spring season and gardens and weather are very pleasing. Or you may come in summer, when all kinds of fruits ripen so that I may render my services to you. Come with all your friends and relatives and stay for three – four months. Villages are very pleasant in spring season with bright farms and flowers.

The city man used to promise unwillingly just to pass off the demand and this went on for eight years. Every year the villager used to raise the demand telling that spring has come and gone and autumn arrived. The city man used to evade every year telling that his relatives are expected to come this year, and postpone upon next year.

The villager used to say that his family waits for him and his children. Thus every year he used to come and go on repeating his invitations and settle in the city man’s house, upon which the city man used to meet his expenses. On the last occasion he took care of the villager for three months. The villager felt ashamed and grumbled and said: “You have given promises so many times and breached.” The city man replied: “I am also anxious to go over, but every moment of man is under the control of God. Man is like a ship, and its sails, and let us see when the Master of the wind blows. The villager pleaded swearing upon his own name to visit the village along with children and have a nice time. He held his hand three times and took a promise, saying you have dodged me for ten years.”

sections.heading: Precaution Before Taking New Ventures
paras: The city man’s children also pleaded to their father saying: “The moon, clouds and shades travel. You have established some rights on the villager and suffered a lot for his sake. He wants to fulfil his rights by hosting you. The villager has entreated us also to persuade you to go.” The city man said: “What all you say is right. But the great wise man, Saibuyah has said that one should protect oneself from the mischief of the one whom one has rendered great benevolence. Friendship is a virtuous act that comes to help at last. I am afraid that it may rot if it is not properly treated. One companionship is like a sharp slashing sword for the winter crop in farms and gardens. Another companionship is like the spring season which increases the wealth of people. It is required that you should think ill of certain situations to protect yourself and from bad results. Even though the noble Prophet has said that precaution means thinking of bad results, yet one should consider every step as an entry into net. Face of the desert is vast and flat, but every step in it is a trap. Be careful while entering into it. The hilly sheep runs about in the fear of the loop, yet it gets caught in the loop. It looks at the green forest and not at the loop. Without passing through the process of trap and loop, sheep does not become domesticized and kept in the farm. Such of the people who had not been careful can be seen under the earth in the form of shattered bones and jaws. You may enquire about their fate when you pass by a graveyard so that you may see clearly that those who were intoxicated of their power while moving about proudly fell down in the pit of their arrogance. Do not walk blindly when you have the gift of eyesight; and if you do not have good eyesight, take a stick in your hand. If you do not have the stick of carefulness and maturity of mind, make some wise, bright-sighted one as a leader. If you do not have the capacity to take care, of your own, do not stand at the head of every path without one who can hold it. Keep your steps carefully as a blind man does, so that you may remain away from every stone and pit. A blind man shivers, fears and cares when he keeps his feet on ground to avoid falling into wrong place. Often, it is seen that one who runs away from smoke falls into fire; and one in search of a mouthful of food becomes a morsel of the python.

chapters.title: Ungratefulness
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of the People of Sabaa who Became Arrogant upon Receiving Grants; and their Falling into the Misfortune of Mischief and Disobedience; and Explanation of the Excellence of Thanksgiving and Recompense for Grants

paras: Have you not read about the story of the people of Sabaa. Or, you might have read or heard about it but taken it as an echo of meaningless talk. Echo is a sound which comes about along the hill, but the hill itself is not aware of it. There is no scope for the hill to know its meaning. It repeats and shouts without any ears and sensibility. And if you keep quiet, it also remains quiet.

sections.heading: Faithfulness of Dogs
paras: God gave in plenty to the people of Sabaa, in the form of thousands of palaces, forts and gardens. These vicious people did not recompense for these grants and they were lesser in thanksgiving than the dogs. If a dog receives a piece of bread from a house, it remains devoted to that house. It becomes a watch and ward at its door even if it is later ill-treated. It resorts to live and settle there and considers it as a rejection of grant to go to another place. If another dog comes over there from another place during day or night-time, other dogs teach it, and warn it by barking at it, to go back to the house where it resided and recompense for the support it received earlier there. They bite at it to send it back there to not to ignore the benefits it received.

But you have drunk the water of life from the door of a man of heart. You drank it many a times and there arose fountains from your heart too. You have taken from him the food of forgetfulness of the self, getting momentarily out of control and observing unseen things. All these, you gave to your soul taking from such men of heart. But you freed yourself from their doors because, of your greed with which you roam about and stand at every shop with greed. You run after the cooking vessels of the rich for the sake of tasty dishes in all meanness. You ignore the fact that tasty and fatty food is that which fattens the soul and not of the body. It would be better if you go away empty handed from here. Church of Jesus Christ is a dining sheet of the people with heart; therefore, O sick man, do not leave this door.

chapters.title: Receipt of Grants from Great Men
chapters.subtitle: Coming over of The Distressed Every Morning at the Church of Jesus Christ to seek Redressal with his Blessing

paras: The blind, lame, cripple and poor from the surrounding places, used to collect at the door of the church of Jesus Christ in the morning hours to get relieved of their problems with his breath. He used to come out at the door after finishing his prayers. He would look at the crowd of the suffering lot waiting for him full of hopes. He would supplicate for them to God, and the needs and objects of all would be fulfilled. He would say: “O suffering people, all your needs are met with the grant and blessings of God, without any efforts from you.” Like the camel whose legs are untied of ropes, all of them would become healthy and go back with the healing breath of Christ and the command of God. All of them used to go back to their homes with the breath of the blessed one.

You had also been many a times with troubles and got rid of them with the kings of religion. Consider as to how many times your lameness has come and gone and how many times you got rid of sorrows. If you do not recognise, this recklessly, tie up your feet so that you may foolishly forget your own self. Your thanklessness and ungratefulness has made you forget the health-giving-honey that you received from the elders. Certainly, when the hearts of the men of heart were injured, the path of truth closed for you. Be quick to repent for this wrong and with all humility shed tears like clouds felling rain drops, so that the fruit gardens may open for you and ripe fruits fall down for you, Run towards that door and do not be inferior in faithfulness to the dog, even if you have become a companion of the dog of the People of the Cave.

sections.heading: Dogs Compel Dogs to Be Faithful
paras: Dogs advise dogs to go back and be at the earlier house and hold on to it as they received the bones there. They even pounce upon and bite those dogs to go back to be faithful to the earlier master’s house. They tell it to be bound to it, become its guard and not to be ungrateful either in conduct or in exhibition. Faithfulness and gratefulness are the character and conduct of dogs and they should not bring disgrace and bad name for the dogs. They ask the freshly entered dogs as to why they have resorted to dishonesty as against their way of life.

God has spoken proudly of honesty telling “Wa man aufa be ‘ahdihi min Allah” (And who is more faithful to his covenant than God: (Tauba: 9: 111). Faithfulness with the opponents of God is unfaithfulness. Nobody should proceed to provide grants to those who have no rights. Consider light as light and fire as fire. Keep flowers in the place of flowers and thorns in place of thorns.

sections.heading: Mother’s Benefaction
paras: Mother has a great right upon you, but God’s right is greater, because it is He who made her the carrier of your life. He has given a shape to you within her womb and provided comfort and character for you therein. She considers you as a part of her own body, but Allah separated you from her body. God has made you with thousands of schemes and designs so that your mother may grant her benevolences. Therefore, the right of God precedes the right of mother; and whoever fails to recognise this is a fool like an ass.

sections.heading: God’s Callings to Men
paras: The one who created your mother also created nipples and milk and provided her a husband to support her. This has not happened on its own. O Lord, You are the earliest benefactor. What all I know and what I do not know is due to You only. You have asked me to remember the Truth as my right is not forgotten. You have asked us to remember the days when we were protected in the Noah’s Ark long long ago to bring us up now after so many centuries. You told us: “Your protection is going on since then till now. You told us: your ancestors were protected at the time of the deluge. Water had become destructive like fire and its waves had become higher than the mountain peaks. I protected you and did not reject you. I protected you through the protection of your father, grandfather and ancestors. Now that you are like a leader on the earth, I cannot kick you down and spoil My own institution of production. But with evil thoughts you are going towards the dishonest people to offer yourself as a ransom. I do not forget and I do not show dishonesty. Come over Me and give up suspicions. Your suspicions with other men are alright, because they are also like you in suspecting things. You have made many such people as your friends and supporters, but they are no more with you. What can you tell me about them, if I ask you, as to where they are. Your noble friends have gone up to the heaven and the ignoble to the depths of earth. But you are still living in between, helpless, and ignored like the fire in the stoves of the camps after the caravan left.

“Hold on the lapel of the One, who is free of the high and low. Be not like Jesus who was lifted high enough to the heaven, nor like Qaarun who got penetrated into earth: Hold to Him who is with you in this material world and that non-material world, when you are not at home or in your shop. He removes the impurities from your heart and converts its hardness into softness. He imposes some hardships upon when you commit wrongs in order to warn you and to take you to better state. If you deviate from good acts, you are made to feel sorry and unhappy under the burden of conscience in order to discipline you so that you may not repeat and you may go back to your earlier goodness. If this is not done, your deviation goes on increasing and becomes a chain of hard-heartedness. This is done as a token of love to cleanse you, to prick your consciousness and make it see things in clear fashion. These are all hints, which you should not ignore.

Sins give you pleasure but darken your heart, which becomes fetters of torture after death. The reward for one “who turns away from our Message, verily for him is life narrowed down and We shall raise him up blind on the day of judgement” (Taaha: 20: 124).

sections.heading: Prick of the Conscience
paras: When a thief steals someone’s materials for the first time, he suffers from the pricks of conscience and crying of heart. He wonders as to what this crying is. This cringing is the effect of the tears of his oppressed’s victim. If he does not attend to this prick, the fire of his sin starts blowing air for repetition. This cringing of the heart inevitably gets imprisoned by this fire and his feelings become immune to the impacts, and the flag of repetition is raised. His conscience gets imprisoned and he becomes liable to be lain flat, hands and legs tied apart by four pegs to be whipped. Immunity from feelings is a root which sprouts branches. Earlier, it was hidden and later it shows up itself. Therefore, pluck and remove it as soon as it develops, so that it may not grow ugly thorns in the garden of your body. Once you have seen the pricks of heart, go fast to remove the cause as this is the foundation for the rising up of all things. If you see the expansion of heart, give water to its roots to grow more, and when you get its fruits, distribute them among friends.
Come; let us go towards the story of the people of Sabaa so that I may continue it to get good results.

chapters.title: Comforts Lead to Arrogance
chapters.subtitle: Further Story of the People of Sabaa

paras: These people of Sabaa were immature in wisdom like children and they were rejecters of the grants of the great men. Rejection of grants is like quarrelling with those very people who grace them. They said: “these grants are of no use to us and there is no need for you to feel sorry for us. We are ourselves sorry for what you have given to us. Be benevolent to us by taking away from us the grants you have given. We do not want eyes to see. Make us blind. Keep these things away from us. We consider what we possess as good, even if you consider them as bad. These are pleasing to us. We do not want these great forts and fertile gardens, good times, peace and prosperity. Our cities are closeby to each other. This is congestion. Those forests are better wherein there are wild beasts.”

Man desires for winter in summer. When winter comes, he calls it bad. He is not happy with existing circumstances, neither in difficulties, nor in comforts. Man is ruined because of his thanklessness. He rejects good instructions. Man’s selfishness is loss-causing and that is why there is a command to crush it.

Those elderly advisers told them to crush their desires. Thorns are on it on all the sides. These will prick and injure you. Set fire to them and also to your passions and behold the hand of friendship of the noble people.

sections.heading: High Level Arrogance
paras: The people of Sabaa went beyond their limits and said that polluted air is better than fresh air. Advisers tried their best to bring them on right path and to prevent them from mischiefs and rejections. But they thought of finishing off the advisers and resorted to sow the seed of sins and arrogance. But when bad times come, they narrow down the life; and sweetness of life becomes bitter. When death comes, it narrows down the surrounding air and blinds the eyes. It shuts the eyes so that they cannot see even the eyeblack in them. When the design of God flies the dust around a horse rider, it even prevents him from seeking the help of God. In such a situation, you should run towards the Great Rider and not towards the dust, as otherwise His designs will crush you down.

Whoever was eaten by the wolf was told by God: why did you not lament when the dust raised by the wolf was seen by you. You could not know of the oncoming of the wolf and kept yourself engaged in eating grass. “Inspite take the case of the sheep: the moment they feel the smell of wolf, they run away helter-skelter whenever they find the place of refuge. Generally, all animals feel the smell of lions as their brains are very sensitive to lions smell and they run away from the place where the lions live.

Now that they had smelt the lion’s smell of the God’s anger, they ought to go back and become holders of supplications to protect themselves. But they did not go away from the dust raised by the wolf, and after the dust a larger wolf of hardship came in, which ferociously tore them like sheep. They had shut their eyes from the guarding eyes of the shepherd. The shepherd called them all to his side, but they did not respond and threw dust in his eyes telling: go away, were are better caretakers of ourselves than you. How can we be obedient to you when each one of us is like a leader. We prefer to be a morsel of the wolf’s mouth than to be under the obligation of a well-wisher. We are the fuel for the fire and not the victims of shame and obedience to you. “Their feeling of self-respect was a madness and acted as the crow’s croaking at their door to warn of an oncoming calamity. They dug up a well for those in difficulties, but they themselves fell down in it and cried out in pain. Like the brothers of Joseph (Yusuf), they tore his shirt, soaked it in blood and deceived their father that he was eaten away by wolf. They got avenged for all that they had done.

sections.heading: Even Jibra’iil Not Spared
paras: Who is this Yusuf? It is your own heart which speaks of truth, who is held up like a prisoner on your way. You have tied Jibra’iil to a post and injured his wings and feathers. You want to present before him a roasted heifer as food, not knowing that Jibra’iil does not depend upon material food. Sometimes you pull him and sometimes you push him. You tell him, it is our delicious food, not knowing that his food is nothing but the sighting of God. Jibra’iil is like the human soul that gets disgusted of these trials and grippings and complains to God about you and tells: “O God hear this complaint from this old wolf”; and God tells him to be patient as good times have come. He tells: I seek justice from you against the commitments of these unrighteous fellows. I seek justice from You as none other than You can do justice. My Patience has come to an end at the hands of the cruelties of these people. My remaining away from You is no more possible. I am like Prophet Muhammad who has suffered at the hands of the Jews; and like Prophet Saleh who was imprisoned by the Th(s)amud. You have provided solace to the prophets. Either cause my death or call me back or You may Yourself come over to me.

sections.heading: Rejectors of God, Not at Peace
paras: You know that even your rejecters cannot remain in peace with your separation; and separation from the friends is still more unbearable. When the separation is not tolerable for your rejectors it is all the more intolerable for friends. At the time of punishments every one of the rejectors says: Yaa laitani Kuntu Turaban (Woe to me! Would that I were (mere) dust: Nabaa: 78: 40). When the condition of someone of the other side is like this, what can be that of those who crave for you.

Upon this God says: “Yes, O clean one, have patience. But know this that to hold patience is a difficult and patient Job. The morning is soon to arrive. Do not take hard breaths as stated in the Quran: Wa alsubhi izatanaffus! At the dawn as it breaths away the darkness. (Takwir: 81: 18). With morning the time of your getting out of difficulties arrives, just as the angels had told H. luut: Morning is their time appointed. Is not the morning hear: Alaisus Subha Biqarib (Huud: 11: 81). Morning is near. Be peaceful! The time of your getting out is arriving. Keep quiet; do not cry. I am working for you. You may not work! My working is better than yours. Mine is a bitter medicine while yours is a sweet one. Bear with all this quietly; use your mouth less and your ears more.
These statements of wisdom have gone beyond limits. Keep the story of the people of Sabaa aside and speak of the master of the city who was taken away by the villager and how he went.

chapters.title: Greed Leads Towards Dangers
chapters.subtitle: Rest of the story of the City man, who went to the village upon the villager’s invitation

paras: The villager resorted to such flattery that the wisdom of the wise city man went mad. There were so much-repeated demands that the fresh water of the wisdom of the city man got polluted. That apart, his children were enthused to have a nice time to eat, play and enjoy. This was like the lure of enjoyment and play that was given to Yusuf by his brothers – Yarta‘a way yal‘ab: to enjoy himself and play: (Yusuf: 12: 11). In similar manner, with a strange fate, Yusuf was taken over and deprived of the protection of his father. This is not a game of entertainment but a play of the game of life itself, which was only treachery, appeasement and cheating. Therefore, one should not hear of what keeps one away friends, as it results only in loss after loss. Do not take it even if it promises thousands upon thousands of gains. Do not break off the friendship of a treasury officer in your greed for gold. Hear this also as to how much God resented and said this and that even to the companions of the Prophet. When in a year of scarcity, upon hearing the sound of drum beatings, they ignored and forsook the Jum‘a prayers and ran to the wheat sellers, leaving the Prophet alone. This, they did with the fear that others not in prayers might go and buy wheat at a low price; and when they go late after the prayers, they might earn more profit at their cost. The Prophet remained alone in prayer with only two, three destitutes committed to prayer.” One merchant beat the dream for business, and you separated yourself from God. You turned toward wheat in a mad rush, leaving the Prophet alone and you sowed the seed of loss and left the Prophet of God. Companionship of the good is better than entertainment and wealth; and therefore, be cautious and keep your eyes open. Your greed did not have belief in the fact that I am the Provider and the best of the providers.

One who provides food to wheat itself cannot destroy your reliance upon Him. For the sake of wheat, you separated yourself from the One who sends down wheat from the heavens. Ducks floating on water did not accept the invitation of the falcon to come over on land, but you are worse than ducks.

chapters.title: Safety First and Last
chapters.subtitle: Invitation of the Falcon to the Water Ducks to come on Land and their Refusal

paras: A falcon told the duck to leave the surface of the water and come upon the land to see the scatterers of sweets in the forest. The wise duck replied: “go away, O falcon! Water is a fort of peace and pleasure.” It told the other ducks: “the falcon has come as our destroyer; be careful and do not go out of the fort of water. Tell the falcon to go away from us and do not come nearer to us to help us. we have no response to your invitation. Let your invitation be prosperous to you. We are not prepared to fall into your design. Let our fort be for us and the sweets of your sweet land be to you. We are not after your offers. So long as there is life, there is no deficiency of food and no need for more flags so long as there is an army.

chapters.title: Wisdom Defeated by Fate
chapters.subtitle: Return to the Story of the Villager

paras: The wise and experienced city man pleaded many excuses before the strong, devil like villager. He said: “I have many jobs to attend to now, and if I go away everything will be upset. The king has entrusted a very important job to me and he does not sleep for the whole night in want for my response. I cannot ignore this job and cut sorry figure before him. Every morning a soldier comes and makes enquiries about the progress of work. You want me to go over to the village so that the king may get disgusted of me. What can I do to meet his anger later, except to bury myself alive.”

sections.heading: God’s Decisions, Supreme
paras: In this manner the city man offered so many excuses, but these could not be in accordance with the decision of God. Even if all the particles of the world offer their excuses, they are nothing before the decision of the heavens. How can this world run away from the heavens and hide itself. Whatever that comes from the sky towards the earth, has no way to escape nor has any means. Fire falls upon it from the sun and it keeps its head bowed down before it. Similarly, if the sky causes the havocs of rain, it destroys the cities. It has submitted itself to the sky like H. Ayub had surrendered to God telling: “I am your prisoner and You may do whatever You want to do to me”. You are only a small part of the earth. Do not stretch your head above and do not shut the doors against the commands of God. When God told you that He has created you from dust, He desired you to be dust. Do not go away from this.

sections.heading: Humble Beginning of All
paras: Look at this! I sowed the seed in mud. It became one with it and rose up above it, like the tree. Be prepared to go with dust for another time so that I may make you a leader. Water comes down from the heights and rises up again as vapour. A grain of wheat gets into mud and comes up later as a dancing plant. When the seed of every fruit gets buried in the earth it raises its head upon the earth. The truth of every grant is from the sky to earth, which thereupon becomes the food for life. When water submitted in humiliation and fell down from the heights, it became a part of man with a grand physical life and then flew upon the ‘’arsh (imperium) in great pleasure.

sections.heading: Fate Leads to Actions
paras: We first came down from the everlasting eternal world and then from this low level, we went upon great heights. Everything is active in one part and also passive in the other part and they go on saying Inna ilaihi raaji‘un (and to Him is our return (Baqara: 2: 156). The recitations and praises of God by all hidden parts have created turmoil in the heavens. When the fate desired to play its role, the villager defeated the city man. He was defeated inspite of all excuses and got trapped into the calamities of the journey. He was very confident of the determination of his mind, but inspite of being like a mountain the gushing flood washed away its half. When fate raises its heard from atop the sky, all wise men become blind and dumb. Fishes come out of the rivers, the flying birds fall into the hunters loop. So much so, fairies and devils get imprisoned in bottles. Even Haroot and Maroot get imprisoned in the well. Only one who got the protection of fate was saved; and his death did not come about by any means of killing. Excepting your running towards your fate, no scheme saves you from destruction.

chapters.title: Creator Knows Creations
chapters.subtitle: Story of the People of Zarwaan and their efforts to save themselves from the troubles of the poor and to go to reap the fruits of their gardens

paras: You have read about the story of the people of Zarwaan; and yet why do you go in for excuses. Some people with the stings of scorpions wanted to take away the shares of the poor. They made plenty of tricks for the whole night by remaining face to face with each other in silent consultations, fearing that God may hear them. Dry mud thought against dry mud, but it was of no use as a hand cannot do any act by hiding itself from the mind. How can the One who has created you remain without knowing your desire, whether it is truthful or otherwise. The Quran says: should He not know what He created? And He is the one that understands the finest mysteries and is well acquainted with them (Mulk.67: 14) (Alaa ya’alamu man khalaq Wa huwal latif ul khabir) How can He be unaware of the one riding gracefully. He knows what is in his fate on the other day. He knows where it is going down and where going up. He is after him and counting all his steps.

sections.heading: Pains Reduced When Heard by Others
paras: Now, you may hear the story of the city man, as to how he went to the village and got into troubles. Clear your ears and hear this carefully about his sorrowful journey; how many hardships and calamities he underwent on the way to the village from the time he left the city. Consider that the hearing of the sorrows of the pains of a person, is like giving a gift to him as it reduces his pains. His heart if full of the smoke of pain and your hearing acts as a hole through which some smoke escapes. Hear the sorrows of the painful hearts as getting stuck in the slush causes even a noble man great stress. An artisans house is full of smoke and keep your ears to hear his troubles while passing by it. Your ears become the path for his breathings of relief and the wide-spread smoke gets reduced during the time of your hearing of this pains when he gets a little diversion.

sections.heading: Be Not Afraid for the Select
paras: Sympathise with us, O finder of the path of God and take us toward the Guardian Lord most High if you are going towards Him. Our hesitation is a prison and imprisonment, which does not release the life into the path it seeks. Hesitation drags everyone from this place to that place and everyone thinks that he is on the right path. This hesitation is an obstacle in the path of God, and he is in a graced, who has his feet free of shackles. One who knows the path treads on boldly; and if you do not know the way, find it out with efforts, by following the deer as it leaves the marks of its feet and of its musk. With these steps you will reach the high level of lights, even if you walk on fire. Do not be afraid of the oceans, waves and froth if you have heard about the command of God: Be not afraid La Takhaf (Huud 11: 70) as was told by the angels to Ibrahim. If God has put fears in you, think that this command of La Takhaf is specifically for you; as he is sure to put bread into it when He has given you the plate. One who has no fear is not in need of this command of La Takhaf. Sorrows are ment for those who have a scope here to crave for happiness.

chapters.title: Curtailment of Village Life
chapters.subtitle: Marching of the City dweller to the village along with family

paras: The city dweller engaged himself in the preparation for journey and the bird of his decision flew fast towards the village. His family members also put their luggage on the bullock. They went on with joy telling that they heard the news of the fresh fruits in the village. There are green meadows, and there lives our lovable, generous host. He has invited us with a thousand entreaties and has planted a tree of generosity for us. We shall bring from him to our city all that would meet the needs of ten winters. He will ransom a garden for us and create a place for us in his heart. O our friends, go fast to gain profits; but their wisdom told them from inside: do not be happy (with these hopes). Try to become those who seek profits from God as God does not love those who exult in riches, as stated in the Quran, Inna Allah La Yuhibbal Farihiin (God does not love those who exult in riches: Qasas: 28: 76). Be slightly happy at what God has given to you. Every good news that comes to you puts you in carefreeness. Be happy with God and not with others as spring season is followed by autumn. Whatever occurs without Him is not a miracle but magic, weather it is your throne, country or crown.

sections.heading: Too Much Expectations from Others
paras: Be happy with troubles, as troubles take you nearer to Him; and going down in it is actually going high. Sorrow is like a lot of gems and the troubles are like a mine, but this cannot be understood by children. Those inclined towards worldly pleasures run after gems like children who run like wild donkeys for games. O the one like wild donkeys roaming about here and there, take care. There are blood sucking devils. Bows are hidden from sight, but arrows are not. Arrows are flying about, but the bow is absent and hidden. Similarly a young man is being pierced with hundreds of arrows of old age piercing from everywhere.

It is required that one should step into the forest of hearts so the deserts on the land may not stretch themselves to trap one. Heart is a city of peace, a strong fort with all materials of peace and security. It is a pleasurable garden for you and for your friends; and there are in it fountains and gardens within gardens. Walk towards the heart, O the walking one as there are trees and founts within it. Do not go to the villages, as villages make a fool of a wise man. They make the wisdom dull and displeasing, just like incompetent teachers do.

sections.heading: Villages Choke Wisdom
paras: The city man thought the village would give him his provisions but he failed to see that it is God who is the provider of food Who provides even to the village. O selected man, hear the words of the prophets that a village is a grave for wisdom. One who resides in a village for one day, will not have his wisdom in order for a month. One who resides in a village from sunrise to sunset gets deprived of the progress of wisdom for a month. Foolishness sticks to him for a month and he will move about only with grass around him.

sections.heading: Village Is an Unguided Shaikh
paras: That is to say that the village resembles an unqualified imperfect master, who is capable of doing nothing but the blind followership of others and is only argumentative. He is like a blindfolded donkey moving around the oil crusher and he loses his senses when he comes about the city of wise man. Leave these wise statements if you cannot digest. Pick up the grains of wheat, if you cannot pick up pearls. When there is no way towards pearls one should go to where grains of wheat are available. At least hold on the apparent acts of wisdom, even though appearances are misleading, because appearance to lead towards the inner faculties.

Every man, earlier, had only a physical body, and later came life in him giving him a character and personality. The miracles of instinct comes out of the physical body. The beginning of every fruit is only a shape and later comes its taste which is its worth. First, you have to obtain the means, and then to depend upon them. In order to host a king one has to buy and build an abode of honour for him. Your physic is like that abode and you are its king. Your worth is your capacity as a boatman, which is required to use a boat.

chapters.title: Reaching to Destination Place
chapters.subtitle: Entering of the City-man with his Family into the Village

sections.heading: Pleasures of Journey
paras: For God’s sake stop these thoughts for some time, so that the city-man’s donkey may ring its bell. The city-man and his children loaded their luggage on their animals and marched towards the village. They went in all pleasure towards the forest on the way saying: go on journeys to gain profits. Travelling makes a slave a king. How can the crescent develop into a full moon without journeying in the sky. When the chessman passes through some squares on the chessboard, it becomes the king’s minister. Yusuf, as a result of journey, achieved many objects. Travellers get their faces burnt in sunshine during the day and find their way at night by observing the stars. These troublesome ways appeared good to them and the ensuring pleasures of the village made them feel the road as paradise.

sections.heading: Magic of the Lovely Faces
paras: Abuses from the sweet lips become pleasing and thorns appear beautiful in garden. Bitter fruits given by the beloved becomes sweet like date. In the company the wife even a desert becomes a home. Many living comfortable life start picking thorns in the hope of seeing the moonlike, flowery checks of the loved ones. Carriers of heavy loads break their backs to see the attractive faces of their beloveds. Blacksmith blackens his face for the whole day to be able to kiss the one with a moonlike face.

Every man imprisons himself in the place of his job till the night as a tall cypress-like beauty has bewitched his heart. Merchants go on journeys on the lands and seas for gains. Actually, they go after one who is staying at home, whom they love. Everyone keeping himself busy with lifeless objects of his artisanship does so far, the sake of a lovely forehead. Every carpenter and blacksmith work in the hope of getting the service of a beautiful one at home. Put your efforts in the hope of getting rewards from that living person who dose not die and become mud after two days. Do not be a mean fellow to love a mean fellow as his mud love does not last long.

sections.heading: Love: a Blessing of God
paras: Without the love of God, even your parents would not love you. It is He who makes them love you. Your wet nurse and servant have no love and strength for you, if God has not provided those for them. Later on, you did not have love for the milk and breasts of the wet nurse. Though you hesitated to go to school initially, that hesitation was no more after some time.

Their love for you was like a shadow on the wall and it was no more when the sun shifted its place. When the rays of the sun fall on something you fall in love with that. Whatever was loved by you was due to the impacts of God. A time comes when gold becomes worthless like copper and its possessor becomes poor. When a man gets disgusted of a beloved thing, he departs from it, leaves it, and turns his back from it. Do not go after decorated and polished things and consider them to be precious because of your ignorance as the beauty of counterfeit coins is temporary and there is ugliness under their polish. Gold from these coins vanishes, and goes back to the mine and therefore do not go after the coin but go after the mine. Light on the wall passes off with the sun, and therefore go after the sun for light and not after the reflection on wall. Water should be collected from the rain falling from the sky and not from the roof of your house. Fat of the sheep does not come from the food of the wolf but from elsewhere which the wolf does not recognise.

sections.heading: Pleasures of Journey End
paras: The city dweller and his family were going towards the village thinking that they have already collected gold in their pockets under mistaken notions. They were laughing and dancing to the tunes of the pullies of the water wells of the village. Upon seeing a bird flying, they used to become impatient thinking that their destination was up nearer. Winds coming from the village were life-giving and soul inspiring for them. Whoever was found to be coming from the village received their kisses of pleasure saying that you have seen the face of our beloved and we see our beloved in your face.

chapters.title: Reaching to Destination Place
chapters.subtitle: Majnun’s graces to the dog that lived in Laila’s street

paras: The city-dweller graced them like Majnun who kissed and made offerings to the dog of Laila. In all humility he circumambulated it just as the hajis do with Ka’aba. He used to kiss its feet and its navel and sometimes, gave it sweet drinks sprinkled with rose water. One blabberer spoke to him: “O crude mad fellow, what is this mean act, you always do with it. Dog’s mouth always eats filth and licks its own arse”. He went on telling about the indecencies of the dog. But the blabberer who knew the defects of the dog did not know of the reasons behind Majnun’s acts. Majnun told him: “You look only at the body and from outside. Enter into me and look at it from my eyes. This is a mystery founded by God that, this dog has become a guard of Laila’s street. Look at its courage its heart and soul and recognise as to where it has gone and made its abode. It is a prosperous dog as the dog of my cave, like the dog of the noble people of the cave, who were beloveds of God. Rather, it is my sympathiser and my companion. The dust of the feet of the dog which roams about and settles in her street is better than that of great lions. I cannot exchange lions for a single hair of the dog of her street. The greatness of the dog whose slaves are the lions cannot be explained. Keep quiet, for you cannot understand this. Good bye”

sections.heading: Ignore Body and See Inside
paras: O friends, if you pass off from the observance of the body and form, you will see paradise with gardens upon gardens. If your break and burn the arrogance of your face you will learn to break everything else like Haidar (‘Ali), who had broken and thrown away the gate of the fort of Khaibar.

That city-dweller developed consonance with the apparent faces of the village and under wrong notions went towards it, getting caught in the trap of flattery, just like the birds which fall upon the grains. It mistook the grain as a grant of the generous. It did not see the net around and found no way of escape. Its greed was the cause of its loss. Due to their greed for grains, birds fly and run after Treacheries with all joy and pleasure. If I go on telling you about their pleasures, I fear I waste my time.

In short, I would say that when they reached the villages it was not that village of their imagination but some other village. For about a month they went from one village to another, as they were not aware of the road to that village.

sections.heading: Risks of Life Without Guide
paras: For a person who goes on a path without a guide, the distance of two days becomes long like that of a hundred years. Whoever goes to Ka’aba without proper understanding, gets disgraced like this city-dweller. Whoever adopts a profession without a master becomes a laughingstock in the city and villages. It will be a strange news in the world that a man was born without parents. He only gets wealth who carries on a profession, and it is very rare that he would get a hidden treasure. Prophet Muhammad whose body itself was a soul, could know only after the benevolent God taught him the Quran. Allama al Quraan. (Al Rahmaan: 55: 2). To all the people with material bodies, he taught with the pen. It is He, who taught all other men with the pen. (Allama bil Qalam (Iqraa: 96: 4). And made it a means with His grace and grant. Every greedy man is dissatisfied; and do not run after them but walk in slow steps.
The city dweller and his family underwent great troubles and pains like what the land bird feels in water. They got disgusted of the village and villager and his sugary words, without a master.

chapters.title: Grave Sufferings with Foolishness
chapters.subtitle: Visit of the City-Dweller and family to the village, and the villager’s treating them as unknown and strangers

paras: When they reached the village after a month, they were like cattle without grass. Looking at them the villager, with evil intentions started saying this and that. During daytime he avoided to show his face, so that they might not go to the garden. His face was of such mischief and treachery that it is better that it is hidden from the Muslims. There are many faces upon which devils sit like flies to guard them. If you look at them, you will be beaten up. If you happen to come before them, do not look at them and do not even laugh at them. About these sinful, dirty faces, Allah has said: We will drag him by the forelock (Lanasfa an bin nasiathin: Iqraa 96: 15) when they enquired and found out his house and ran after it like relatives, the people of the house shut the door, and the city-dweller became mad at this misbehaviour. But it was not a time to be harsh, as it is of no use when you have fallen in the well. They settled at his door for five days in chilly nights and burning days. Their remaining at that place was not due to foolishness, nor out of forgetfulness, but due to compulsions and lack of money. Under the circumstances of helplessness, noble people are compelled to be with the mean fellows. A emaciating lion eats a dead bird.

The city-dweller looked at him and saluted him saying that he was so and so and such and such was his name. The villager callously said: “May be. What do I know of you, whether you are good or bad. I am busy day and night in the observation of the workings of God. I have no concerns for you. I am not aware of my own self and I do not known to anybody except God; and there is none but God, in my heart and mind. “Mayself have the worth of a hair. What I am, is”.

The city-dweller said: “This moment is like the doomsday when a brother runs away from brother as said in the Quran Yowma yafirrul Mar’u min akhiihi: (Abasa: 80: 34) He explained to him: “I am the one upon whose dining sheet you have eaten delicious dishes. On such and such a day, I have purchased for you such and such materials. The secret that had not gone beyond me and you has to be revealed. Have you not been my guest for so many months? Do you not remember all those generous acts done by me for you? People have heard of the benevolences shown by me. Do you not know when the mouth eats, the face feels ashamed?” The villager replied: “What nonsense you are talking about. I do not know you, your name and place.”

sections.heading: Guest Treated Like Servants
paras: The fifth night, it so happened that there was heavy rain; so heavy that even the sky was held in surprise. When the chill penetrated into the bones like knife, the city-dweller rattled the door chain to call for the villager. When after much entreatment, he came out and angrily said: “What is this for?” The city-dweller said: “I have given up all the rights that I have upon you. I forsake everything that I thought of. I have seen a pain of five years in these five days in this chill and difficulty. One pain given by a relative and friend is more severe than a hundred thousand given by others. This is because one does not expect troubles from friends as one’s life is always accustomed to goodness, honesty and affection from them. All that a man feels as misery and pain, is due to his being not habituated to them”. He further said: “Though the love of your sun is towards setting; and even if you kill me, I shall forgive you. At least in this night, give us a corner in your house to protect us from rain so that you may get rewarded on the doomsday.”

The villager said: “There is a shelter in the corner for the gardener, from where to protect the garden from wolves. He carries a bow and arrow for the wolves so as to shoot at that fat wolf. If you do this job, this place is for you: as otherwise, you may go away wherever you please”

sections.heading: Extremity of Troubles
paras: He replied: “Okay. I shall do a hundred services for you. Hand over the bow and arrows to me. I shall not sleep but take guard of the grape vines; and if the wolf comes, I shall shoot it at its head. But do not send me to that place on this night as there is heavy rain on the head and slush under the feet.”

He was provided with a narrow corner insufficient for him and family. But he occupied that corner. Like locust they were rolling upon each other as those in the corner of a cave with the fear of rain. For the whole night they were telling. “O God, what kind of punishment is this?
