This is certainly a suitable punishment for those who befriended a mean fellow. And for those who show kindness to the mean fellows.”

Licking the walls and dust of the good people is better than the gardens and grapes of the ignoble fellows. It is better to be the servants of a wise man than to be above the heads of the kings. A man passing by, cannot hear a sound other than of the drum-beating of the kings of the world. Even the dwellers of cities are dacoits of the soul; what can be said of the villagers who are unpolished and crude. This is the punishment for one who heard the voice of the devils of the forests and imitated it. It is of no use if the wrong is admitted, when its shame has gone deep into the hearts. Taking long cold sighs is of no use after the heart is fully informed of the wrong.

The city-dweller with the bow and arrow with him used to search for the whole night for the wolf which could not be seen. On the country the wolf itself had dominated his mind. Every mosquito and flea was like a wolf for him, which was biting him in that ruin. He was so engrossed in the search of wolf that he had no time to chase away mosquitoes fearing that it may charge upon him any time; that it may come any time and give a chance to the villager to pull his beard. Thus, by shivering till the midnight, his soul reached upto his lips.

sections.heading: Wolf or Donkey
paras: All of a sudden, a wandering wolf showed its head from behind a mound. He released the arrow from his pinch, hit the wolf and it fell down. It fell down and cried out and farted and the villager started beating his forehead. He shouted “It is a baby of my donkey that you have killed.”
The city-dweller said: “No, it is a large-sized wolf. Wolfishness is clearly visible from it. All its appearances show that it is a wolf.”

But the villager said: “No. it is my donkey. I recognise it from the smell of its fart, just as I recognise wine from water. You have killed my donkey in my field. I make a curse that you should never get released from your difficulties.”

The city-dweller said: Make proper enquiries. It is a dark night now and faces cannot be recognised in darkness. Night distorts many things and shows them differently. No one can have a good sight at night. Nights, clouds and rains cause darkness and misunderstanding.

The villager said: “These things are clear to me as in the bright day. I can very easily identify the gas emanating from my donkey’s fart, out of scores of wind just as a traveller recognises his tiffin carrier.”
The city-dweller lost his patience and pounced upon the villager and caught hold of his clothing’s saying: “O pickpocket, you have consumed both opium and bung.

“In three darkness’s, you can identify your donkey. Why don’t you recognise me? How can one identify an animal in darkness remain without identifying a ten year old companion. You make yourself a knower and lover of God and throw dust into observing eyes. You said that you have no information about your own self and nothing exists in your heart except God. I cannot remember what I ate yesterday. This heart is not happy with anything other than the state of estrangement (in God). Similarly, you consider me as one unconscious of my acts and consider me as foolish and mad. Even such people have also their rights.

sections.heading: Exceptions of Law
paras: One who takes a forbidden drink and is in intoxication is considered in law as not liable for his acts. The pronouncing of divorce and entry into contract by one who is under intoxication is considered as void and is not liable like a child, and is free of all liabilities. One who gets intoxicated with the fragrance of God gets so much dullness of head which cannot happen even with a hundred pots of wine. How can there be punishment for him? He is like a horse that has lost its front and hind limbs which cannot be made to bear burdens. When it becomes lame, burdens from its back are taken away. God has said: Laisa ala al a’ama haraj: it is no fault on the blind (Nuur: 24: 61). Similarly, there is no fault on the lame: Laisa ala al a’araja haraj (: ibid). This is because there are no such difficulties as in blindness and lameness. Who puts a load upon the back of a baby donkey. Who can teach the lesson of Persian language to the devil. I am blind in respect of myself but fully bright in respect of God and therefore I am pardoned of my few and many sins. You boast of your forgetfulness and unconcern for wealth and cry out like a lover of God and also say that you are unaware of the earth and sky. Upon this God's honour has tested you upon your claims. The smell of the fart of the baby donkey has disgraced you and disproved all your claims of higher levels. This is how God exposes treachery and catches the flown away bird. There are hundreds of thousands of trials for such people who claim that they are soldiers tied at the door of God. Though common people do not understand these trials, the strong ones in His path find out the signals.

chapters.title: Trial Establishes Truth
chapters.subtitle: Understanding of the claims of the perfect and the claims of perfectness of the common people

paras: When someone makes a claim of good tailoring, the king places before him rolls of silk fabrics telling him to stitch a comfortable apparel with both capacities of his cutting and stitching to get him tested. Had there been no such testing of capacities, a eunuch would claim to be brave like Rustam. If you see a eunuch wearing the coat of mail, you will see that he surrenders to the enemy upon receiving a wound. A drunken fellow regains his consciousness when the western wind blows, but one intoxicated with the wine of God cannot regain even if the sur (The trumpet of resurrection) blows. The wine of God is full of truth, but what you drank is nothing but butter milk. That is all!

You consider yourself as the great gnostics H. Junaid of Baghdad and H. Ba Yazid of Bustaam and blabber that you cannot differentiate between and axe and a key. How can you, treacherous fellow put a curtain upon your bad nature, laziness and greed? You pose yourself as saintly H. Mansur Hallaj, the cotton ginner, but you set fire to the cotton stocks belonging to your friends.

You say: “I do not differentiate between H. Umar and Abu Lahab, but I recognise the air excreted by the baby donkey. O the one like a donkey, a donkey alone can believe in your words. That too a donkey that, for your sake, makes itself blind. Consider yourself as lesser than other searchers (saaliks). Do not be a friend of dacoits and eat grass. Keep away your feathers of treacheries and move towards wisdom, as one cannot fly into the heights of skies with artificial feathers. You consider yourself as a lover of God, but maintain friendship with black devils. The lover and the loved ones are brought together on doomsday face to face, and examined together. You have made yourself senseless and mad. You drank our blood and grape juice. You have told me that you cannot recognise and to go away and that you recognise only God and that you are the leader of the village like me H. Bahlul. You think that you are closeby to God thinking that one who makes a plate keeps it nearby to himself.

“You do not know that friends of God (aulia) have hundreds of marvels and grandeurs which benefit their friends. Iron became soft like wax in the hands of H. Dawood, but in your hands, soft wax becomes hard like steel. Nearness and provisions of God are for all, but these great men are nearer to God receiving His special gifts of love and inspiration.

sections.heading: Different Impacts
paras: You should know that nearness is of many kinds. The sun spreads its light on the mountains and on gold. But the light of the sun on gold is such that the ruttan reed cannot understand it. Dry and fresh branches of the tree are impacted by sun and it does not differentiate between them. From the fresh branches you get fruits which ripen and allow you to eat. But for the dry branches there is nothing but to become drier. Thus, do not be intoxicated of ignorance so that after regaining your normal self, you may not feel ashamed. But be like those drinkers upon whose words in inebriation, wisdom feels ashamed. Or rather, like those drunks whom the men of mature wisdom should exemplify. You have caught an old rat like a cat. Be like a lion to catch a lion when you are drunk like those great men. When you have not drunk the wine of gnosis and so not have even wrong impression, do not speak of truths just as the intoxicated ones talk. You are only falling this and that side like the drunk; you are on this side of the material world only and not passed through the path of the other world of souls. If you go over to the other side of souls, then you may shake your head this and that side to enjoy the fruits of revelations. You are entirely on this material side of materiality, do not speak of the other side. Do not talk like a man in death bed, when death has not approached you. That man with the unending life of Khizer who does not fear death should be better placed if he does not bother about the other creatures. You are trying to please the people with unreal taste. You are just blowing air in your goatskin instead of water. All your air will go out of it with just the prick of a needle. In the same manner you should not fatten your weak body. You want to make cups of ice in winter, which would just melt away in summer.

chapters.title: Pride upon False Decorartions
chapters.subtitle: A Jackal’s falling into a bucket of colours, getting coloured and boasting as a peacock before other Jackals

paras: A jackal fell into a bucket full of colours and remained in it for sometimes. When it came out, its skin got coloured and it thought that it was a peacock of paradise. Its hair have become colourful and pleasing to look at and the sun brightened the colours. It found itself in red, green, blue and yellow colours and proudly presented itself before other jackals. They asked it as to what happened that we see a kind of pride in you. Because of this pride you have become different from us; and from where did you get the cause of this pride. One of them came near to it and said: “you have done some mischief and made yourself pleasing. You have done this to stand up on the pulpit so that with your blabberings people may get flabbergasted. You tried very much to get elevated but having not achieved it you have resorted to this shameful act”.

Truthfulness and enthusiasm are the practice of the saints. But shamelessness is the character of the mischievous in order to attract people towards them. They feel happy at their appearance but deep inside they are unhappy.

chapters.title: Results of Boasting
chapters.subtitle: Boasting of a person by greasing his lips and moustaches with the hide of a lamb and appearing before friends to show that he has eaten fatty foods

paras: A mean fellow found a piece of the hide of a lamb with which he greased his moustaches every morning. He used to go among the rich and say that he has eaten fatty food in a gathering. While saying so he used to touch his moustaches in order to make them specially look at the moustaches to prove that what was said was true that fatty moustaches are symbol of eating of delicious food. But his stomach used to say without words that he was hungry, and that God upsets the tricks of the liars. It used to say: “your boasting has kept me on fire. May God root out your moustaches. O beggar, if you had not been boasting, so me generous man would have taken pity on us. If you had been truthful and not deceitful, some physician would have provided us with some medicine. Had you not hidden our defects, and lessened your harms on us, some friends would have become our host.”

God has said not shake the ears and tails in a wrong way: “the truthful will certainly get the reward for truthfulness: Yanfa’u al saadiqina sid qihim: [The truthful will profit from their truth (Maaida: 5: 122]

sections.heading: Truthfulness Gives Peace
paras: One who has had nocturnal emission while sleeping in curved manner in a cave, and not taken bath must speak of whatever happened and walk free. If you cannot reveal you defects, keep quiet, but do not engage in ostentation and fraud and bring disgrace to yourself. Do not have hope upon your falsely greased moustaches, because the cat has taken away the hide of the lamb with which you grease the moustaches, and you cannot commit the fraud anymore. Do not go on speaking among the people if you have found out some money, as there are many trials like rocks in the society to spoil it. Even in order to meet those trials; you have to undergo many trials. God has said that from birth to death one has to meet two trials every year. They are tried once or twice every year: (Yuftanuna fi kulli ‘aamin marrataini) (Tauba 9: 126). There are trials upon trials. Be careful as to be not proud upon a petty success. Do not remain without fear of the disgrace (of failure) which you would meet.

chapters.title: Prayers Responded
chapters.subtitle: Bal‘aam Ba‘or’s remaining carefree that Honourable God has already tested him and that he has come out untouched

paras: Bal‘aam Ba‘or and the accursed satan were pleased with successes earlier but got disgraced in the last trial, as they lost the fear of God’s designs as they thought that they would succeed again. At last, they got disgraced about which you might have heard.

The boastful fellow was leaning towards the possession of riches, when his stomach was telling ill of his moustaches in pain’s and praying to God: ‘O God expose what all he is hiding. He is causing pain to me. Disgrace him as punishment. All parts of his body were disgusted of him as he was speaking of his spring season, when he is in autumn.’

Boasting returns to the boaster all that he has done, and the root of benevolence gets uprooted. Either tell the truth or keep quiet and reap the gains of benevolence that come to you. His stomach became the enemy of his moustaches and prayed in silence: ‘O God disgrace this mean boaster so that the pities of the merciful persons may fall on us’. The prayer of the stomach was accepted, and the flag of poverty was unfurled. God said: ‘Whether you are a sinner or rejecter, when you call upon Me, I respond to you. You may cry upon your troubles and pray to Me and do not get tired of praying.

chapters.title: Truthfulness Pays
chapters.subtitle: Taking away of the piece of hide by the cat and the boaster’s disgrace

paras: When the prayer of the stomach was accepted, a cat came and took away that piece of hide. His son ran after the cat but could not catch it and became pale in the fear of his father’s anger. He came among the people and revealed the facts of the matter. He told them that the piece of hide with which his father was greasing his lips and moustaches was taken away by the cat. He ran after it, but it was of no use. When the boaster heard of this, he felt ashamed in the presence of all, lowered head and submitted and spoke of his folly. The assembled people laughed at him, and their sympathy moved. They fed him and put the seed of benevolence in his land. When you have seen the grace of truthfulness, do not be proud of falsities and become a slave of truthfulness. Hold on to truthfulness always in order to get a good name in both the worlds.

chapters.title: Boastings Do Not Last Long
chapters.subtitle: Claiming as Peacock by the Jackal that had fallen into the bucket of colours

paras: The Jackal that had fallen into the bucket of colours went near his critics and said: “Look at me and my colours. Even the idol worshippers do not have such an idol. I have become colourful like a garden with hundred colours. Do fall prostrate before me and do not deviate from me. Look at my grandeur, my shining brightness and colours and consider me as a foundation and pillar of the world and religion. I have become an exponent of the grace of God. I have become such a tablet from which the greatness of God can be read, O jackals: do not call me as a jackal, as no jackal has such beauty as I have.”

All the jackals came around it just as moths surrounding the lamp and asked it as to what it should be called. It said: ‘Call me a male peacock bright like Venus’. They said: ‘The peacocks, like the soul, exhibit their beauty in gardens of paradise. Can you exhibit any such scene’. The jackal said: ‘I cannot one who has not got into the forest cannot speak of the bear; and also, one who has not seen the desert cannot speak of it. They asked whether it could speak like the peacock, and it said: ‘no’. Then they said: You boaster, you are not a peacock which has high levels. The dress of honour of the peacock comes from the heaven. You cannot reach that level just with your verbal claims. If you still hold on to your claim, produce its proof. Do not blabber as otherwise you will have to scratch you neck in shame.

chapters.title: Boastings Fails
chapters.subtitle: Phaeraoh’s claim of godhood which is like the claim of the Jackal of peacockhood

paras: Similarly, Phaeraoh decorated his beard with pearls behaving like an ass, raised himself above H. Musa. He was also like one from the progeny of the jackal, who had fallen, like the jackal into the bucket of wealth and grand status. Whoever that looked at his wealth and status fell in prostration before him in fun and even that he swallowed. Like a beggar in torne clothing’s, he lost consciousness of himself and those around were flabbergasted. His wealth was like a poisonous snake for him, and the people’s obedience and prostrations were like pythons. O Phaeraoh do not project yourself as an honoured one. You are only a jackal; do not behave like peacock. If you go before the peacock, you will hesitate to show yourself and get insulted.

H. Musa and H. Haroon were like peacocks who hit him in the face with the feathers of their grand looks. Your ugliness and false grace fell before them, and you were toppled from heights. When your gold got tested, it became black like a counterfeit coin. The marks of lionness left and those of doggishness appeared. O ugly dog behaving-like-jackal, your rashness and greed, do not wrap yourself in the hide of a lion. Roar of the lion is the first test for your claim; and then the test with the face of lion; and then appears the character of the dog. O ugly, worthless jackal do not even think of considering yourself as peacock, as peacocks will test you and you will put yourself into disgrace and ugliness.

chapters.title: Tone Reveals the Mind
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of Wala ta‘rifannahum fii Lahni alqoul: (you will know them by the tone of their speech. (Sura Muhammad: 47: 30) in order to test the hypocrites

paras: God has said to the Prophet in the Quran that there is a simple way of finding out the hypocrites. Even if a hypocrite is fat, handsome and impressive, you can identify him by the tone of his talk. When you buy an earthen pot, you test if by tapping on it. You hear a sound to find out whether it has cracks. The sound of the one with cracks is different from that of the perfect one. And it is like the announcement of the orderly of the kings, who comes first. Sound that comes reveals and is like the verb which shows the status of an action or thing. When the occasion of the tests arrived, the incidents of Haroot and Maroot came to my mind about which I have told a little earlier. I wanted to narrate this, but because of some obstacles, I could not explain. Out of many matters, I shall speak of some which will be like explaining of a limb of the elephant. Now, hear the facts about Haroot and Maroot, as I am a slave and servant of your face.

chapters.title: Trials of Friendship
chapters.subtitle: Story of Haroot and Maroot and their boldness when God put them on trial

paras: Turn your ear for some time so that I may reveal some of the secrets of a friend. They were intoxicated with the sighting of God. And also, about their wonders and marvels. With the relaxation that God had given to them they were inebriated. With the marvels that they had achieved, and, when marvels cause so much effect, imagine the effects when God provided ascent towards Him. And also, when seed in their hand had so much intoxication, to what extent the plates of food of God might provide. They were His friends, but not under His trap; and like those in love they used to cry and sigh. There was a way with obstacles and trials for them, which contained such stormy winds that mountains flew away like dust. But a drunk cannot understand this, Trenches and flat land are the same for him. For him, wells and trenches are the same and good enough.

chapters.title: Power of Sexual Excitement
chapters.subtitle: Intoxication of a male sheep and its jumping below the hill to meet the female sheep (Ewe)

paras: A hilly sheep was running about on the hills to feed itself without much efforts. While it was eating grass, it saw a strange scene in the sky. It looked upon an ewe on another hill. Suddenly its eyes became sightless for some time and in an intoxicated mood, it jumped to the other hill. The ewe appeared so closeby as in the compound of a house. The distance of thousands of yards appeared like one or two yards. And, in intoxication it got a desire of jumping over it. And instantly it jumped and fell down on the ground between the hills. The hilly sheep is very smart and cannot be hunted, but in this case, it lost its own refuge. Hunters were sitting on the space between the hills hoping to see a great misfortune of the sheep. It is through this that it got trapped inspite of the hilly its very clever and smart with ability to recognise the enemy. However, a man is strong enough possessing large-sized head or big moustaches his passions became a net for his feet. Control your passions as I do. However passionate one may be, his passions cannot be stronger than a camel.

How much ever great the extent of inebriation may be, it cannot be as great as that of the angels. The inebriation of the angels destroys the inebriation of the passions of man. The angel does not respond to any passion. Saltish water is very sweet for one who has not tasted sweet water any time, giving delight to the eyes. One drop of water from the sky makes one disgusted of the wine and wine provider. Angels have many types of inebriations; and also, the souls that have achieved greatness. They have chosen for themselves the fragrance of heaven of the nearness of God; and therefore, they have shattered the wine containers of this world. But that is not so with those who have lost hopes and fallen afar, hidden within their graves like infidels. They have lost hopes of both the worlds and have sowed innumerable thorny bushes.

chapters.title: Domination of Fate
chapters.subtitle: Haroot and Maroot desired to become humans and God’s reluctance

paras: With their intoxication they said: “We would have established order all over the world like clouds and spread justice, equity, prayers and honesty in place of cruelty.” While they were saying this, fate was telling: “There are many invisible traps near your feet. Do not enter carelessly into the forest of difficulties and in places of danger, because one cannot find a way through the ruins of the dead nations. They have been converted into bones as the sword of the wrath of God wiped them off leaving no marks. God has said that his moderate servants walk in humility. Wa ibaadur Rahamaniallazina Yamshuna ala al ardi hownun: (And the servants of God most gracious are those who walk on the earth in humility: (Furqan: 25: 63). With bare feet they proceed carefully and slowly in a forest full of thorns.

Their fate was telling all this, but their ears were blocked with their excessive enthusiasm. Generally, people have shut their ears and eyes, excepting those who have set free the thoughts of self-assertiveness. Excepting the grant of God, nothing can open their eyes. Only love can put an end to anger. Attempts to act without proper guidance spoils the life even if the attempts are more in number that the heaps of grains of small-sized millets. May it happen that nobody’s struggles go without the guidance of God in the world. God knows best.

chapters.title: Phaeraoh’s Desire to Cheat Isra’ilis
chapters.subtitle: Phaeraoh’s seeing H. Musa’s coming in his dream and his attempts to stop it

paras: As the attempts of Phaeraoh were without guidance, all that he stitched was getting torne. There were thousands of astrologers, magicians and interpreters of dreams under his command. They saw the oncoming of H. Musa in dreams, who would destroy Phaeraoh and his kingdom. He consulted with them as to how to outdo the impacts of the vicious dream. They said that they would make a design to prevent the very process of his birth, until that day came when Musa had to be conceived. This was to organise a grand function with Phaeraoh’s participation in a long-wide field on that day and make announcement that the ruler calls all the Isra’ilis for a feast, so as to show up himself to them to grace them and benefit them. This was because the Isra’ilis were far away from him as there was custom of his being non seen by them. If they were to be on his way, they had to fall with their faces down. They were not entitled to look at their king any time. When they were to hear the announcement of his coming their way, they had to turn their faces towards the walls. Anyone, by chance was to see him, would meet severe punishment. They were all anxious to see him as man has a desire to see or do what he is prevented to see or do.

chapters.title: Avoidance of Conception
chapters.subtitle: Phaeraoh’s invitation to Beni Israel to the field to prevent the conception of H Musa An anecdote to explain

paras: The announcers went into their localities and announced of this happy news saying: “O prisoners, come toward to the field as the king would show up himself and grace you.” The Isra’ilis who were thirsting for his sight and anxious, got trapped in the design and ran towards the field. They were unaware and ran to the field to meet their desire.

In Similar manner, a Mughal (in later period) made a design and told the Egyptians that he was in search of a particular person, and they should all assemble in a place to find him out. The Egyptians from all sides assembled and one by one came before him. He used to say to everyone, ‘not he’, and he should sit in a place. All of them came in this way and got killed. This was because, upon the sound of Azaan they were not in the habit to going for prayers. The treachery of the caller dragged them. May God save us from the Satan’s designs.

Hear the calling of the poor and helpless and respond to it so that mischievous fellows may not drag you. These beggars may be greedy and tricky, yet there may be one with noble character. Pearls are mixed with stones at the bottom of sea. Situations of pride are found in disgraces.

Anyways the Isra’ilis rushed to the place with enthusiasm from the early morning. When all of them assembled, he showed them his beautiful face. He gave them gifts and made promises and asked them all to sleep in the field for that night. They said that they would obey the order and sleep even for a month if he so desired.

chapters.title: Well Thought of Plan
chapters.subtitle: Return of Phaeraoh with the satisfaction for having separated Men and Women to prevent cohabitation and conception

paras: The king returned to the palace thinking that there is no possibility of Isra’ili men and women coming together so that a child cannot be conceived. Imran was his treasury officer and he also returned with Phaeraoh. He told him to sleep at his door and do not go to his wife. He agreed and said, I never do anything against your wish. Imran was an Isra’ili but he was extremely devoted to him. Phaeraoh never thought that he would disobey being close to him like his soul. He never suspected that he would do any act that would cause him alone to be the cause of his destruction. Phaeraoh never knew of his fate. Such was the fate of Th(s)amuud and ‘Aad also.

chapters.title: Fate Plays Its Role
chapters.subtitle: Imran’s cohabitation with Musa’s mother and her becoming Pregnant

paras: The king went to his bedroom and Imran slept at the door and at midnight his wife came over to him. She groped him, kissed on his lips and woke him up. He got up and got immensely pleased and fell a rainfall of kisses on her. He asked her the reason for her coming at that time. She said her desire and God’s decision brought her. Her husband came over on her body as he was unable to control himself. He cohabited with her and returned the trust and said: “What he has done was not an ordinary job. Iron has dashed at the stone and fire has come out; a fire that would burn the king and his country. I am like a cloud, and you are like earth and Musa is the plant. God has played on the chessboard and the king got trapped. Victory and defeat are caused by God, O my bride. Do not consider what we did as an act done by us and also do not feel sorry for this. Whatever Phaeraoh feared came to be caused when I mated with you.

chapters.title: Loud Cries in the Air
chapters.subtitle: Imran’s advice to his wife, not to come to him anymore

paras: “Do not ever speak of this as otherwise hundreds of hardships and sorrows will fall on us. Atlast, the result of this will come about.” At about the same time there were many cries in the crowd that were scattered in the air. The king got frightened and came out even without his slippers to find out as to what these shouts were that devils and jinns were running away in fear. Imran told him; may our king live long; Isra’ilis are expressing happiness at the generosity of the lord. They are dancing and clapping.

chapters.title: Prophet’s Conceptions Frighten Enemies
chapters.subtitle: Phaeraoh’s fear of the shoutings and noise

paras: He said: “it may be so. Fear and doubt are worrying me. These sounds are changing my mood and sowing the seeds of sorrow and pain.” The king started to come forward and go back, and in this manner spent the whole night and went on saying: “O Imran, these shoutings are causing great fright to me.” Imran was not dare enough to speak of the real cause of these sounds as his mating with his wife; and that the star of Musa appeared when his wife groped him; as it happened that, whenever a prophet came into the womb, his star came up in the sky and shined.

chapters.title: No Victory Against Fate
chapters.subtitle: Birth of Musa’s star in the sky and the astrologers shouting at that

paras: Musa’s star appeared on the sky which blinded Phaeraoh and blunted his designs. In the morning he called Imran and told him to find out the reason for those shouts of the astrologers and enquired about it which caused disturbance in the king’s sleep. All the astrologers had removed their headgear, torne their clothes and were crying like professional mourners. Their voice had choked like the choking of the mourner’s voice, because of their cries. The instruments of pleasing sounds were off. They were pinching their beards and faces, putting dust upon their heads, their eyes reddened in sorrow. Imran asked them: “What is all this? What wrong has occurred. Has an accursed year shown its face”.

They sought an excuse and said: “O our lord, fate has imprisoned us. What all we did, and our wealth got ruined. The king’s enemy has come and run over us. The star of the birth of that child has appeared on the forehead of the sky and thrown dust into our eyes. When that star appeared on the scene our stars have gone into grief.”

Imran was pleased but in hypocritic way struck upon his mouth and said: “O what sorrowful event”. He hid his pleasure, and making a sorrowful face returned like a mad fool who had lost his sense. He behaved like an ignorant fellow saying many bad things about the crowd. Making himself bitter and sorrowful, he told them: “You have cheated our king due to your greed and dishonesty. You have taken our king to the open field and caused dishonour to his majesty. You kept your hands upon your chest promising to keep him out of danger. So much of money was spent and nothing was obtained”.

He went over to Phaeraoh and narrated the facts. Hearing this, he got angry and his bace blackened; and he called them all before him and said: “O dishonest fellows! I shall not pardon but hang you on the scaffolds. You have put me to disgrace and made me spend money upon my enemies so as to make the Isra’ili men away from their women. Wealth lost, honour lost and the job remaining unfinished. Such things are not of friends and noble souls. For so many years you have been collecting money from me and eating away the wealth of the country. I did all this to you, so that you may save me from such days and help me. What is the worth of your designs, knowledge and astrology. You are only swallowers of food, treacherous and vicious. I shall cut you to pieces and put them in fire and pull out your lips, noses and ears. I shall destroy your pleasures and comforts and make you the fuel for fire”.

sections.heading: To Play Tricks at Musa’s Birth
paras: They fell in prostration before him and said: “On one occasion, devil has dominated over us. For years together we have chased away many of your troubles. Our wisdom is in shock upon what happened. It has gone out of our power and conception has occurred. His father’s semen settled into his mother’s womb. Forgive us. We shall take care of the matter on the day of his birth, by keenly observing from the observatories, so that he does not remain alive, and fate may fail. If we do not happen to do this, you may kill us. You have that great wisdom before which all other wisdoms and senses fail”.

Then, the king waited day by day for nine months, so that the arrow of fate may not injure its enemy. When this material world strikes upon a place from beyond the universe (Laa makaan), the world of souls and origin of God’s power, it kills itself and falls into difficulties. Whoever makes surprise attacks on fate faces defeat and drinks his own blood. If the earth betrays the sky, it becomes unfertile and dashes with death. If the painting hits upon the painter, it loses its lips and beard.

chapters.title: Male Babies Slaughtered
chapters.subtitle: Phaeraoh’s treacherously calling of the women of Bani Isra’iil who had delivered babies, to the field, around that time

paras: After nine months, Phaeraoh came out sitting upon his throne and went towards the field. An announcement was made in the city: “O women, come and take your share of the world. You may come here with your babies to receive gifts and grants from the king. Just as men had received last year, royal apparel and money would be given to every woman. Know this, O women, it is your share now, and children will receive golden caps. Whoever has delivered a baby this year will certainly receive wealth from me”.

These women came out along with their babies in great joy and went nearby to the king’s tent, being ignorant of his mischievous design. When all the women came around him, their male children were taken away from them. They cut off their heads as a precaution, so that the enemy might not survive, and madness does not spread.

chapters.title: Baby Saved in Furnace
chapters.subtitle: Coming up of the soldiers into the house of Imran, and of the revelation to Musa’s mother to put the child in the fire of the furnace under assurance that he will be protected by God

paras: Imran’s wife who had delivered Musa, managed to save herself from this trial. See what happened after the playing of that trick with women by that dog-natured king after that day. He sent midwives into houses to find out whether any child was left out. One such woman gave a signal that there was a child there which was not brought to the field as his mother was suspicious. She is very beautiful and lives in such and such street and she is very cunning. The soldiers entered her house, and she put the child in furnace with burning fire as per the revelation of God upon assurance that nothing will happen to the child. The revelation was: “This child is a progeny of Ibrahim. Throw Musa into the furnace and be fast, as We shall protect him from fire and smoke. Under our command: O fire become cold: (Ya naaru kuuni bardan) O fire! be you cool, as stated by God: (Ambiya’: 21: 69). The fire will not be hot and disobedient”. As per this revelation, she threw the child in burning fire, but the fire did not have any impact on Musa’s body.

The soldiers searched into the house, but there was no child there, and they eft without success. But many tale-bearers who were aware of the situation, enquired with the soldiers and told Phaeraoh for some money, stressing that the child was definitely there. Then the soldiers were directed to once again go and search in all the rooms and upstairs. They all came back to search for Musa.

chapters.title: Continuous Protection to Musa
chapters.subtitle: Another revelation to Musa’s mother to put the child in water: Alqiihi fil yammi: put him in the river: (Quraan: Taha: 20: 39)

paras: Again, a revelation came to “put him in water” and keep your face toward hope and not to worry. Put him in river Nile and be hopeful; I shall return with a brighter face to you. His mother put him in the Nile with the trust: He is the best Disposer of affairs (Nima al wakil: Aal Imran: 3: 173).

This matter of treacheries has no end; enough to say that all these twined around Phaeraoh’s feet and calves. While he was killing thousands of children, his enemy was growing up within his own house. Even the babies in the foetuses were killed by him in madness. With his designs he was acting like a blind man. The treachery of Phaeraoh was like a python, which has swallowed the treacheries of other kings.

But one greater than his treacheries came forward, which swallowed them all. It was a python, and Musa’s staff became a python which swallowed them with the support of God. One hand is above all other hands and that is the hand of God, because it is an ocean which has no depth and coast. Other oceans are just like streams before it. If designs and treacheries are like pythons, they are all nothing before Illa Allah (none but God). When I came to this extent to speak, I lost myself by saying: God alone is aware of the rightest path.

sections.heading: Phaeraoh’s Hidden in Men
paras: Whatever was there in Phaeraoh, is there in you also, but your pythons are imprisoned in your well. Regretfully, you have all these bad qualities, but you want to attribute them to Phaeraoh. What all I have said is your affair, yet I have not spoken of one hundredth of it. If your own affairs are spoken of, you get disturbed, but when said about others, it becomes an interesting story for you. Your mean self is spoiling you; it takes you far away from the right path. All these injuries are a product of the mean self, but you are defeated by it, and therefore you are very hard to realise. There is no need for the fire of Phaeraoh to set fire to your heap of cotton, as it is on fire on its own heat. There is no wood and twig for the fire of your mean self, as it destroys itself like Phaeraoh’s fire. Hear this story from this historian so that, on the basis of it, you may know of your hidden secrets.

chapters.title: Hidden Python Inside Man
chapters.subtitle: Story of the snake-charmer who mistook a frigid python as dead, put it in ropes and brought to Baghdad Phaeraoh’s warning H. Musas reply Seeking of time Time stressed Time granted Endless discussion Aakhiruna al saabiqun: Last to come, First in Lead

sections.heading: A Snake Charmer Went Towards the Hill to Catch a Snake with His Charms
paras: Whether a person is lazy or smart, if he tries to get something, that will reach him. Keep your hands engaged in a job to get something, because engaging in jobs provides the way to the goal. Whether a person is lame, handicapped, of sleepy face or uncultured, he should move towards his object to get it. Sometimes, by talking or silence or by feeling the smell, one can attain the object.

sections.heading: Success Lies in Searching
paras: H. Yaqub said to his children to search for Yusuf without limits. Let free all your senses to search him and go in all directions with utmost care. He told them not to get dejected of God’s grace. Thus, he sent all the losers of his son to go in search of him.

Search with all your senses the face of the beloved and with entire heart and soul. Ransom your life in making enquiries. Keep your ears in all directions. From which ever direction good fragrance comes, go towards it and find out. From wheresoever you see the impressions of grace, take it as a direction to reach and you can reach the real beloved, God. All these directions are like rivers starting from the same place. Ignore them and go to the source.

sections.heading: Bad Things Occur to Bring Good
paras: Defects of the people are for a good result. Trees having lost their leaves proceed for next greenery. Fights among the people are for the establishment of peace. Achievement of comfort comes out of discomfort. People’s anger is for the sake of goodness, and from the troubles of the peoples comes about honesty. Every beating is for the grant of some good. Every grievance leads to the happiness of redressal. The information about entirety comes out of opposites. Consider the entire world to be on the same lines as the staff of Musa become a python destroying the serpents. Wars create scope for peace. The snake charmer searched for the snake for the purpose of game. Man searches for snakes for entertainment; undergoes plenty of pains to enjoy rest.

The snake charmer was searching for a strange snake during winter season on the vicinity of hills. He saw a large dead python, which was very frightening to look at. In order to put the people in wonder, the snake charmer caught the snake. Foolishness of the people itself is great wonder. Man, himself is like a hill with many pythons hidden within him. Yet he gets wonderstruck by looking at pythons from the hill track. He is very dull in understanding himself. He is born with high potentialities but reduces himself to low levels. He sells himself at a very low price. He was made of silk fabric, but he makes it to patch it on torn clothes. Thousands of pythons and hills are wonderstruck at this, yet he feels wonderstruck at the sight of a python.

The snake charmer caught the python and brought to the city of Baghdad, to exhibit it and put the citizens in awe. The python was thick and long like a pillar at home and the charmer was using it for his livelihood, by passing himself as one who has done the wonderful act of bringing a dead python and for doing this, he has undergone many troubles. But the python was not dead; the charmer had not seen it properly. He had become frigid because of the winter ice falling on it. It was alive but appeared dead. The entire earth is also like frigid sediment and appears to be dead. Materials of the world are frigid wait till you see the sun of the doomsday, when you will see all material things also moving.

sections.heading: Life of Material Objects
paras: When the staff of Musa became a python, wisdom came to know about the material things also becoming alive. The idol of man was also of the material of clay but he was given life. Consider clay also as such. These materials are dead on one side but are living on the other side. These are silent here but speaking there. When God sends them from that side to this side towards us, Musa’s staff becomes a python on our side.

Hills have also sung along with H. Dawood, and the contents of iron became wax in his hands. Wind becomes one to lift H. Sulaiman, and oceans become one to obey the command of Musa. Moon becomes one to see the signals of H. Muhammad and H. Ibrahim’s fire becomes flowers. Earth swallows Qarun like the python. The log of wood of the palm tree, Hannana which the Prophet had used as a pulpit starts receiving instructions. Stones give salutations to H. Muhammad; and hillock gives message to H. Yahya (John). All particles in the universe speak out to you, day and night through their hidden tongues. They say: “We are hearing, seeing, and are happy of our conditions, but before you, we are silent as you are deprived of knowing all this. Inspite of you being alive, when you are following towards (dead) material bodies, you cannot know the secrets of material bodies. Leave off your stony attitude and march towards the world of life and hear the sounds made by the material bodies. You will know of their dedication and praises of God; and all your suspicions will vanish.

sections.heading: How Things Glorify God
paras: As the chandeliers of inner light in you are dark, you try to interpret differently about them by looking at them. God has said: Sabbaha Lillahi Ma fii alsamavati wa al ard: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorify Allah: (Hadid: 57: 1). The objects of glorification of God is not to show; and therefore challenging it to be shown, is a misunderstood thought. But the one who has the inner eyes, finds them in praises of God and becomes like them by taking lessons from them. as their tasbih (repetition of the glorification of God) makes you also to do that, the conclusion is that it is like their speaking by our mouth.

sections.heading: See Things with Inner Sight
paras: The argument of the Mu’tazila that material objects cannot recite the name of God as they have no mouths, become futile. It is regretful for the one who does not know of the states of the heart and its working (haal). So long as man does not come out of the world of senses (five senses of touch, sight, hearing, smell and tasting) he remains ignorant of the hidden pictures of nature which can be seen by the inner sight of the heart. There is no end to this discussion.

sections.heading: Python Dragged to Baghdad
paras: Let us go back to the snake charmer, who dragged the python with much efforts; and entered into Baghdad to assemble the people around a central place. He organised a show on the bank of the river, Tigris and there was a great talk of the event in the city: that a snake charmer has brought a python which is wonderful and strange. Thousands of foolish people gathered. Everyone was a victim of his foolishness like a donkey. The snake charmer was waiting for larger number of people and put on a blanket upon it to hide it from sight. People were gathering for the python to be shown. The gathering of the people should increase for the collection of alms and contributions. Thousands of rumour mongers gathered all around keeping their feet upon the feet of others in the thick assembly. The gathering became so large as the grapevines around their supporting mesh, or like the idol worshippers around their idol. Men had no consideration of women and women of men all in euphoric mood. They were all mixed up as if it was a doomsday.

sections.heading: Frigid Python Becomes Active
paras: Upon the snake charmer’s dragging the covering from the python’s body, they all used to shout loudly tearing their throats. The python was frigid due to cold and was under too many coverings of rugs. It was tied with many thick ropes. All this was done as a protection by the charmer. Due to the delay in the uncovering of the rugs, long waiting and gathering of the people and their shouts and cries, and the hot sun of Iraq spreading its heat and light on the python, the liquids in its body became warm, the python got into the activities of life and started moving and shaking. It’s coming to life after death put the people into greater astonishment from one to thousands. They all shouted with greater vigour and started running away in fear. The python was breaking the ropes with much sound that were tied on its body. All the ropes broke, and it became free, and its hissing was like the lion’s roar. Many of the men while running away fell upon each other and hundreds of them died.

The charmer was in terrible fear thinking as to what he has brought from the forest. A blind goat itself woke up the wolf and foolishly put itself into the grip of the angel of death. The python swallowed the foolish charmer. It was like the spilling of blood by Hajjaj bin Yusuf, the governor of Iraq during the reign of Caliph Abdul Malik bin Marwaan. The snake twisted itself and broke the bones of the charmer. All the people went away to their homes, so also the python towards the forest.

sections.heading: Man’s Inner Self; Like a Python
paras: Your inner self is also like a python. It appears dead but is not. It has become frigid due to coolness of the lack of means. If it gets the means as Phaeraoh had, it will loot hundreds of Musas and ordinary people. Your python is like a moth because of your poverty and also like a mosquito when you do not have wealth and grandeur. Imprison your python under the ice of deficiency and do not drag it into the heat of the comforts of Iraq. Your python is now frigid and if you give freedom to it, it will swallow you. Defeat it and consider yourself in peace. Show only a little mercy to it as it has no capacity to bear excesses. Because, when the sun of desires heats it up, it will start flying like the bat. Keep it under constant fights and battles like a brave soldier; and then God will reward you of His companionship.

The charmer had brought the python to the warm place. It became warm and active. Inevitably, it became a cause of mischief; but rather, more in hundreds of times of what we have said. You think that you can keep it under control by giving honour and comforts. Every mean fellow cannot do so. It requires a Musa to keep this python under control. Thousands have been put to great difficulties and got killed by this python, just like the snake charmer who got himself killed by responding to the python’s greed within himself. I have said what all I should. God alone knows the correct path of guidance.

sections.heading: Warning of Phaeraoh to Musa
paras: Phaeraoh asked Musa: “Why did you put the people in fear and got them killed. Because of you, people have fallen into doubts about religion. In the flight from the scene they slipped and fell upon each other. Inevitably, people have become angry with you; and both men and women have hatred for you. You are calling the people towards you, but the result is opposite. You do not do anything else than to become vicious in people’s view. I have also gone away from you because of your mischief; and I am also making arrangements to finish you. Remove this thought from your mind that you can cheat me. None will be with you excepting your own shadow. Do not be proud of what you have done. You have filled the hearts of people only with fear. Even if you bring hundreds of miracles, you will receive only disgrace, contempt, abuses and insult from the people. Many tricksters like you have come and gone and ultimately got disgraced in our Egypt.”

sections.heading: Reply of Musa to Phaeraoh to the Warning Given by Him
paras: Musa said: “There is no participation of mine in the command of God. If my blood is spilled by His command, I do not care. I agree with Him, and I am thankful to Him. I get disgraced here but I get honoured by Him. It does not matter, if I am disgraced, dishonoured and laughed at by the people; but before God, I am a loved one, important and appreciable. This much, I say, because I have to say; but you are going to be disgraced in future. Honour is for Him and His slaves. If you doubt, think of what happened with Adam and Iblis. There is no limits to explain His state and also the Truth. Be careful and shut your mouth; and turn the page.

sections.heading: Answer of Phaeraoh to Musa (AS) and Seeking of Forty Days Time
paras: Phaeraoh said: Papers are under my command. Office, working places and orders are in my hand at the moment. All the people have chosen me as their ruler and you think that you are wiser than me. You have chosen yourself. Get away and consider yourself to be at low level and do not be proud. I shall bring together the magicians of the world to show your ignorance to the people. This cannot happen in a day or two. Give a period of forty days during summer for this purpose.

sections.heading: Musa’s Reply to Phaeraoh
paras: Musa said: “I do not have permission for this. I am just a slave of God and I do not have the authority to give you forty days time. Though you are at present above me and I do not have a friend; but I am a servant of the command and nothing more. I shall fight against you so long as I have the strength. I do not have anything to do with any support. I am only a slave. I shall fight against you for so long as God wants. He alone separates all fighters”.

sections.heading: Phaeraoh’s Reply to Musa and Coming of a Revelation
paras: Phaeraoh said: “You will have to definitely give me time; do not talk nonsense and try to cheat me”.

God sent a revelation to Musa to give time and not to fear. Give him forty days time so that he may perfect his plans. Let him do what he wants; and anyway, I am not sleeping. Tell him to go fast and I shall put obstacles in his way. I shall upset all his plans; I shall throw down everything he adds. If they bring water I shall set fire to it. They will drink honey and I shall make it bitter. They will create allies, I shall destroy them in ways which are unknown to them. Give him a long time and ask him to make a hundred designs”.

sections.heading: Musa’s Grant of Time to Phaeraoh to Collect Magicians from Cities
paras: Musa said: “Command has come to me. I give you the required time. I shall go over to my place; for the present to get the relief”.

He was walking along, and the python was moving behind him like a faithful dog. Like a hunting dog shaking its tail. It was moving and crushing whatever that came in its way. It swallowed stones and pieces of iron and crushed them between its teeth, crushing them to powder. It was rising its head in the air high above the buildings. Upon seeing this, people of Rome and Gajistan were running away in fear. It was spraying its froth like the camels do, and upon whomsoever the drops fell, they caused leprosy. When Musa came back among his people and picked it up, it turned into staff. He rested upon the staff and said: “How strange! This miracle is bright like the sun for us and like a dark night for our enemies. How strange! They are not seeing this army which is clearly visible in the light of the late morning hours. Their eyes are open: so also, their ears and they have all senses. I am wonderstruck at the closing of all these by God. I am wonderstruck at them, and they are wonderstruck at me. But with the spring wind caused by God, I am surrounded by flowers, and they are by thorns. I offered them cups of clean wine to drink but it became hard like stone. I made a bouquet of flowers and presented to them, but every flower became a thorn and the honey in them became stings”.

sections.heading: How Knowledge of God Comes
paras: That cup of wine of the gnosticism of God goes to them who are already out of self-control under its impact; but cannot go to those who are caught in the world of senses. There has to be one who is awake in his sleep before us, so that one may witness dreams while being awake. The enemies of such dreams are the thoughts and engagements of sensual and worldly affairs. They cannot see such dreams. So long as these thoughts and engagements do not go to sleep, the throat for gulping of gnostic truths remains closed. One has to get wonderstruck to chase away sensual thoughts, upon which the throats and engagement of worldly affairs will get chocked. One who is more busy in worldly affairs is in the forefront, but in reality is on the last position.

Allah has said in the Quran: When a misfortune strikes them they say: Lo we belong to Allah and to Him we return (Qaalu inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raajiun: Baqarah: 2: 156). This returning is like of a sheep from a flock that went to the field or to the waterfront, which was at the last at the time of proceeding but will be on the forefront while returning to the shed. The lame sheep will be the first to re-enter the shed. Those who are at the end of the worldly affairs will be the first to go to God with pleasing and happy faces.

sections.heading: Lameness in Worldly Affairs
paras: The friends of God (Aulia) have become lame and taken up lameness in worldly affairs to be at the end, to become the first in the next world, after their return. They have opted for unrespectable life by giving up all things that give respectability. They take narrow and troublesome routes to go to Hajj with tired and injured feet as they know that the wide field can be reached through narrow ways. They wash and clean their hearts and keep them away from wisdom, as they know that the wisdom of the world cannot lead them to that world of God. That wisdom is required which leads towards one’s base as every branch of a tree starts and goes back to the root. No falcon can fly upon entire space of the ocean. So also, with wisdom of worldly affairs, one cannot know the expanse of the next world.

sections.heading: Knowledge from God’s Own Presence
paras: What is required for this is the knowledge of the nearness of God, that provides the knowledge from God’s own Presence as started in the Quran in respect of H. Khizr that he was provided knowledge from the presence of God Himself: we had taught him “Knowledge from Our Presence”: (Allamnaahu min ladunna ilman: Knowledge from Our Presence: (Kahaf 18: 65)

When God has to give this knowledge to anybody, that person should keep his heart clean of influences of worldly wisdom. Therefore, you should not be in search of this knowledge. Become lame in the world and be in the end. When the time of return comes, you will be in the lead. Be in the end and know that the last to come among the communities are the Muslims but they are in the lead: as the noble prophet has said: “Nahnu Aakhirun al saabiqun” (we are the last to come but we are in the leading position on the doomsday). Fruit on the tree comes at the last and it becomes the most highly priced one. This is because: it is for its sake that the tree is maintained and taken care of.

Like the angels who said: we have no knowledge (laa ilma lanaa), you may also say so to possess “allamtana” (except that what you have taught us) as stated in Quran, the angels had said: Subhaanaka la ilma lanaa illa ma allamtana (we have no knowledge except which you have taught us: (Baqara: 2: 32). Therefore, if a man keeps himself away from the worldly knowledge, he can get knowledge from God.

In the school of this knowledge, you do not know even the spellings. The noble Prophet also did not know. You also can fly above the light of hidden wisdom. If you are not well known in the cities, do not care for it. Do not think that you are lost, as God very well knows of proper guidance. Treasures are hidden in the ruins that are not well known. So also comforts are placed under pains.

sections.heading: Doubts Arise in Hearts: so Also Answers
paras: From this statement, one doubt arises, but a good horse smashes the boundary fence. Love sets fire to doubts, just as daylight brings to sight everything. Therefore, O thinking man, find out the answer for your doubts from the heart itself, because your doubts also originated from your heart. Corner of a cornerless heart is a highway, which is like the moon which has no east and west. You are like a beggar on this and that side. You are yourself the meaning of what you hear; and do not search for it here and there. Similarly, when you are in pain you call upon God and repeat: O my Lord! O my Lord! At the time of death and pain you do not get tired of turning toward Him and calling Him, and your pain gets reduced. Why do you become dumb and stop calling God, when the pain has ended. In moments of difficulties, you trace out His smell, and when difficulties go away, you say: where is the way. At the time of difficulties and sorrows, you think of Him, and upon their going away, you forget Him.

sections.heading: Exoteric and Esoteric Knowledge
paras: This is because, one who has understood God without doubts, continues to be upon it for ever. One who is behind the curtain in this matter finds God clearly visible to him and at times, and at times hidden, upon which he gets into great anxiety of love and tears his own clothes. Worldly external wisdom sometimes dominates and sometimes gets dominated. The perfect inner wisdom is completely cleansed of the doubts of wisdom coming accidently. Sell out your wisdom and knowledge and buy anxiety by getting informed of the scenes unbelievable to you and totally unbelievable for others. Go towards self-destruction and shamelessness and not towards Bukhara where there are men of great exoteric (apparent) knowledge and have great fame. If you go towards self-destruction you will be a man of Bukhara of quite a different esoteric (hidden) knowledge. The scholars of Bukhara do not understand this aspect of knowledge.

We have engaged ourselves in the world of discussions so much that we are telling stories after stories. I am sunk in the world of non-existence, that is, what is beyond space and time and their contents. I am telling stories in a crying mood like the female camel crying upon not finding its baby. I am doing this, so as to get mingled with those who have completely dived into the esoteric sciences and have lost their physical existence.

These are not just stories for the men of understanding. It is an explanation of the state of getting dissolved into the beloved God. The infidels of Arabia had called the Quran as nothing but the stories of the men of olden days. Asaatirul Awwalin: (Anaam: 6: 25). They took into consideration only the words of Quran and apparent meanings and looked it as a means of creating disunity.

sections.heading: Time, Space and Matter Are Relative
paras: Consideration of past and future is as per your calculation. They are the same, but you consider them to be different: one place is a roof far one, but a floor for another. One is someone’s father and someone’s son. There has to be seen some meaning within meaning. There is nothing with which to compare. The comparison can be only by way of new words and points to be replaced by old ones. As there is no coastlive for this ocean, do not think of keeping your goatskin to drag water. This is an ocean of the secrets of God, which has no coast. There is no end to this subject. Leave it at this, and go towards the story of the arrogant Phaeraoh, and know as to what he said.

chapters.title: Invitation to Magicians
chapters.subtitle: Phaeraoh’s despatching of announcers to invite Magicians

paras: After Musa left, Phaeraoh called for his advisers. They came and thought over, and every one of them gave this opinion. At least, his minister Haamaan, a mean worthless fellow offered his advice. As per the Quran, “The chief of Phaeraoh’s people said: Lo! This is some knowing wizard, who would expel you from your land. Now, what do you advise? They said: put him off for a while and also his brother, and send into the cities summoners to bring each knowing wizard” (Al-aaraf: 109, 110, 111)

Haamaan said: O victorious king, as it has become a cause of worry, magicians should be called for early. In our country there are many magicians, each one of them is a master in the art. It is reasonable that from all over Egypt they are called here by the king and officers of the realm organise them.

He dispatched men to bring the magicians from all around. To every well-known magician two messengers were sent. Two young men among them were very well known and their magic impacted even upon the moon. They used to draw milk from the lionesses and travel by seating themselves in earthen pots. They would make fabrics from moonlight and sell them instantly. After taking the fabrics to home the fabric would disappear and the purchaser would slap his own mouth in sorrow. There were hundreds of magicians like them, who were known to all the people. They heard that the king desired to seek their opinion as two beggars have come and dominated over the king and his palace. They do not have anything except a staff, which becomes a python on their command. The king and his army have become helpless. These two have put everybody in grief. Becoming a seeker of advice, the king has sent the messengers for the purpose that they may make designs to chase them out. The king would give them much rewards for that. Some magical powers should be shown to get rid of these two magicians.

When this message reached two well-known magicians, they feared at the thought as to how great they might be that the king’s army is afraid of them. They also had a feeling of love for such great magical powers that they had, which is a product of regard that professionals have for each other. When the nerves of professionalism started beating fast, they went into deep thinking, keeping their heads on their knees. It is also well known the sufis also keep their heads on their knees to concentrate. Knees give a magical relief in difficulties.

chapters.title: Magicians Visit to Their Father’s Grave
chapters.subtitle: Enquiries by the two magicians with their mother about the grave of their father to find out the reality of Musa from his spirit

paras: Thereafter, the two magicians went to their mother and asked her to guide them to the grave of their father. She took them to the grave and they sat there fasting for three days for the sake of the king. Thereafter, they said: O father, the king, out of fear, has given us a message that two men are troubling him, and destroying his honour before the armies. They do not have any arms and armies; but only a staff and its capacity is to cause turmoil. You have entered into the world of the truthful, even though you appear to be sleeping under mud. If what they do is magic, inform us of it or whether it is a divine act. Inform us so that so that we may fall in prostration and enlighten ourselves of their physical and chemical characteristics. We are desperate, give us some hope so that the sun may rise on dark night. So that we may come on right path and receive guidance. We are roaming about in ignorance. Show us your grace.”

chapters.title: Father’s Advice to Steal the Staff
chapters.subtitle: Answer of the dead magician to his children

paras: Their father told them in the dream: “O my children, it is impossible to express this matter in clarity. It is not in my control to speak out in the open. I do not have the permission to speak out clearly, but one secret is not hidden from sight. I shall give you a hint from which you can proceed further, so that you may know of the hidden affairs.”

“O the light of my eyes, when you go over there, find out the place where that magician sleeps. Take away his staff when he is in deep sleep, and thereafter forget all fears. If you steal his staff, it shows that he is a magician, and you know how to deal with magicians. If you cannot lift that staff, be sure, it is a divine matter: he is a prophet of God of Might and Glory and a guide. Even if Phaeraoh happens to collect all the countries from east to west, he will be defeated in the battle against God. You are my soul. What I have said is true and write it down upon your hearts that God alone knows the entire truth. O my souls, know this that when a magician goes to sleep, his magic tricks go off. This is because: when the shepherd goes to sleep, the wolf remains in peace as sleep brings to end all his efforts and capacities. But towards the animal, which is guarded by God, the wolf does not get a way. The magic that God does is true and right and calling it as magic is wrong. Know this: this is a clear sign, and if he dies or sleeps, God elevates him to higher levels.”

chapters.title: Magicians Meeting with Musa
chapters.subtitle: Comparison of Quran as Musa’s staff; comparison of Muhammad’s death as Musa’s sleep; Comparison of those trying to alter the Quran as the two magicians, who intended to steal Musa’s staff, when he was found asleep.

sections.heading: God’s Promises to Muhammad
paras: Grace of God gave a promise to Muhammad that even upon your death, this less on will not die. I am the protector of the Book and miracles and I oppose the one who adds to and deletes from the Quran. I raise you above in both the worlds. (Already: we have exalted your name: Wa rafa‘naa laka zikrak: (Inshrah: 94: 04). “I shall keep the rebels away from your words. Nobody can add to and delete from the Quran. Do not search for any other protector. The Quran says: there is none to alter the words of God: La Mubaddila Kalimati Allah: Al an‘am: 6: 34). I shall raise your charm day by day and get your name inscribed on gold and silver. I shall make the pulpit and niche for you. Because of my love for you, my wrath will become yours.

“They take your name in secret out of fear and performance of prayer also in secret. Now they take your name in secret and also say azan also in secret. Out of the fear of the accursed infidels, your religion gets hidden underground.

I shall take the minaret of your religion to the heights of skies and make the disobedient blind of both the eyes. Your servants will capture cities and authorities: your religion will reach from the depths of ocean to the heights of the moon. We shall keep it intact upto the doomsday; and Mustafa! Do not be worried of your religion getting lost. You are not magic. You are truthful and a co-disciple of Musa. Quran is similar to Musa’s staff, which swallowed infidelity like a python. Even when you are asleep under the mud, consider what all you say as Musa’s staff; which could not be stolen by the magicians when he was in sleep. Your enemies have no power to pick your staff. Do not be anxious; go to sleep, O prosperous one. Your light will reach upto the sky when you sleep which fixes the arrow in its bow to fight against your enemies. Whatever the philosophers and rationalists say from their mouths against you religion will be pierced by the arrows shot by the bow of your light.”

God did what all He said, and even more. Mustafa went to sleep and His prosperity and acceptability did not sleep. This is not so in the case of magicians. When they go to sleep; their acts get spoiled and obliterated. Both the magicians returned from the grave of their father and went fast to fight the hard battle of Egypt, declared by Musa. When they reached the capital city they searched for Musa and his residence. It happened that on that day, Musa was asleep under a date tree. People pointed towards the oasis to search for Musa there. When they reached, they found the one in sleep, who was awake for the world. Apparently both his eyes were shut, but both the imperium (‘arsh) and the earth were under his sight.

sections.heading: Awakened Heart and Sight
paras: Many with awakened eyes have sleeping hearts. Nothing can be seen by the physical eyes. One who has an awakened heart, upon shutting his eye, gets the sight of a hundred matters. Be careful to be awake if you are a man of heart by struggling constantly to get it. When your heart becomes awake, go to sleep with full contentment. There is no need to worry about six and seven skies and dimensions by arguments. Everything will be within your sight and clear. The Prophet said: ‘My eyes sleep but my heart does not sleep. No danger comes about, when the king is awake but the guards sleep’. But there is danger otherwise. Heart is like the king and the eyes are like the guards. Narration of the wakefulness of the heart cannot be explained even in thousands of long poems like my Math(s)navi.

sections.heading: Attempt to Steal Staff
paras: When the two magicians saw Musa carelessly sleeping with stretched feet, they decided to steal the staff. They thought of taking the staff from his back side. When they went a little nearer to the staff, it started moving. It started swivelling upon itself and both of them dried up in fear. Then it became a python and turned and attacked them and both of them began to run with pale faces. They were falling down on their faces and into and getting up from the pits on their way. It became certain to them that this staff has come from the heavens as they had seen the extremities of the magicians. Thus, if one learns magic to find out its difference from miracles, it is permissible; but if it is purely for magic itself, it is forbidden. It is good if it is learnt to differentiate between truth and falsehood, otherwise resorting to magic is totally forbidden.

After this, they got fever and loose motions, and they came very near to death. Then they sent a person to Musa to pardon them. We did this for testing your power, even though we did not have a right to do it. It was only due to our jealousy. They said: “we are criminals of the Emperor of the world. Please plead for us before God as you are close to Him than the closest. Forgive us: we have done a great wrong; as your grace and grants have no limits”. Musa pardoned them and they recovered, and they bowed down before Musa. Musa said: “I have pardoned you and honoured you. Hell is now prohibited from doing any harm to your body and soul”. He further said: “You are for me, my friends, project yourselves as though I have not seen you at all; and project yourself as though you are totally ignorant of me. Project yourself as dumb. Thus, you may be my friends in secret but enemies in appearance; and go before the king for battle against me. Collect what all the magic powers you have in you, both inner and outer, and project them against me”.

chapters.title: Musa and Phaeroah in Every Man
chapters.subtitle: Gathering of the magicians from the cities before Phaeraoh, getting honours and grants and beating of their chests with their own hands to impress that it is their duty to crush the enemy

paras: They kissed the ground in front of Phaeraoh and waited for the occasion of contest. The other magicians came before Phaeraoh and received many grants from him. They were given promises and advance payments: slaves, horses, cash, grains and food items. Then Phaeraoh addressed them: “O experts, if you succeed in the trail, I shall give you so many gifts that will tear off the curtains of generosity and charity.”

They told him: “With the prosperity that you have achieved, we shall certainly win and destroy Musa’s efforts. We are great competitors, and strong in this field and none in the world is of our competence.”

sections.heading: Musa and Phaeraoh Within Each Man
paras: The narration of Musa has become a subject of interest, because such events like his, have occurred earlier also. Musa’s story is only a pretext; actually the light of Musa is to be your objective. Musa and Phaeraoh do exist in you: and these two personalities have to be found out within yourself. The chain of Musa is to last till the doomsday. Light is not different but the same; only the source of light has changed. The earthen container of oil and the wick are different but the light is the same from all lamps. You will be misled if you keep your eyes on the glass surrounding the wick as the glass becomes a cause of its being different. This leads to duality. Glass only controls and spreads the light and it should not be considered by you as the real light. You should consider the light coming from the wick and then only your understanding will be perfect. It is the cause of the substance of existences in the universe that is understood differently by the people. This is the difference of understanding that makes one faithful; the others as fire worshippers and Jews.

chapters.title: Difficulty in Deciphering
chapters.subtitle: Disagreement on the body and shape of the elephant in a dark night Detachment from comfort leads to progress Noah’s calling to his son, his refusal saying, ‘I shall climb the hill and make my own plans and not take your obligation

paras: There was an elephant in a dark house, which was brought by the Hindus to be presented and kept for a long time. Many men came over to look at it; and everyone had gone to see him in the darkness. As there was no scope to see it by the eyes, they spread over their hands on its body. One man’s hand fell on its trunk and he said: ‘it is like a pipe’, one’s hand fell on the ear and he said ‘it is like a fan’, another’s hand fell on its leg and said: ‘it is like a pillar’. Another kept his hands on its back and said: ‘it is like a plank’. Thus, everyone considered the elephant to be like that part which was touched by him. And when each of them heard of an elephant, he thought it to be like what he had felt by touching. Their expression, as a result of it, became different: one called it as A and another as B. If every one of them had a lamp in his hand, the differences in their assessments would not have been there. The sense of seeing with the eyes is also like the palm of the hand. Both of them cannot see things in entirety. Ocean is different and so also its surf. Ignore the surf and directly look at the ocean. The surf is a product of the continuing attack of the waves of the sea, day and night, on the coast and you look at the surf instead of at the sea.

In similar manner we are attacking each other like the ships on the sea and while doing so we only look at them, but not at the sea. Thus, inspite of being on the sea, we do not look at the sea; it remains out of our mind. In similar manner, you are sleeping in the ship of your body and do not see the water, and even if you see water, you do not see the mover of water. There is a different water that puts the water of the sea in motion. Similarly, there is a soul that calls upon your soul.

sections.heading: Imperfect Notions About Matters
paras: Where were Musa and Jesus at the time when the sun had given water to the farmland of existences? Where were Adam and Eve at the time when God had shot the arrow of creation of the universe in the bow-like space. Even these examples are not perfect and all embracing. All these imperfect assessments are of this part of the world (of matter), but what God Himself has referred to as examples are true. If I speak of them, the steps of the ladder of your wisdom will slip down; and if I do not speak of them you will be at a greater loss. If I speak of them as a physical model, you will stick to that model as real. You stick to them in simple followership without trying to go from the model to the reality. Your feet are deeply attached to the earth like grass, which waves its head when the wind blows without efforts from itself. You do not have the feet of wisdom to move away from this blind followership, or if you have, you do not move them as you are accustomed to it. Of course, you cannot remove yourself from the mud, as your life itself is out of it and running away from it is very difficult.

sections.heading: Efforts to Pass Beyond Matter
paras: If you get real life from God, you will get rid of this earthly matter. Try to keep yourself away from earth and march towards the heart. You will get rid of those still attached to the earth and make yourself free. When a baby remaining attached to the wet nurse gets separated from her, he starts eating other foods.
