You are attached to the milk of the earth like seeds without which they cannot survive. But try to get the food of the heart and ignore the food of the development of the body. Take the food of wisdom, as wisdom is a hidden light; and you are not, on your own, capable of seeing this light behind the curtain: so that you may instantly see this light and see the hidden one in the open. So that you may move about in the sky without any means, just as you came into this existence without your own means. Not only that you have come, you have come unconscious. You do not know the way through which you came, but I shall speak about this secret path with an example.

Give up your sensual consciousness and then make yourself internally conscious. Close your ears to open the internal ears. I say that you are yet raw and immature in the spring season and you have not seen the summer.

This world is like a tree and we are all like tender fruits, attached to the branch very strongly, as immature fruits are not worthy of going to higher level of the king’s palace. When they ripen and become sweet and capable of sweetening the mouths, they give up their connection with the tree. Similarly when man’s progress becomes sweet, it does not see any warmth in the world. Hardness of feelings and extremity of thoughts are a defect of immaturity. So long as you were in the womb, you were only sucking blood. Your progress starts when you detach from womb.

sections.heading: Inner Information to You Through You Only
paras: There is another thing which I cannot speak to you about. This will be told to you by the Holy angel. No: rather you tell yourself to your own ears. At that moment you will not be you nor the other one would not the other. One will be rolled up with the other. Just as it happens in your dreams. When you walk, you alone walk with you and in front of you; and none else walks. In the dream someone says something to you. What he says are your own words. You talk your words to yourself but through someone else. You hear yourself and think that another has spoken to you of unknown things. You are the speaker and you are the hearer.

Know this my dear: you are not one; but you are a deep sea and the large sky. You look small but you are very large. Your personality has a personality nine hundred times larger than you. It is an ocean which is a place of the sinking of your hundred ships. There is nothing like wakefulness and sleep for getting the light of wisdom. Be quiet. Let there be no further talk on this, God alone knows best.
Let there be no talk of your own: -
—So as to hear from the knowers who can say in few words or elaborately;
—So as to hear from the sun all that cannot be written in book and said in lectures;
—So as to hear from the moon which calls upon you saying come and hear, O clean one;
—So as to hear the secrets of the states of the great saints, who speak out with a tongue that does not speak; and commands you to stand up till you get message from God.

—So that you spirit may tell you what has to be said that you should not speak of all that comes to you; but enter into Noah’s Ark for safety and guidance. And not like his son. Kan‘aan, who relied upon his own swimming capacity and said that he does not need any ship.

H. Noah warned and asked him to get in the ark so that he may not be drowned. He said: No I know swimming. I have lit another lamp and I do not need yours. Noah said: “Do not do so. This deluge is horrible. There is no scope for swimming. This is destructive and will put out all lamps, excepting the lamp of God”. He said: “I shall climb the lofty hill, which will protect me from all troubles”. Noah said: “Do not do this. At this time, a hill is a piece of grass. Excepting the friends of God, none will be safe”. He replied: “When have I taken your advice that I shall take this time? You think that I belong to your family. I do not appreciate your advice. I am disgusted of you.”

H. Noah entreated: “No my boy, do not be like this. This is not a day to please anybody. God has no companion and partners. He is eternal: He begetteth not, nor was He begotton: Lam yalid wa lam yulad (Ikhlas 112: 3). He does not have a father, son or uncle. When He has no reason to bear the coquetry of a son, where is He going to entreat the pleadings of the fathers? He will say: “I am not a son” and do not entreat me like the father. I am not a youth; do not show your pride before me. I am not a husband, nor do I have passions for women so as to bear their coquetry. Therefore, my son, do not do this dilly-dallying in this place. Nothing but submission and servitude and pleading of helplessness can be of use before Him.

Kan‘aan said: “Father: you have told me all this for years. Yet again in your foolishness you are going astray. You have told all this to many persons and they have not cared to respond to you. I have not cared to hear your effectless words; particularly now, when I am well grown and wise.”

Noah said: What loss is going to occur, if you hear your father’s advice at least once”. In this manner, Noah went on giving advice and the son continuingly rejected. Then the father got disgusted and no advice entered into his ear.

sections.heading: Bad Ones Are Not Relatives
paras: While they were still talking a large wave struck Kan‘aan’s head and it was smashed to pieces. Noah said to God: “O Great Majestic King, my donkey died and all my materials washed away. You have promised me many times that my family will be saved of the deluge. I have been having a hope on you, but how has this deluge taken away my son and my materials”. God said: “He was not among your household: Innahu laisa min ‘ahlika Innahu amalun ghair salihin (He is not one of your household. He is of evil conduct: (Huud: 11: 46). You have not differentiated between the white and blue. As your tooth was infected and giving pain, it is no more a tooth. It requires to be pulled out, so that the rest of the body may not suffer. Though, it is yours, yet discard it.

Noah said: “I am disgusted of all other things other than You, One who has lost himself in You cannot be another. You knew very well as to what I am with You. My relation with You is twenty times more than what a garden has for rain. I live for You; I am happy with You; I am entirely dependent upon You. I get my food from You without there being any intervention of other’s reasons. I am neither together with You nor away from You. You are perfect in every manner. And You do not have anyone similar to You, nor You are definable, nor You are caused. We are alive because of Your care and concern for us. You do not come within the consciousness of wisdom. You cannot be considered as the effect of cause. You alone had been my addressee, before and after this deluge. I talk to You not in my words but only through the words that You have given to me. You are the grantor of words now and also in the past.

sections.heading: Why Lovers Go to Hills and Ruins
paras: A lover in extremity of love talks day in and day out with hills and valleys and runs towards ruins. His talking to the hills and valleys and running towards ruins is not for them, but by addressing them, he addresses the beloved and in running towards ruins, he runs towards the loved ones. They do not reply to him, just as the loved ones do not. And also the ruins do not embrace, but frighten him, just as the beloved does. This similarity between these objects and the loved ones makes him go to them and talk to them. He sees in them a characteristic of the beloved.

I am thankful to You that with this deluge You have washed off the ruins, and I do not have them to go to You alone, because these ruins were bad and they never called me nor received me. I want such ruins which should echo back to my calls like hills, so that I may hear the repetition of Your name when I call. I am a lover of Your name that gives relief to the heart. Every prophet had befriended the hills to hear Your name being repeated.

sections.heading: Love of Creator, Not of the Object of Creation
paras: The hill that is lowly and like a stoney land is fit for the rats to live in and not for us. It does not respond to me when I give a call and remains soundless; and such a one cannot be my friend. (Similarly such non responsive men are not worthy of sitting with the noble people; and such lowly men should be allowed to lie at the low levels and statements of wisdom should not be told to them). It is better that such lowly stoney land is flattened as these are not to remain in responsive hilly tracks.

Then God told Noah: “If you so desire, I shall bring back to life from underneath the earth not only your son but all others. For the sake of one Kan‘aan, I shall not cause injury to your heart, but I inform you of certain facts”. Noah said: No, no my lord, I am agreeable even if you drown me if You so wish. You may drown me in every period of time. I shall be happy. Your order is full of life and I shall bear with it like my life. I do not look at anybody; and if I do so, it will be only a pretext as I look at it to look at you. I am a lover of all your acts. I shall bear them with patience and thanksgiving. I cannot but be a lover of what is done by You And not like an idol worshipper who loves the idol and not its maker. One who loves the creative capacity of God becomes honourable, and of the creature is a rejecter. The difference between these two groups is very little. This is understood by one who is keen and discriminative in understanding you.

chapters.title: Acceptance of God’s Actions in Good Faith
chapters.subtitle: Bringing together of these two hadiths: Agreeing with infidelity is infidelity (Al ridhaa’I kufri kufrun) One who does And not Agree with My decision, and does not show patience on trials by Me, may seek a lord other than Me. (Man Lam yardna biqadhaayi, wa lam yasbir alaa balaayi fal yatlib Rabban Siwaayi)

paras: Yesterday a person asked me a question, as he was in love with arguing on matters! He said: “the Prophet has said: Agreeing with infidelity is infidelity”. This statement of the Prophet is well settled and there cannot be an argument and doubt on it.”

Then again he said: “A muslim should be in agreement with every decision of God. Does it not mean that infidelity and hypocrisy are also decisions of God: and if I agree on that, how can I be wrong. If I do not agree with infidelity and hypocrisy I am at a loss, as I would be disagreeing with God. What is the solution for my problem in these contradictory situations?”

I told him: What you consider as infidelity is a product of a decision and not decision per se; what you consider as per se; and it like the impact of the decision. Consider the difference between a decision and its product to get rid of this difficulty. I agree with infidelity as having come from a decision of God and not as something that goes against God and comes out of man’s mischief. From the point of view of infidelity as a result of God’s decision, it is not infidelity, but from the point of view of the infidel’s accepting it, if is so. Do not go on extending the argument. God’s decision is an act of God. If the act of taking decision is considered as infidelity, God forbid, God will have to be considered as infidel. Infidelity is ignorance of realities, but the decision that infidelity is infidelity, is knowledge. Both cannot go together as forbearance and wrath cannot go together. Decision is a godly act and therefore its knowledge is the knowledge relating to the acts of God which is noble knowledge. But infidelity per se is vicious and therefore, the meaning of both these a hadith(s) is the same.

Bad handwriting is not a fault of the writer, but it is an exhibition of a bad quality by him. The former is his possession and the latter is exhibition. A painter has the ability to make both ugly and beautiful paintings. He cannot be blamed for making an ugly picture. He does so only to show mastery on this also.

If I go on citing more and more examples, it will become a very lengthy affair, and I shall be deprived of the taste of love and the marks of the service to God will become marks of the exhibition of argumentative abilities which usually dialecticians do and not those getting lost in God.

chapters.title: Love of God and Love of Debate
chapters.subtitle: An Example to show that wonderment ignores argument and thoughts

paras: A man with a few greying hairs in his beard came before a good-natured hairdresser and told him: “separate the grey hair from my beard as I have a new bride”. The hairdresser shaved of his entire beard, placed before him and said: “you may pick up the grey hair yourself, as I have to go on some other job.”

There was a demand and there was an answer in the form of an action. The demand was meaningless. There could not have been a better reply to it. It is like one who slapped a man’s face and the other one also did the same to him in revenge. The first fellow told the other fellow: “I shall ask you a question. You may first answer me and then slap me. When I gave a blow to your donkey there came a sound of the blow and in connection with this my question is whether this sound was a result of my blow or of your donkey’s own.”

The second man said: “I am yet to be relieved of the pain of your slap and this does not allow me to bother about all these questions. As you do not suffer any pain you are thinking of all this. Those in pain do not engage themselves in such thoughts. Those in pain do not think of others, whether they are in a mosque or in a temple of idols. Your carefreeness and painlessness makes you think of all this and you go on searching for new and newer questions. Those who have the pain of faith have only sorrows of faith and engage themselves in the affairs of the faith; and those others engage themselves in hollow, meaningless, time-passing logic and verbalism. They find out the man clearly even when he is hidden in the midst of dust. They keep the command of God on their heads and before the faces and try to protect their thoughts with the commands and keep themselves in pondering over the meanings and demands of the commands.

chapters.title: Memorising of the Quraan
chapters.subtitle: A Narrative

paras: There were only a few companions of the Prophets who had learnt the entire Quraan by heart, even though they had a great desire to do so (They were only four: Ubbi b Ka’ab, Muaaz b Jabal, Zaid b Th(s)abit and Abu Zaid). They were fully aware of the spirit and meaning of Quran and had little importance for verbalism. They were like ripening fruits, which when fully ripe weaken their rinds and tear them off. The rinds of fruits like apricots, almonds and pistachios also become thinner as their contents go on increasing in size. As the contents increase the rind becomes thinner.

Similarly, when the contents and spirit of the knowledge increase in a man, his external appearance becomes lesser in importance. Men of knowledge do not care for words, expressions and showy aspects. Just as a lover is burnt down to nothingness of knowledge. Lover and the beloved are two opposites. Character of the searcher is the opposite of the searched one. So long as this duality continues, true love does not come about. Revelation and the lightning of the light of God burnt down the Prophet. Duality of the revelation and receiver of revelation vanished. When revelation showed its light, qualities prior to it were burnt down. Words of revelation destroyed the human qualities. The noble companions used to be in the efforts to observe God through the revealed statements, meanings and spirit of the Quraan and always engrossed in them. [They could not put effort to learn it by heart, as it would be a physical, mechanical, rote work of certain organs of the body as against absorption of the meaning and spirit.] Whoever had learnt a quarter of the Quran by heart, used to be considered as one who had gone ahead of others.

sections.heading: Words and Spirits Cannot Go Together
paras: Keeping the learnt-by-heart words and the meaning and spirit together is impossible for anyone other than an extraordinary genius. Observance of God would elate them and overwhelm them to such an extent that maintaining of formal conduct would not go with it. Yet if it is maintained, it is a wondrous affair. Maintenance of formalities of devotion and the state of elation is like bringing together of opposites like bringing together spherical and elongated bodies. Devotion to the beloved and the beloved’s showing no concern for devotion are two opposites. As devotion increases and goes nearer, concern of the beloved goes farther and farther away and this continues. And in particular, when one is in a state of wonderment and awe due to some revelation of the beloved’s beauty, it becomes all the more difficult. Yet the companions had the extraordinary capacity to keep the difference and distance between the Master and servant.

sections.heading: Grades of Memorisers
paras: Learning by heart the Quran without knowing its meaning and connotation is like the holding of a stick by the blind man. Such a haafiz of the Quran is box in which the Quran is kept safe, as the box knows nothing of its meanings and directions. It is said that the blind men are like the box containing the words, explanations and meanings of the Quraan. Yet this box is better than an empty box at hand. So also the hafizs or huffaaz are better than others. Again it is said that the empty box is better than a box full of rats and snakes. That is to say: those who have no words of Quran in them are better than those who have mischievous and unlawful beliefs.

sections.heading: No Guide Needed at Destination
paras: A man who has reached his object, does not need a guide. Therefore, your searching for more knowledge is also useless. When you have reached upon the sky, there is no need for you to have a ladder or handrail. Excepting for the support and teaching of others, there is no need for others when one has already attained goodness. Trying to polish a mirror which is clean and bright serves no purpose. Searching for a writer and carrier while sitting honourably with the king is meaningless.

chapters.title: True Love Does Not Change with Time
chapters.subtitle: Story of the lover who read the love letter written to the beloved in the beloved’s very presence and the beloved’s disliking it telling: Seeking of arguments when the object of argument is very much present is bad; and keeping busy to seek knowledge, when it is already attained is condemnable Need is the First stage of Achievement

paras: One’s beloved seated the lover in front of her and the lover took out the love letter which he had written once and started reading it. The letter contained verses, praises, adorations, narrations of his sorrows, helplessness; and much flattery for her. There were narrations of his grief, complaints, pains, sorrows, lack of honour, disgustion with his friends; and also of distance and separation resulting in sickness; and of the messages and messengers sent by him and so on. He went on reading all this to his beloved so much that it went beyond the limits.

The beloved said: “if all this is for me, it amounts to wasting of life when you are already in nearness. I am very much present before you and you are narrating stories. This is not a mark of your love.”

sections.heading: Levels of States
paras: The lover said: “Of course, you are present here, but I am not getting my full share. What I had seen in you earlier is not found in this presence. I have taken a drink of fresh water from your fount and refreshed my heart and eyes. Now I am seeing the fountain, but there is no water in it. I feel, perhaps, a dacoit has taken away the source of water”.

The beloved said: “In that case, I am no longer your beloved. I am in the city of Bulgaria and your object is in the far off city of Qutu. You are not in love with my entirety but only with a part of mine. I am not the beloved but the home of the beloved. Your love is with the money in the box and not with the box. A beloved is one who is always in the same condition and is the beginning and end of the lover. When you have attained her, you should not wait anymore. The beloved should be the same in appearance and in non-appearance. Beauty of temporary things must not be one’s object but of the everlasting Creator. He commands the states and is not commanded by them. He should consider that passing of months and years as the slave of the moonlike face of his beloved and not the moon itself in the sky. He should be such that if he gives a command, states should obey him and upon his desire, bodies should become spirits. State means a situation that comes upon the heart like its expansion to know many things, or constriction to put an end to all channels of knowledge and the enthusiasm to know, and enjoyment of that knowledge. This situation vanishes when sensory knowledge comes back. But one who gets annihilated in God retains this and dominates over them. One who is subordinated to states is not perfect. One who is perfect feels pleasure in death and pains.

“He never stays at one level and always searches for better states. His hand is like the alchemy for the states. If he waves his hands, copper starts obeying him. If he so desires, death becomes sweet, and thorns become flowers. One who considers the states to be the end and objects, becomes obedient to states and gets dominated by human qualities and loses the elevated state. The dominant over the state is like a king upon the states and not like you, as you are deprived of states and their attractions. One dominated by a state is at times in deficiency and at times in excess. Man’s beginning and end are by God alone. The Quran says: Allahu Yabdaul khalqa, summa yu’iduhu, summa ilaihi turja ‘una. (Allah produces creation, then He reproduces it and then unto Him you will be returned: (Rum: 30: 11). Do not wait upon anyone after meeting Him, because He is Evident and dominant: Huwazzaahiru wal baatinu (Hadiid: 57: 3)

sections.heading: Difference Between Sufi and Safi
paras: Sufi is a product or child of time; but the Saafi is the creator or father of time. Saafi is not impacted by his states whereas sufi cannot and does not control the impact of the state and therefore, many a times marvels and unnatural event come out of his state. But, the states are under the control of Saafi and are under his will and choice, and these are alive, as if influenced by the blow of the breath of Jesus, he does not allow marvels and unnatural events to be caused by him as he considers them to be opposed to the tradition of God. This is the difference between Sufi, the creature or child of time (Ibnul-Waqt) and Saafi the creator or father of time (Abul Waqt).

sections.heading: Love Should Be Full, Not Piecemeal
paras: The beloved told the lover: You are not in love with me but with a state of mine. You inclined towards me in the hope of my state, which is at times perfect and at times not: such an imperfect thing is not a beloved of Ibrahim Khaleelullah, who had seen stars, moon and sun bright at one time and then set at another time. Such things cannot be loved ones as H. Ibrahim said in the Quraan La Uhibbu al aafilin (I do not love those that set: (An‘aam: 6: 76).

One who is happy at one time and unhappy at another is like water at a time and fire at another. It is not the moon but the zodiacal constellation. He is a model of the idol which knows nothing. As the Sufi, though of very high level is a child of the time, he holds on tightly to the hand of his father — time is like a father for him. [When time ceases or passes away, time is no longer useful to him, he also gets lost]. But Saafi is sunk in the depths of the love of the “Face of the Lord full of majesty, Bounty and honour: Zul Jalaali wa al Ikraam (Al Rahman: 55: 27) and he is no body’s son. And does not depend upon times and states. He is sunk deep in the light of the one who is not born and whose grandeur is: He begetteth not nor He is begotten: Lam Yalid wa lam yuulad: (Ikhlaas: 112: 3)

Go and search for such a love if you are alive, or otherwise, you will be a slave of different times. Do not look at the good and bad of yourself; but look at your love and at your loved one. Do not consider yourself to be worthless and weak, but look at your potentialities. When you are thirsty with dried lips, search for water; and similarly go on in search of some object. Dry lips are evidence of the fact that ultimately they will reach the fountain. Dryness of the lips, is in fact, a message and invitation of water which thinks that it will certainly bring you toward it. The need of water brings prosperity to you and puts you into action and creates a situation which puts an end to all obstacles. This demand is the key to meet your needs. It is your marching flag and the army to support you. It is like the loud crowing of the cock, which indicates that sun is about to rise. Go on demanding even if you do not have the means, as there is no need of means in the path of God. Join him when you see someone is putting a demand and become obedient to him. Become one demanding like him, as the company of those in search makes you also search; and you will also dominate along with them under their shadow.

If an ant goes in search of Solomon, do not look at it with contempt; as whatever material wealth you have, initially started with your humble desire and struggle. It is very strange that one may get a treasure, though it may not be impossible. Yet one will be certainly at loss if one stops search and demands. Whoever went in search of a thing and worked hard for it, got it. The moment you started your efforts, it means that you got your object. Your starting is beginning of the reaching of the object. Do not even remain without putting efforts thinking that you will get your object without efforts. One who searches, gets it, as he runs towards the object and be fast in the efforts. This much I said: and God alone knows the best.

chapters.title: Sustenance Without Work
chapters.subtitle: Story of a man during the days of David entreating to God, day and night, to give him provisions without pains and efforts

paras: There was a man in the days of Prophet David, who in the presence of every wise man and fool, always used to pray to God: “O God grant me wealth without efforts and work. You have made me idle, weak, useless and crippled. People do not keep heavy loads to be carried by horses and camels on the back of a weak worthless donkey. You do not require to be told anything; but You know that You have made me idle and therefore give my provisions through my idleness. I have slept under the cool shade for all my life, under the shade of Your excellences and graces. Perhaps You have kept a different kind of promise for the idle and for those who sleep under the shade. One who has feet, uses them to earn his bread and one who does not have, requires to be shown benevolence by You. Send his provision to him and let the clouds fall upon him from all directions. As earth has no feet, Your grace sends clouds upon clouds towards it. As a child has no feet to walk, his mother goes to him, provides food regularly without taking any recompense. I want my food without any efforts as I have no interest in putting efforts except by way of entreating to You.”

sections.heading: David Worked to Earn Bread
paras: In this manner that fellow went on supplicating to God for a long time from morning to night and the whole night. People laughed at his talks and his meaningless greed and continuously saying: “what wonderful thing that this fool talk’s of. May be someone has addicted him of marijuana. The means of getting food is through hard work in a profession and getting tired with it. And the same without efforts is very strange and has never occurred. God has provided a job to everyone as a means and this is through hard work and efforts. Food has to be sought through its means; and entry to cities is through the gates.

“In the present days, David is a king and prophet of God: and he is a professional prophet. Wild animals and birds are under his command and he has authority all over the world. He has got such honour and reputation before God: and he is chosen for extraordinary grace. He has innumerable miracles and the waves of the grants of God flow upon him. From the days of Adam to this day, there was never one with such sweet appealing voice as he has. Hearing his sermons two hundred men die in excitement. Man gets killed by sweet voice. Lions and deer come together to hear him, without caring for their dangers. Hills and deserts join him in chorus along with his voice and share his secrets. These and many more miracles he has. The light of his face is in layers upon layers and shows itself time by time and on all sides.

“In spite of all these grants, God has connected his food with efforts. Without making coat of mail, and working hard for it, his provisions do not meet him. Yet this degraded, worthless, mean fellow, discarded by his family and accursed of the sky, desires to get a treasure of such volume that his feet should be stuck in it. With his foolishness he wants to gain profit without undergoing any pains and carrying on a profession. There is no such fool who would desire to climb the sky without ladder.”
Someone would tease him saying take this, your provisions have arrived, and your saviour has come. Another would laugh: O rich man, give something to us out of what you would obtain.

Inspite of all these condemnations and pricks he would not tire and go on making his supplications and entreaties. He attained full publicity in the city that he was a fool who searches for cheese in empty bag. He became an example of beggary, greed, idleness, yet he would not desist from his entreaties. He did not reduce his supplications in humility. At last the Helpful God of majesty and grandeur heard his prayers.

chapters.title: Differences in Men and Groups
chapters.subtitle: Entry of a cow into the house of the supplicatory in humility. Statement of Prophet Mohammed: “God loves those who supplicate in humility”; for the reason that humility is loved by God: and one’s humility is better than what one seeks. And Rumi’s seeking of pardons and help

paras: Atlast, one day in the morning hours, when he was as usual praying, all of a sudden a cow came running unlatched the house door, broke it open and entered into the house, and that man suddenly pounced upon it and tied its hind and front legs. Immediately he slaughtered it, without any hesitation. After separating its head, he went to the butcher to get its hide skinned out.

sections.heading: Everyone Supplicates Without Adopting Means
paras: Know this: I am also demanding like a child in the womb from within, for the completion of this Math(s)navi. I also supplicate to him in similar manner to make the writing of Math(s)navi easy for me to do, guide and support me, or give up your demand for its completion and remove the burden from me. When you can demand money from a poor man, You being a king and having no concern for anything, You as well grant money to him to meet Your demand. Without your support, no poem can be written and no beginning and end can come about like mornings and evenings, nor any verses be written. Poems and versus, rhymes and rhythms your slaves and are obedient and fearful of You.

sections.heading: Predestination and Free Will
paras: You have made everyone to recite your praises, whether he has consciousness or not. The praises of everyone are different from those of others, and they are all unaware of what they are doing. Man refuses to believe that minerals also recite your names, even though minerals are expert in praises and perfect in worship. Rather out of seventy two groups, every group is unaware of the others. Each of them considers itself to be on the right path and the rest are not. When two talkative persons are ignorant of the state of each other, what can they know about the non talking doors and walls. When I am unaware of the praises made by a speaker, how can I know of the praises made by the non- talkative materials. The Sunni (free willer) has a special praise of God, but the same by a believer of pre-destination is different. The sunni is unaware of the praises made by the predestinarians, and he of the sunni. He says that the other fellow is misguided and confused. He is unaware of his own state and of the command of “Qum” (Get up). The command of “Qum” clearly shows that man is ordered to get up: which means he has the free will to get up.

He does not know that God has created quarrels between them on the question of predestination and free will. The former telling that man has no power and all his actions are already determined by God, the latter telling: no, no, man is empowered. He has a free will and he can do whatever he pleases to do. God has clearly exhibited the inner worth of everyone and specifically of the living and the non-living (and the species from the genera).

sections.heading: Mercy in Wrath and Wrath in Mercy
paras: Everyone, whether wise or not, or a mean fellow considers wrath as different from mercy. But, is not aware of the mercy hidden in wrath and the wrath hidden in mercy. This cannot be understood by anyone other than a Godly person who has the capacity to differentiate in his soul. The rest of the people suspect both of them and fly towards their nest with only one wing, the other wing being lost.

chapters.title: Confidence in Knowledge Strengthens
chapters.subtitle: To explain that knowledge has two wings and suspicion only one

paras: Knowledge has two wings and suspicion only one. Suspicion is defective in flying as it has got its tail cut off. A bird with one wing falls down instantly or just after one or two lengths of steps. The bird with suspicion moves and falls down and moves, with one wing to reach its nest. When it gets rid of its suspicion, its knowledge becomes clear and it becomes one with two wings. Then it moves upright as stated in Quran: yamshi sawiyyan alaa siratin mustaqim: (he walks upright on a beaten path: (Mulk: 67: 22); and not one who goes groping on his face in sickness; as stated (yamshi mukibban alaa wajhihi): (Mulk 67: 22)

He flies on two wings like Jibra’iil, without any suspicion, anxiety, questioning and enquiring. If the entire world says: you alone are on the right path of God, he does not get excited, and his soul does not get lured by it. And if they all say: “you are on the wrong path; you consider yourself hard and large like a mountain, but you are just a piece of grass”, he does not get into doubts at their taunts and also he does not feel grieved. Even if oceans and mountains tell him so, he will not get a particle’s worth of doubt nor feel grieved. He is quite contented, confident and without excuses. He remains so in all situations.

chapters.title: Suspicions Increase with Repetition
chapters.subtitle: A man’s falling sick due to suspicions upon the honours shown by admirers and common people and getting inclined towards them. Story of a children’s teacher

paras: Students of a class were disgusted of the tiresomeness and hard work imposed by the teacher. They consulted to avoid this by putting the teacher in worries. They thought as to why he does not fall sick so that they might be free of him for some days. This fellow is settled like a hard rock. One more intelligent fellow said: I have a plan. I shall ask the teacher as to how he has turned pale. May God help you. Your colour is disturbed. It may be due to effect of wind or fever. With this he will fall in a little suspicion; and you may help me in this regard. When you enter the class tell the teacher: May God help you. How is your health. This will increase his suspicion a little more. It should be known that suspicions make a man mad. The third of you, the fourth and fifth should express your sorrow and even cry over. When thirty children say this one after another, this suspicion will develop deeper roots.

All the students appreciated this design and prayed for his success on this. All of them took an oath that none would betray so that none may be a tale-bearer. The proposer was wiser than others and he was in the forefront of the lot. This is the difference between the wisdom of the people just as there are differences between the faces of the loved ones.

chapters.title: Wisdom Is Different in Different Persons
chapters.subtitle: To explain that wisdom and instinct of the people are different. But Mu‘tazilites say: No, it is the same; And that, difference in wisdom is due to knowledge and experience. The Prophet has said: Beauty of man is in the fluency of his tongue

paras: In connection with this, Prophet Muhammed has said that the beauty of men is hidden in their tongues. Difference in wisdom is from the beginning itself. This is as what the sunnis consider which is different from what the Mutazila say, that wisdom of all is the same. Learning, teaching and experience bring about differences in wisdom and some become wiser than others. This assessment is wrong, as the wisdom of a boy who does not belong to any school of thought gives opinions which are better than those of the learned and experienced, and their jobs meet failure in times of difficulties.

The young boy made a suggestion which could not even be smelled by a hundred experienced old men. The excess of wisdom that is given over to one by nature is better than what comes about by thinking, study and efforts. You may tell me which is better: what is given by God or given by that lame fellow who makes efforts to run like a fast horse.

chapters.title: Repeated Follies Become Reasonable
chapters.subtitle: Putting in doubt of the teacher by the pupils

paras: The day arrived and all the boys left for the school as per their plan. They all stood outside waiting for the proposer of mischief to come. This they did because he was the fountain head of their designs. One’s head always leads, and the feet follow it. Those who have to follow should not precede the leader, as he is the bearer of the light from sky.

That boy came, saluted the teacher and said: “May God bless you; your face is giving a pale appearance”. The teacher said: “I do not have anything wrong. Go inside and sit down. Do not talk nonsense”. The teacher rejected the boy’s comment, but a little of the wrong idea took a place in his heart. The next boy came inside and said the same. This increased his suspicion. And when all of them said the same the suspicion got strengthened and the teacher was caught in mental anxiety.

chapters.title: Suspicions Cause Phobia
chapters.subtitle: Falling sick of Phaeraoh the people’s honouring

paras: The prostrations before him of women, children and men made Phaeraoh’s heart sick. When everyone called him as a master and king, a consequent suspicion of greatness destroyed him to such an extent that he claimed Godhood for himself. He became a python and his stomach never got filled.

Suspicions and doubts are a menace for the immature wisdoms, as they originate in darkness. Where there is even half a meter wide path on the land, a man walks over it boldly without any doubt. But on a high wall of the double of its width, he feels uneasy as his heart shivers with a suspicion that he may fall down. Therefore, use your wisdom to know of doubts and suspicions to be safe.

chapters.title: Suspicions Increase with Time
chapters.subtitle: Teacher becoming sick due to suspicions

paras: The teacher felt himself very tired out of his suspicion and fear and he decided to lie down under a blanket. He got angry with his wife that she has very much reduced love. I am in such difficulties and she never spoke to me of it. She did not inform me of my pale face. She has an intention to get rid of me. She is intoxicated in the observance of her own beauty and appearance ignoring the fact that my life is in great danger.

He came over and roughly pushed the door and the children followed him. His wife asked him: “What is the matter; you have come so early. May God protect you and no trouble may come on you”. And he said: “You are blind. Look at my colour and condition. Others are crying upon my pains. But, you are comfortably settled at home, due to your hypocrisy and ill feeling for me. You do not look at my condition.”

His wife said: “My dear, you do not have any sickness. Your doubts, suspicions and anxieties are baseless.” Then he retorted”: You are foolish: you want to quarrel with me. You do not see the change in me and my shivering. What can I do if you have gone deaf and blind. I am in such misery, pain and frustration”. She said: “I shall bring the mirror for you so that you may know that I am not wrong.” Then he said: “Go away! What are you and what is your mirror. You are always full of contempt, mischief and ill will. Do spread out my bed so that I may lie down. I feel giddy”. “For not being instant in doing so, he shouted at his wife: “O enemy of mine. Be fast.”

chapters.title: Pretentions Become Real
chapters.subtitle: Teacher’s lying in suspicion of sickness and crying

paras: His wife brought the bedding and spread for him. It was not possible for her to say anything. She thought: “If I say something he will make accusations on me; and if I keep quiet, this imagination will become real. Wrong prediction makes one sick even if there is no cause of pain. The Prophet has said: ‘Imaginations become acceptable. If you pretend to be sick before us, you will fall sick’. If I say something, he will misunderstand and say: “she has to attend to some other job and she wants to be away from me. She is thinking of chasing me out of the house. She is planning to do some wrong”.

The teacher laid himself on the bed and started crying, sighing and groaning. His students sat nearby and started learning their lessons in slow voice as though in great sorrow. They thought we did all this and got confined in his house. We laid the foundation of an ill-conceived building. We should be careful. We should make another design so as to get rid of this trouble fast.

chapters.title: Loud Sounds Increase Sickness
chapters.subtitle: Putting another suspicion in the teacher’s mind by the students that recitation of Quran creates headache and increases it

paras: That intelligent boy said: “Friends, revise your lessons and read loudly”. When they started like this, he told them: “Our loud voice is causing trouble to the teacher. Loud noise increases the headache of the teacher. Is it right that for the sake of a little money we are paying as fee to the teacher every month the teacher should suffer?

chapters.title: Suspicions of Others
chapters.subtitle: Boys getting relief from lessons, going to their houses and questioning by their mothers

paras: Hearing this the teacher said: “What he says is right. My headache has increased. All of you may go out. The boys bowed to him saying: May God give you relief of your sickness and fear. And they ran towards their homes like birds flying in search of food. Their mothers got angry and said: “It is a school day today, and you are in play. This is a time to learn, and you ran away from the books and the teacher”.

They said to their mothers to wait for a while and hear. This is not due to their negligence and wrong. There is no mistake on their part. As per the decision of the heaven, our teacher is under pain, sickness and anxiety.

Their mothers said: “There is some falsehood and treachery. You tell a hundred lies in your greed for butter milk. We shall go to the teacher tomorrow so as to know the reality of your tricks. The boys said: May God be pleased with you. You may proceed and know as to what is right and what is wrong?”

chapters.title: Pain Not Felt in Deep Engagements
chapters.subtitle: Visit of the children’s mothers to the teacher to enquire about his health

paras: Next morning their mothers went to the teacher’s house from all directions. The teacher was sleeping like a terribly sick person, with his forehead tied strongly with cloth just as women do. Because of being in many blankets, his entire body was sweating. He had hidden his face under the blanket. He was continuingly groaning so much that everyone felt disgusted. They said: “how are you sir? We swear upon your life we had no news about your sickness. Our children have told us about this”. The teacher said: “I was so busy in teaching and learning that I did not know that I have such serious illness. When a man becomes fully concentrated in some job, he becomes blind to see his troubles. The story of the women of Egypt is famous, as they were so much engrossed in observing Yusuf that they could not feel the pain of their fingers being cut instead of the apples. This is because the soul of a lover looks at what is in front of him and not that behind. It so happens that brave soldiers in the battlefield get injured in their hands and feet, yet they continue to fight with the injured hand under the impression that it is alright. They do not look at the injury and much blood flows down from their veins.”

chapters.title: Soul Has Different Limbs
chapters.subtitle: To explain that body is like the apparel of the soul, hands are like its sleeves and the feet as its shoes

paras: Hear this that the body is like an apparel of the soul. Go in search of the wearer and not the apparel to and stick on to it. Soul is more interested in God for which it has different limbs. Soul has different kinds of limbs as against the apparent ones of the body. What you see as limbs in your dream are only their models and not real. Think over this, and do not consider what I said as meaning less. So also you have a different body than the one that you have. Therefore, do not be afraid of your soul getting out of your body. Soul has many other jobs to do than merely protect the body; and after getting rid of the body, it has many more jobs to do. Your soul is much disturbed in your body just as a bird is in a cage. Wait till your bird of soul gets out of the cage of your body so that you may see the seven heavens obedient to it. In order to make it clear, I shall narrate a story so that you may get informed of the truth and reality; and fall in love with them.

chapters.title: Think Well Before You Act
chapters.subtitle: Narrative of a Great man who settled in the hills: Pleasures and excellences of Seclusion and God’s saying: I sit with him who thinks of me; and I am friend of him who loves me

paras: “If you are with everybody but not with me, you are with no body. And if you are not with others, but only with me, then you are with all.”

A dervish had made a hillock as his home living throughout in seclusion. This was because he was getting pure northern air from God, as he was disgusted with the breaths of men and women. Just as settling in our place is easy for us, likewise for some others travelling is easy. Just as you crave for dominance and leadership, a blacksmith, is in love with himself. Everyone has been made for a purpose: and inclination towards it is put into his heart. (this has been said by the Prophet: kullun muyassaran limaa khuliqa lahu: for everyone, that work is easy for which he has been created). Hands and feet do not move without an inclination for it. How can dust and rubbish wash off with water and air unless they are blown. If you find your inclination toward the sky, open up your wings of fortune for flight like the phoenix. And if, it is toward earth, cry and do not remain without crying even for a moment. Wisemen cry before action and fools after action. Think of the end before starting any work so that you may not feel ashamed on the doomsday.

chapters.title: Think of Results Before Action
chapters.subtitle: Goldsmith’s seeing the end of the borrower of balance and speaking to him well before giving

paras: A person came to a goldsmith seeking his weighing balance for weighing gold. He said: “Please, I do not have a sieve”. He said: “I am asking for the balance. Give that to me and do not be funny”. The goldsmith said: “I do not have a broom in my shop”. And the other man said: “You are making fun of me. I am asking for balance; give it to me. Do not pretend like a deaf”. The goldsmith said: “I have heard you. I am not deaf. Do not at all think I am senseless”.

I have heard what you said: “Your hands shiver because of old age and your body cannot rise up with ease. I thought you are a weak elderly man, and your hands constantly shiver. Your gold is not solid but scrapings and slices. When your hand shivers, your gold scrappings fall down. Then, you will ask me for a broom so as to collect gold from the mud and dust. After collecting dust, you will ask me for a sieve so as to sieve gold scrappings from mud; and I do not have a sieve in my shop. I have seen the end even before the act. Please go away somewhere else. Goodbye”.

One who looks only at the beginning only is blind, and the one who sees the end is sufficiently wise. One who sees the end in the beginning never feels ashamed. As the ultimate end is the final judgement, seclusion and living in poverty is better than kingship. Well-guided persons look at the end. And be sure to know that God knows the best about guidance. This talk has no end, speak of the secret of that pious dervish. Narrate the story of that exceptional elderly man, whose food, drinks and subsistence were in the hillock.

chapters.title: Think of Results Before Action
chapters.subtitle: Remaining story of that elderly man in the hillock who had taken a vow not to pluck a fruit from the tree; and will not shake the tree to fell fruit, nor would tell anyone to shake the tree in clear words or in gestures; and shall eat the fruit that falls on its own.

paras: In and around the hillock there were many trees laden with fruits —apples, pomegranates and guavas. These were the food of the dervish and these apart, he would not eat anything else. He said: O God, I take an oath upon your name that I shall never pluck a fruit from the trees, nor I shall ask anyone to pluck for me. I shall rely upon only that fruit that falls on its own.

This was followed for a long time, when at last, God wished otherwise, and he was put into trial. That is why; it has been ordained by God that you should always see exceptions saying ‘except what God wishes’ by saying: Inshaa’a Allah (if God wishes). “This is for the reason that the decision upon everything is dependent upon My wish and all authority is subordinate to mine. [A Hadith(s) says: Hearts of all the people are between two fingers of God in such a way that he alters them as and when He wishes.] I always put in a different desire in the hearts, and I put a mark on the heart at every breath. Every morning, I am in a different glory. Nothing can go against My decision.

Another Hadith(s) days that heart is like a feather, which is bound by the winds in a field. Wind takes the feather in different directions in hundreds of ways: sometime towards the right and sometimes towards the left.

Another Hadith(s) says that the heart is like boiling water in a vessel. Every moment, heart is in a different condition, but this is not on its own, but from somewhere else. Then, why do you remain satisfied with the heart’s desire. You make a determination now and feel ashamed later. This is the result of the impacts of God’s command and predestination. This is also as per God’s wish that you see a well that but you are not afraid of falling in it. It is not strange that a flying bird does not see the net and gets trapped. The strange thing is that it sees the net and also the pegs holding the net, yet gets trapped. Eyes are open, ears are open, and the net is in front of it, yet it flies with its own wings toward the net.

chapters.title: Invisible Shackles
chapters.subtitle: Example of the trap of God, which is invisible but puts its impacts

paras: Look at a rich man’s son wearing the woollen garments of the faqirs, with no head gear, and fallen in difficulties. He fell in love with a woman and got his life spoiled and has sold out all his movable and immovable properties. He has fallen into disgrace in his own community. Everyone would tease him and injure his heart for which there was no ointment of any kind to cure. All his family connections are lost, he is ill famed and lowered in status; and bound to follow what an ignoble enemy would desire. When he sees a great man, he says: Please for the sake of God, have pity on me that I am caught in these miseries having lost all my possessions. Please do something for me that I may get rid of these troubles, and possibly get freed from this black fate. He used to entreat like this with all and sundry, so as to get a little relief thereby for a while.

His hands were free and so also his feet; he was not in any prison; and there was no prison guard upon him, nor any shackles upon him. Which are the shackles from which to free yourself and the prison from which you want to be released.

The shackles and prison are invisible and hidden, which cannot be seen by anyone other than a man of clean heart. Though they are invisible and hidden, yet they are worse than iron shackles and prisons. The iron shackles can be cut and broken by a blacksmith and the walls of the prisons can be smashed. It is strange that these iron shackles are such that they cannot be cut and broken by any blacksmith.

Nobody could see these invisible prisons and shackles except, Muhammed, who saw a rope of palm-fabric tied around her neck. Hablun min masad: (Surah Lahab: 111: 5). He saw the wife of Abu Lahab, Umme Jameel, carrying a bundle of firewood along her waist and got called as Hamma latal Hatab(ibid).

The rope and bundle of firewood were not seen by anyone other than his eyes for which every hidden thing is visible. All others than him have interpreted the bundle of firewood as the burden of sin and the rope as the shackles of the hell. These things can be visible when one gets rid of sensory powers.

But the rich man’s son has got his back broken by the invisible troubles and he is crying before others to seek relief. So that, with their blessings he may get freed from the shackles. One who can see these signs in clarity, cannot remain without seeing the fortunate and unfortunate. He knows very well and hides them with the command of the God of majesty and grandeur, as it is not proper to speak of the secrets of God. There is no end to this discussion. And let me say that, that faqir had become weak due to hunger and got imprisoned.

chapters.title: Breach of Vow
chapters.subtitle: The faqir’s getting impatient with hunger and plucking a guava fruit and God’s instant reprimand upon him

paras: For five days no guava fruit fell of its own and his patience was running away from him due to hunger. He saw a few fruits on a branch, yet he remained patient and controlled himself. Wind blew and the branch came down and his hunger dominated and compelled him to eat. Hunger, weakness and the natural power dominated and compelled the pious man to break his vow. Then he plucked a fruit, and he became weak in his determination and promise. Instantly there was a reprimand from God, which opened his eyes and ears.

The sincere and pious are always in great danger. There are many trials in their path. My dear, you should always keep your promises so that you may not fall into shame and troubles. Or do not make any promise which you cannot fulfil, or you should wait till God makes you incline towards this or that.

We have made many promises to do some jobs; and secretly made entreaties to God. But we do not have that strength to fulfil; we are helpless, weak and oppressed by circumstances. If your grace does not support us, we shall be put to disgrace and sorrow. Do link our promises with their fulfilment and keep us strong on our determination.

I return to the story of that dervish who immediately after the breach of promise was imprisoned. God’s honour reprimanded him instantly as God has said: “Fulfil your undertakings” awfu bil uquud: (Maida: 5: 1). In his near abouts there was a gang of dacoits who had brought Plenty of gold and silver. By chance some of them ran away and took refuge in the hills.

chapters.title: Punishment from God
chapters.subtitle: Accusing the Shaikh of theft, his hand was cut off

paras: There were about twenty thieves, who were distributing their booty among themselves. The police chief was informed by his informer and his men came over to the hills and he caught held of them all and ordered the executioners to severe their hands and feet, who cut off their left foot and right hand and there was great furore in the roundabouts. By mistake the Shaikh’s hand was also cut off and they were about to cut the foot, when a respectable person came over and shouted at the executioners and warned them and said: He is so and so great man. He is an abdaal (a class of sufis who have so changed themselves that they convert their vices into virtues). The executioner got panicky, tore his clothes went to the police chief and informed him. The chief came running barefoot, admitted the wrong swearing upon God, and sought pardon. He told the shaikh also: “Please forgive me for this misdeed. You are the leader of the dwellers of paradise”. And the shaikh said: “I know the reason for this injury. I am aware of my sin. I have dishonoured my promise to God and His department of justice has got my right hand severed. I committed breach of promise knowing well that it was wrong. The viciousness of that wrong reached my hand. Our hands, feet and the whole body, have to be ransomed at the command of the Friend. This was my misfortune; and I pardon you. You did not know, the impacts of this would not be upon you.

sections.heading: Victims of Hunger and Greed
paras: One who knows that it is God who commands and issues commands and that nobody can disagree with Him in this regard. Many a times, a bird in search of grains to satisfy the urge gets its throat slaughtered. Many times, upon the pangs of hunger of the stomach and intestines, birds are held in the cages on the balconies of buildings. Fishes swimming in deep waters come above with the greed of their throat and get caught in the hook. A women hidden within the confines at home, gets disgraced with the mistakes of throat and sex urge. Many a times a judge of the high level, is put to shame for taking bribe to meet the demand of his throat. A haji goes to hajj with all sincerity and love of God but comes back with hidden sins. Haroot and Maroot for having drunk wine, were prevented from going back toward the sky.

sections.heading: Bayazid’s Repentance
paras: That is why Bayazid of Bistam had resorted to self-control for the reason that he had felt tiresomeness in prayer and thought over of the reason for it. He found that it was for drinking excessive water; and he decided not to drink water for one year. He did so and God provided to him the strength to do so. This small struggle, he took for the sake of faith, and as a reward he became the king of the guides of the gnosis of God (Ma’arifat).

The shaikh of the hill track concluded that it is to meet the demand of his throat that his hand was severed, and shut the doors of regret upon himself. It so happens that when one door is shut for a man, hundreds of other doors open for him.

chapters.title: Loss of Hand Caused No Problems
chapters.subtitle: Marvel of the handicapped shaikh: making handbags with both the hands

paras: He became known among the people as ‘handless shaikh’. The demands of the throat provided the ignoble name for him. Instead of this name, if you want to call him with the original and earlier name, call him as Abul Khair Tinati (for that was the name of the shaikh, as the character in this narrative)

A person found him making a handbag with both hands in a hut. He said: “Why are you entering into my hut. Why are you so fast in coming forward to me “? And he replied: “It was due to his love and desire to meet him”. Abul Khair Tinati laughed and said: “I am not coming to you. You may go away but be careful not to divulge this secret of my bag making with both hands. You should not speak of this so long as I am alive, neither to your friend, nor companion, nor to any mean fellow.”

But after some days, people peeped into his hut through its openings and became aware of his activity. And Abul Khair said to God: “You know very well that I hid it, but You revealed it. Then a revelation came to him: there were some people who refused to believe in your being innocent of theft and that you were troubled unnecessarily. They did not believe in the truth of your affair and were suspicious of your good conduct. Therefore, we revealed this marvel to them so that at the time of your work, it is we who provide a hand to you, so that these suspicious, helpless men may not be kept away from Our presence. I have already given solace to you about My essence even before this marvel. I have given this marvel to you for their sake that these people may know that physical hands and feet alone may not be considered, and there are other means of jobs getting done. You had progressed so much already that there was no need to fear for the severing of limbs and head, and death. And now you are totally convinced of that. Any little suspicion you had has vanished. You have now got a strong shield to defend from the attacks of doubts and suspicions.

chapters.title: World, as Dream
chapters.subtitle: Fearlessness of the magicians of Phaeraoh with regard to the severing of the hands and feet

paras: The accursed Phaeraoh warned the magicians in the open field and said: “I shall get your right hand and left foot severed and then hang you. I shall never pardon you”. He was thinking that they are held under doubts and insinuations. They will be taken over by fear and shiver with the fear of life and limb. But he did not know that they had been freed of all fears. They had reached and sat at the window of the light of faith. They had found out the difference between themselves and their shadow. They had become smart, fast, pleased and sharp in mind. The connection between physical body and spiritual body is like the body and shadow. Even if the grinding stone of the sky crushes them to pieces a hundred times, there was no scope for them to have any doubts and suspicions resulting in fear. This body is like the one that is seen in the dream and this world itself is like a dream. No one fears the cutting away of his hands and feet in the dream.

sections.heading: Worlds: Like a Dream
paras: You see your head getting severed in your dream, but in reality, you head is intact and so also you are. You also feel that, rather your life is elongated. You may see yourself being cut into two pieces in the dream, but when you wake up you are very much alive and intact. To sum up, even if you get cut into two hundred pieces, there is no need to fear anyway. The noble Prophet has said: This world is intact and settled, yet it is like a dream for one in sleep. You accept this as a matter of followership of the beliefs and directions of the elders; but those who have gone deeper into matters have actually seen them, of their own, without even receiving such directions. As for as you are concerned, you are in a dream even during daytime when you are not asleep. Do not say so. Shadow is only a phenomenon of the light of the moon. Think of your sleep and wakefulness as situations observed by one in asleep in the dream. He thinks that he is asleep, being ignorant of the fact that it is a different sleep. [The noble Prophet said: people are in sleep, and they will wake up only when they are dead]. If the wakefulness in the world is a dream, what can be said of a dream. Sometimes one sees oneself as awake in the dream and later going to sleep. Thus, he sees a dream in a dream. The situation of the world as dream has to be understood in this manner.

If a potter breaks his pot, he is capable of making another pot whenever he wants. A blind man has the fear of a pit at everyone of his steps and moves forward with a thousand fears. But a normal man looks at the width of the road and he knows of the pits and wells on the path. His feet and legs never shiver, and he never bothers.

Get up o Phaeraoh! Now we are not what we were, that we might be stopped by every shriek of the devils. Nothing happens if you tear off our apparel: our chests will remain intact. We will be satisfied with our bare bodies. We shall manage to sleep even without our clothing’s. We shall keep our souls intact with our bare bodies. Our spiritual life is dear to us with the help of God, even though getting separated from the body and its pleasures appears to be unhappy.

chapters.title: God Gives Life and Provides
chapters.subtitle: Complaint of a mule before a camel: I fall down on my face very often; but you do so rarely: and the camel’s reply

paras: A mule told a camel: “My dear friend! You walk along high, low and narrow paths very well and do not fall on your face. But I, like a misguided fellow often fall down. Please tell the reason for this, so that I may know as to how to live in the world”.

The camel said: “My eyes are sharper and brighter with a farther sight than yours. That apart, I see from a greater height and therefore I do not fall on my face. My eyes being brighter, can see from a higher level. When I reach the top of a hill, I use my wisdom to look at lower levels; and thus, the high and low levels of the road are shown to me by God. I keep all my steps with due care and calculations and protect myself from stumbling and falling. As against this, you look at only two-three steps ahead. You look at the grain and not at the net. In your view the blind and those with eyes are the same in walking, climbing down and settling.”

sections.heading: Physical, Spiritual Life Taught to Absorb
paras: When God puts life into the foetus, it gives the power to absorb things for itself. From food, it absorbs the requirements and develops its flesh and nerves. And after coming out of the womb, for forty years, man goes on absorbing the requirement, and God makes him greedy after these to grow more. Similarly, He has taught the soul to absorb things required for its development. When all these can absorb requirements, God cannot be considered to be not knowing of these absorptions.

The sun collects all its particles. God knows how to collect all your requirements for your life. Even things other than food. When you wake up after sleep, all your senses that had vanished, are brought back to you instantly. So much so, you think that they had not gone away from you. similarly, the parts of your body return to you when God calls you back to life.

chapters.title: Sleep, Similar to Death
chapters.subtitle: Recollection of the parts of H. Uzair’s donkey which had scattered; and their coming together and assembling in the presence of H. Uzair with God’s Command

paras: [Uzair was a Prophet who while passing along a ruined city exclaimed and asked God as to how would he bring it up back to life. Upon this God sent death upon his donkey and upon him, for a hundred years, after which he woke up and found the donkey’s body decomposed and parts scattered. These were regathered and the donkey came back to life — Translator]
“O Uzair look at your donkey, which was decomposed and scattered into pieces right Infront of you after its death. I shall bring together all scattered parts: its head, tail, two ears and legs.”

He has no hands, but he collects the parts and reassembles them. Look at the darner’s wonderful skill, that he stiches torn clothes without needle and thread and finishes his job in such a manner that the darned portion is not distinct from the rest.

Open your eyes and see clearly that such things happen on the doomsday and there is no need to suspect; so that you may know of my regathering in full, and that you may not shiver at the time of death. In similar manner you go to sleep in peace, because of the breakdown of the sensations of all parts of your body. You do not fear about the loss of all your senses while going to sleep, even though they are destroyed and scattered.

chapters.title: Old Man Is Like Prophet for His People
chapters.subtitle: A Shaikh’s not feeling grief upon his children’s death

paras: In the earlier days there was an elderly shaikh (master) who was like a lamp on the face of the earth. He was like a prophet among his followers who could open the gates of paradise. The noble Prophet has said that “an elderly person in his community is like a prophet among his followers”.

One day his wife asked him as to why he was hard hearted. While we so much grieved at the death and separation of your children, in spite of our old age, why did you not grieve and cry. Is it because you have no feelings and kindness in your heart? When you do not have kindness within you, what hope can we have from you? You are our leader, and we have hopes upon you that you will not leave us in difficulties. When on the doomsday, trails and judgements are organised, you will be one to intercede for us. Our hopes in such circumstances will be only upon you to seek solace. At that time, our hands will be in your hands, where there will none to protect and provide peace to criminals.

sections.heading: Intercession by the Prophet
paras: The noble Prophet has said: “I will not leave the sinners in sorrow on the day of judgement. I shall intercede for them with all my heart and soul, so as to release them from hard clutches. I shall provide relief to those who have committed major sins and breach of promises. The good among my followers do not need any intercession by me; rather they themselves can intercede for others and their words will have the power of promulgated commands.”
But there is none on those days to bear the burdens of another. God has said: nor can a bearer of burdens, bear another’s burden. (Laa taziru warizathun wizra ukharra (Fatir: 35: 18).
[This ayat refers to those who have some burden upon themselves. They cannot carry the burden of others. But I am burdenless and therefore, I can bear other’s burden]

sections.heading: Who Is a Shaikh?
paras: O young man, one who is without burden is that shaikh, who is the accepted one by God, who is like the bow in the bowman’s hand. Who is a shaikh? He is an elderly man whose hairs have gone grey. But you should know the meaning of hair. Black hairs are the life and the strength of existence. They act as the wires of his life. But when his strength of existence ceases, or he ceases to be of strong life, and he has no care for life, he becomes old, when his hair may be grey or a mixture of black and grey. Black hairs is a baser attribute of humanness which is not dependent upon the colour of hair of the beard or the head. [When a man becomes old with grey hairs, he is supposed to have lost baser human attributes. Jesus Christ announced as a baby in the cradle: became old without passing through the process of youthfulness. When the black hair which is our attribute of youth is no more with one, one becomes the beloved of God and a shaikh. Inspite of having all grey hair, if one has not given up his pride and arrogance, he is neither an old man, nor a beloved of God.

If a man has cleansed himself of some of the attributes of humanness, he is neither middle aged nor old. Even if he has a hair’s worth of bad human qualities, he has nothing to do with the sky or the ‘arsh. He is just a worldly man.

The Shaikh’s wife continued to tell him: we are hopeful of your kindness and benevolence and we desire to take these from you. Inspite of this why do you not have concern, softness and empathy for your children. Why your heart does not burn upon your son’s death. Kindly clarify this to us.

chapters.title: Coordination and Decontrol of Senses, Wisdom and Soul
chapters.subtitle: Shaikh’s explanation for not grieving upon son’s death

paras: The shaikh told his wife: “Do not think that I do not have kind, loving and concerned heart. Our mercy is there on the rejectors of God too, even though they deny the grants of God. I have concern even for dogs and I pity them for their being pelted stone by the people. I pray even for that dog that bites, and ask God to prevent it from its biting habits and to put into the heads of the dogs that they should not do acts that render them to be stoned. God has sent prophets on the earth so that they may be the mercy for the world. They invite the people to the special abode of God and pray to Him to forgive them all. The prophets turn toward the people to advise them; and if their advice fails to impact, they tell God not to shut His doors upon them.

sections.heading: Limited and General Mercy
paras: Common man has a little mercy in his heart for some; but great men have a generalised mercy for all, like the grace of the rivers which is open for all and they guide all. You are only a part mercy. Join with the common mercy for all and consider it as your guide and go along with it. So long as a man has mercy for a selected few, he does not go toward the ocean. He considers a pond itself as an ocean. When he is aware of the path toward the ocean, he does not walk on it, he cannot take others on the path. He gets connected with the ocean when he is aware of the flow of the river and its path toward the ocean. If a shaikh of the limited calibre speaks of his knowledge of these ways, he says so upon the hearsay of others. He is a narrow-minded follower. His guidance is not a product of his own observation of truth and God’s revelation but mere verbal followership of his masters.”

sections.heading: Tears: Spokesmen of Mercy
paras: The Shaikh’s wife said: “If you have kindness for all, you are like a shepherd who is protecting the flock of sheep. And why do you not cry upon the fate of your own children, when the pricker of death has torne apart their veins. The spokesmen of mercy are the tears from the eyes, but your eyes are without tears and you without cries.”

The shaikh got angry at this remark and lost control for a moment in his talk. He turned toward his wife and said: “O old woman, autumn season is not like spring season. All the children, whether dead or alive are not hidden from the eyes of the heart. I look at the dead also in their full physical form, and why should I slap at any injure my face like you. Crying is due to separation, but when they are right before me, and I am looking at them, there is no reason for crying. Though they have gone out of the circle of the world, they appear to me as playing right before me and around me. A man cries because of separation and getting away from them, but I mingle with and embrace my dear ones, even though they are dead and gone in the view of others.

sections.heading: Supress Senses to See Realities
paras: People see them in dreams, but I see them clearly even when I am awake. External senses get lost in sleep and therefore, the dead appear in dreams, but I suppress any senses to inactivity and see the dead right before me in full form. Sometimes, I abstain myself from this world and scatter away the leaves of the tree of senses.

sections.heading: Senses and Wisdom Are Prisoners of Soul
paras: Know that senses are the prisoners of wisdom and wisdom is the prisoner of soul. When soul releases the imprisoned wisdom from the prison, many confused jobs become free and fair. Senses and thoughts have overlapped the clear water of the soul like dust and scraps. The hand of wisdom sweeps the dust and scraps and pushes them on one side, and water appears clean to wisdom, and spiritual consciousnesses come about. There is plenty of dust like bubbles on the layer of water, in the stream. When it is wiped off, water becomes clear. Until God does not wipe of this dust through the hands of wisdom, the dust of passions and senses will be dominant upon the water of our soul. This dust continuously keeps our water under domination, and passions and senses stand aloof and smile at your confused wisdom. When our self-discipline ties both the hands of passions and senses, God unties both the hands of wisdom. When your wisdom becomes your leader and comes under the control of your soul, senses that dominated over you become obedient to you. Wisdom puts the senses into sleep without your going to sleep, so that, unseen things come out of the soul and appear before you. man sees things in dreams because of the senses becoming non-functional leaving soul free of its compulsions. And if wisdom dominates, wisdom can see things while awake, what others see in dreams. They see dreams even while awake and doors of the heavens open for them.

chapters.title: Patience Is Bitter but Gives Sweetness
chapters.subtitle: Story of a blind shaikh who read the Quran by looking at it. He would become sightful for this by God’s command

paras: A destitute shaikh in Baghdad saw the Quran in the house of a blind shaikh. He became his guest in a harsh summer and both of them stayed in that house for a few days. He was astonished to see the Quran in house as his host was totally blind. His anxiety went on increasing as there was none other than the blind shaikh in that house. He is alone and the Quran was kept along; and he was not so familiar with him to make enquiries about it. He was perplexed as to whether to ask him about it or to keep quiet and wait, so as to get the answer through patience. He waited for some days as patience is the key to the information of issues. Patience is a great wealth to get rid of an old sorrow. Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet. It is a guide for the revealing of all secrets.

chapters.title: Patience as Great as Truth
chapters.subtitle: Patience of Luqman when he saw H. Dawood making rings out of steel, on the ground that patience gives pleasure and comfort

paras: Luqman came over to H. Dawood (David) and saw that he was making rings out of hard steel. Then he put the rings in each other. Luqman had not seen the making of coat of mail and he got astonished and put into suspicions and thought of asking him as to what he was making by mingling up the rings. Then, he said to himself, patience is better, as it is a fast guide to reach the object. Even if you do not enquire, the truth of the matter would become known to you, as the bird of patience flies higher above other birds. On the contrary, if you make enquiries, you may get the result after a longer time. By then, David’s job was completed and the work of the coat of mail was over and he wore it before the patient and wise Luqman; and he said: “O young man, this is a good dress to protect from injuries in the battles”. Then Luqman said: “Patience is a good friend as it is a refuge from every sorrow, and a good protector. Make friendship with patience and read the last words of Surah: (Al-asr: 103: 3) which says about the noble people as those who hold on — in the mutual teaching of truth and of patience and constancy: watawasow bil haqqi, watawasaw bis sabr. That is taking care of patience is as necessary as that of truth. God has created hundreds and thousands of chemicals but none like patience to alter the nature of things as was seen by Adam.

chapters.title: Alternate Provisions for Losses
chapters.subtitle: Rest of the story of the blind shaikh and his reading of Quran by seeing it
