chapters.subtitle: Wisdom behind making a hell in that world and prison in this world, so that these may be their places of worship, as obedience is with pleasure or under threat of punishment

paras: Hell is the mosque and place of worship of the mean fellows just as the net is the trap to tie the feet of untamed birds. Prison is the place of worship of the mean fellows in the world where only, they will remember God, all the time. As worship (obedience) is the purpose of man’s creation, the place of worship (obedience) of the arrogant is the hell. Men has the power to do all kinds of jobs, but the fundamental purpose of his creation is obedience. Read this in the Quran: maa khalaqtu aljina wa alina illa liya’buduni: (I have only created jinns and men that they serve me: (Zurriyat: 51: 56). The purpose of man’s creation is nothing but service to God in this world.

Though the purpose of a book is to teach the lessons in it, you can as well make it as a pillow for you. but its purpose is not to make it a pillow. It is knowledge, wisdom, advice and profits. If you use a sword as a hook to hang on things, like a nail on the wall, you give preference to misfortune to victory. Though the object of man’s creation is learning and guidance, but everyone has his own place of worship. The place of worship of a noble man is one that makes him honourable; and of the mean fellow, that makes him sick. Beat the mean fellows to make them obedient and reward the noble ones, so that they may increase their nobility and benefit others. God has hell for the mean fellows: and paradise for the noble one’s: the hell is sickness-causing and the paradise increases honour: as He has said: There will be for them that they wish and more, besides our presence: Lahum maa yasha’una fiha wa ladiana mazid: (Qaf: 50: 35). Beat the mean fellows to make them obedient and grace the noble one’s to increase nobility. Hell, and heaven are like two masjids where they respectively pray.

H. Musa made a small door in the Holy city so that the arrogant may pass through it with their upper parts bent down in order to compel and train them in humility, because they were very cruel and arrogant.

chapters.title: Mean Fellows Respect the Lowly
chapters.subtitle: To explain that God has created kings to make obedient to themselves those who do not obey God, just as H. Musa made a small door in the wall of the Holy city to bend them like prostrating, saying: enter the door in prostration and say prayers, as the Quran says: Enter the gate, prostrate and say repentance: udklaulu al baaba sujjdan wa qulu hittatun: (Baqara: 2: 58)

paras: In this manner God had made the kings as smaller gates made of flesh and bones. Worldly people prostrate to them, because they oppose prostration to God. The place of prostration for them is a niche in a house of filth, which is called as a palace, its master being called as king and leader. This is because they are not worthy to prostrate in the court of God. Clean people are like sugarcane and these unclean are like rattan. These mean fellows are obedient to these dogs, and they prostrate to them.

They are not worthy to prostrate a lion and admire him. Rat is afraid of the cat and not afraid of the lion, as it cannot understand the grand status of the lion. Therefore, a cat alone can be one to watch as a police officer of the rat. The rejectors also fears the dogs of God (Kings); they cannot fear God as the bright sun of truth. While the noble people say: My Lord is great (Rabbi al a‘ala) the mean foolish fellows say: my Lord is lowly (rabbi al adnaa). Lowly rats are not afraid of the lion, but those noble deers that produce musk in their navel, fear the lion. O the licker of the tumbler, go to the one who licks the large vessel and consider him as your patron and grantor. The vessel licker also must search for the licker of tumbler, and you may call each other as patrons and grantors.
I should stop talking more about these fellows as otherwise their king will think that he is also worthy of consideration that so much is said about him.

sections.heading: Be Harsh to the Mean
paras: The sum and substance is the nobleman may be harsh to the mean fellows, so that they may be obedient. Similarly, if you show kindness to your nafs (vicious self), it will also reject the worth of your kindness just as the mean fellows among men do. This is the reason why those who work hard to earn their livelihood are always thankful and the rich are arrogant and treacherous. The leader with golden laced dress is haughty and the one in simple clothes is thankful. Thankfulness cannot arise in wealth and properties, and it arises in trails and sicknesses.

chapters.title: Pleasures of Pain and Deprivation
chapters.subtitle: Story of the Sufi in love with an empty dining Sheet

paras: A Sufi happened to see a dining sheet hanging on a wall hook. He got into a mood of intoxicated excitement, (which the sufis get upon seeing something new through their mind which usually happens when they hear music. It is called wajd) ecstasy. Looking at the dining sheet hanging vertically without any scope for any dish being kept on it, he went into started dancing and tearing his clothes and shouting: “This a provision provided in no provision. This is a remedy for famine and pains.”

When his feelings of pain and burning increased, whoever was a sufi or sufi inclined joined him. They were all laughing and shouting and getting more and more enthralled, euphoric and out of control. A passer-by who could not understand this strange situation asked him: “What is this strange behaviour. There is a dining sheet, hanging on the wall without any dish and scope for the dish and you are dancing as though in great pleasure of eating”.

The sufi said: “Go away. You are just like an idol without soul. You cannot understand this. You may go and search for something that exists in form and not in reality just as a lover does. Love with bread in spite of its not being bread is the food of those in love. A truthful person is not bound by the pleasure of things that are apparent in existence. Lovers do not have anything to do with the apparent existents. They get profit without any investment. They do not trade, but they get profits. They do not have feathers, but they fly everywhere in the world. They do not have hands, but they carry an invisible ball to the field to play. That faqir who has found out the fragrance of truth, will make bags even when he has his hands severed. (as the case of a sufi already narrated earlier). They have put up their tents in the world of spirits and have become like each other with one single soul. A baby knows only the taste of milk and of no other food. The food of the fairy is only the fragrance of food, but of the man, it is food itself. He cannot understand how the fairy lives only upon the smell of food. The fairy gets such pleasure and energy with the smell of food which you get with hundred maunds of food.

sections.heading: Good for One, Bad for Another
paras: The water of Nile was blood for the Copts but for Bani Israil it was clean water. The sea split to make way for the Bani Israil, but it became a place of drowning for the cruel Phaoraoh. Strong wind became forceful like maces and axes, but a cause of victory for H. Hood and his followers. For H. Ibrahim fire was a garden but for Nimrod, it was a poisonous snake. For Samandar, fire promotes its family but a cause of destruction for other birds. Pains and sorrows are pleasurable sweets for the lover, but for the mean fellows, sweets become a cause of trail and troubles.

chapters.title: Tastes and Likings Differ
chapters.subtitle: H. Yaqoob received divine coolness from the face of H. Yusufs face, and God’s fragrance from the fragrance of H. Yusuf; But Yusuf’s brothers were deprived of these two benefits

paras: What all the pleasures that H. Yaqoob got from the face of H. Yusuf; and the fragrance from him that he got for his soul; and what all was hidden in H. Yusuf was visible to him but could not be tasted by his brothers. H. Yaqoob was felling himself in the well of his love for Yusuf, but his brothers were digging up a well to fell H. Yusuf in it. The dining sheet of Yusuf was full of dishes of varieties of foods for H. Yaqoob was empty even of the bread for his brothers. An unclean face cannot see the face of heavenly beauties (Hoors). That is why the noble Prophet said: La salaata illa bil huzuur (it is not a salaat which is not with total inclination of soul toward it). Love provides varieties of foods for the soul with a never ending hunger; and this hunger is the actual and only food of souls. H. Yaqoob had the hunger of Yusuf as the food of his soul. That is why, he felt the smell of his food from a long distance. The fellow who carried his shirt was running fast. He was not feeling the smell of his clothes. H. Yaqoob who was miles and miles away felt its smell, because he was hungry for him.

There are many scholars, who do not have intellect and cannot understand the worth of what they have learnt. They are only the protectors of knowledge and not its lovers, as they do not understand its worth’s. But one who hears their talk feels the smell of that knowledge even if he is a layman. This is because the scholar has a borrowed garment like the slave-merchant having a maid among the slaves. The maid is with the slave-merchant for a short time as a commodity for the sake of the buyer.

This is the distribution system that God has made and not the seeker of the needs. There is such a way for one and not for another. One good idea becomes a garden for one; and one bad idea becomes a dacoit for him. One thought makes a garden and other sets things upside down. With one thought God made a garden; and with another thought made a hell. Nobody knows the paths of His gardens, so also of the paths of smelting kilns. Man as the protector of thoughts does not know as to from which part of the soul thoughts come. Excepting that heart which has got the support of God whose own material existence has been destroyed and replaced by God’s. If the source of the thoughts were to be found out, he would have closed the source of evil thoughts. Thoughts originate from the secured place of the worlds of spirits (‘adam). Man as a spy with his sensual, physical source of knowledge cannot step into that place. Hold on to the mantle of His benevolence just as the blind holds. The holding of the blind is with the fullest confidence and reliance. Command and order are His mantle and he is fortunate whose soul is completely devoted to Him.

One is in a garden with streams in pleasure and another nearby to him is in torture. He is in a puzzle as to why the other one is in pleasure; and the other one is in puzzle as to why the other one is in troubles. The one is pleasure calls the other one and says: “Why are you in a hot dry place. Come to this side; it is cool and pleasing. You appear to have gone pale due to some sickness. come over here: there are hundreds of medicines here. O my friend, take care, come over to this garden”. The other man replies: O my friend, I cannot come over there”. The first man stresses. “Your feet are not bound; you can walk, come over”. The other man replies: “No, No, I have no strength to walk”.

In connection with this affair, there is a saying by hearing which, perhaps you may understand the secret behind this puzzle. I shall narrate a story for this. Hear me carefully so that you may share the secret.

chapters.title: All Tied to Their Fate
chapters.subtitle: Story of the slave of a ruler who was very devout in prayer and loved immersion in God’s praises

paras: Once upon a time there was a great man of authority among others, who had a slave by name Sunqur. One morning he was in need to take bath, and he called his slave to get up from the bed, collect the vessel, underwear and the clay (used as soap for bathing) from the maid Iltun, so that we may carry them to the bathroom. Sunqur took these things and walked with the master. There was a mosque on the way and a call for prayer entered into Sunqur’s ears. Sunqur was very committed to prayer and told his master: “O my master and protector of this slave, please wait in this nearby shop for some time so that I may perform my salaat and other recitations”. So, saying, he left, and his master sat down in the shop, waiting for Sunqur in full intoxication of his pride. The master sat down only for a little time only to please that living soul of Sunqur. When the imam and the followers came out of the mosque after finishing their prayer and recitations, Sunqur continued to remain in the masjid up till the time of after sunrise prayer and the master remained in wait. He called upon Sunqur as to why he was not coming out. Sunqur replied: “He is not leaving me. Wait for some time. I have not forgotten you”. In this manner the master called him seven times and every time Sunqur said: “He is not leaving me”; and the master got disgusted and said: “There is no body in the masjid. Who else is there preventing you from coming out”? Sunqur replied: “I am prevented by Him who has tied you outside. He has tied me here in the masjid. He is not allowing you to enter into, and me to go out. He is not allowing you to take steps in this direction and tied the feet of this slave”.

sections.heading: All Allotted Duties
paras: Ocean does not allow the fishes to go out of itself and does not allow the land animals to get into it. The place of the fishes is fixed to be water and of the other animals as land. There is no scope for finding alternatives here. The lock of all this is very heavy and the one to unlock it is God. Therefore, you should adjust yourself to accept this fact and be ready to remain satisfied at that. Even if every particle of earth becomes a key, it is not possible for all of them to open the lock. There is no escape from this law of God. But when you recognise your failure to alter this, the only way for you is to go to a shaikh and submit yourself to him. When you forget your self-respect, your shaikh will remember you. When you become his slave, he will grant you freedom. If you want to be free and get the life of the heart, the only means for you is to be a slave, and nothing else. Get out of yourself so as to reach God. You have to destroy yourself in the thoughts of God. By destroying yourself within Him you will get the everlasting life. If you want to find out the right path, destroy yourself and be sure that God alone knows everything with certainty.

chapters.title: Man Proposes, God Disposes
chapters.subtitle: Prophet’s losing all hopes from the people and God’s saying: until the prophets lost hopes: (Hatta iz astai as al rusulu: Yusuf: 12: 110)

paras: The prophets told within their hearts: how much ever we may advise and entreat them, it has no effect. How long are we to beat cold iron? It will not mould. How much ever we blow the wind in a cage it will not be filled. How long are we to measure a donkey’s tail? It gives no benefit even of the worth of a grain. Movements come into people as per fate and directions of God. Teeth become active only with the rising of hunger in the stomach.

Whatever that happens, happens from the command of God, the first Commander upon the next commander. Fish start rotting from the head and not from the tail. But be sure and go on driving the donkey of your wisdom like an arrow as God has commanded: Balligh (proclaim) as stated in the Quran to the apostle to proclaim the message which has been sent to you from your Lord: Balligh maa unzila ilaika min rabbika (Maida: 5: 70). There is no escape from it.

You do not know the results of your actions. You have only to carry on your job to know the result. When you load a ship with your goods. you do so only upon a hope. You do not know for certain as to whether it sinks or reaches the port of your choice. You cannot carry on trade: if you say that you will not enter into the sea unless you know for certain that you will definitely reach your destination. Or unless you know whether you are one among the reachers or the sinkers; or you say: I shall not proceed upon an uncertain journey like others who go only on hope. You cannot carry on trade with such thoughts because the result of this or that is a hidden fact. A fearful, weak-hearted merchant cannot carry on trade. He will not either earn profit or get into loss. But he is certainly at a loss as he is deprived and cowardly. Light is obtained by him, who is dare enough to set aflame the torch. As everything is dependant upon hope, the work of religion is also upon hope; rather this is more deserving to achieve. But I cannot knock the door very much on this aspect excepting to be hopeful of God’s grace, who alone knows the truth.

chapters.title: Efforts Lead to Success
chapters.subtitle: To explain that the faith of a blind follower is dependant upon hope and fear.

paras: Every profession is carried on with a desire and hope, even though the professional’s neck turns into a spindle in carrying on the trade. Every morning the shop keeper goes to the shop in the hope of meeting his desire to make money. If there is no desire for money, he would not go. It is the fear of failure that makes one go strong. The fear of eternal deprivation only makes you to go in search of food. It does not make you desperate and tired. You say that the fear of deprivation is right before you, but this fear is more in inactivity than in activity. I see greater hope in actions and danger in laziness.

Then, O suspicious fellow. why do you do so in the acts of religion, and why the fear of loss does not hold on to your act. Do you not see, how much the goers into this market are making profit? So also, prophets and saints in their actions. What kind of mines of precious materials they found when they went to their shops in this market of godly professions. How much profit they have made? Fire became obedient to them like anklets. Ocean became like a porter for them. With the blow of their breaths, dead bodies got life; and clouds became their sunshades. Iron became wax in their hands as it happened in the case of H. Dawood. Wind became their servant and subject as happened in the case of H. Sulaiman when his throne was carried by it. Staff became a serpent to protect him from the enemy as happened with H. Musa; and the spider built a curtain at the mouth of the cave of Sowr to protect H. Muhammad from the enemies.

chapters.title: God’s Friends Are Hidden from Men
chapters.subtitle: To explain Prophet Muhammad’s statement: God has some hidden friends

paras: Hadith(s): inna lillahi ta’aala aulia i akhfiah. There are other groups of people who are completely hidden. They are never observed by the common people who go only by the appearances. They possess all good qualifications but the eyes of anyone do not fall on them even for a moment. Their grandeur and their marvels are themselves are hidden in the precincts of the Ka’ba; so much so, even ABDALS, (who have converted all-natural human viciousness into virtues), cannot know of them. There are graces of God that call you toward him, but you are unaware of this. There are graces of God all around you — right, left, back, front, top and bottom. Whichever side you look; you can see them. If such a great man calls you to enter into fire, do enter, and do not say that it will burn you. He can make the fire into narcissuneses and jasmines and bring out flowers out of the flames. The fact is, fire itself is like water, and acts as a washerman of the dining sheets of Prophets.

chapters.title: Faith of Great Men
chapters.subtitle: Throwing of the kerchief of H. Anas b. Malik into furnace and it’s not burning

sections.heading: It Is Reported from Anas B. Malik That He Had a Guest. He Said That Anas B Malik After His Food Found the Dinner Sheet Was Soiled Yellowish with the Spilled Curry. Anas Asked His Maid to Put It in Furnace and She Dropped It in the Burning Fire of the Furnace. All the Guests Were Surprised and Waited for the Smoke of the Burnt-Out Cloth. After Some Time, She Removed the Dining Sheet. It Was Clean and White Without Any Marks of Fallen Food. People Asked Him: “O Companion of the Prophet, Why It Did Not Burn and Come Out Clean”. He Said: “the Prophet Had Wiped His Hand and Mouth with This Cloth”
paras: O heart, fearful of fire and torture! Develop intimacy with such hand and lips. When a non-living material receives such nobility, how much nobility and expanse cannot the heart of a loving one get? He has made the lump of mud as an honourable place for circumambulation of the people. Man can get greater honour than this and therefore, become close to the dust of the man of God. After this people asked the maid: “Why did you not talk about your state when you have seen these wonders. Why did you put the dinner sheet into fire, instantly without asking any question? We do agree that H. Anas was aware of the secret. How about you? Why did you throw such a precious dinner sheet into fire”?

She said: “I have great confidence in great men. I have great hopes with the sincere servants of God. What do you speak of a dinner sheet? What about even my clothings? If he were to tell me to enter into fire, I would have done so. I would enter into fire with the full confidence I have in him. I am not hopeless of his graces. I would even put my head in fire; a dinner sheet is something else. This would be in my confidence in his graces.”

The faith of the men should not be lesser than of a maid. Rub yourself with the alchemy of great men. The heart of a man which is lesser than that of a women is so lowly as a lowly part of the stomach.

chapters.title: Cause and Effect: Not Always
chapters.subtitle: Story of the Appeal of an Arab caravan with the noble Prophet complaining of hunger, thirst and humbleness, being very nearby to death; with the tongues of the people and camels being out of their mouths due to thirst

paras: In a valley, a group of Arabs had their goatskins dried up due to famine. There was nothing in that desert except the caravan which had invited its own death. Suddenly that responder to the callers of the two worlds Mustafa Muhammad, appeared on the way to help them. He found a large caravan on hot sand and a hard way. The tongues of their camels were hanging out of their mouth and the people lying scattered everywhere on the sand. He got pity for them and said: “Get informed; go fast: some of you may run on that way. A black man is carrying goat skins full of water on his camel and running fast towards his master. Bring that black camel driver with the camel even with force, warning him of my strict order”.

Those in search went towards those sand dunes and within a short time they saw what was told, that a black slave was going with goatskin full of water as donors carry for the donees. They told him: “You are called by the honour of humanity and the best of the creatures”. He replied: “I do not know as to what and who he is”. They replied: “He is bright like the moon with sugary sweet nature. He is a leader and commander, Muhammad, the light of the souls, greater and elevated, pleader of the sinful”. They praised him in such manner as he was. The camel driver said: “Yes. Perhaps he is that magician, who has dominated over a group of people with his magic. I shall not go toward him even for a half a span’s length.”

The people dragged and took him. He started shouting and telling unpalatable things. When they took him near that honourable, he told them to drink and also collect water. They supplied water to full satisfaction to all the people and camels and also filled their small and large goatskins. Clouds in the sky became envious and wonderstruck. They had not seen this wonder that from a goat skin of water the burning fire of so may mouths was quenched. That with the water of one goatskin so many goatskins were filled up, with so much ease.

sections.heading: Man Habituated to Cause and Effect
paras: The real fact is the goatskin was only an apparent thing. It was the wave of the benevolence of God that provided water to him, which was falling over the goatskin having come from the ocean. Water with the heat caused by Him becomes hot air (vapour) and again it becomes water due to coolness. These are the apparent reasons in water’s becoming vapour and again as water. But apart from these natural processes and causes, God’s creative power has created water out of nothing. As you are in the habit of seeing causes from your childhood, you have got attached to causes out of your ignorance. Because of your attachment to causes. You have forgotten the Maker (causer) of the causes. That is why you are inclined toward the apparent things. When the causes become exhausted, you hit upon your forehead and repeatedly say: My Lord, O My Lord.”

sections.heading: God’s Forgiving and Granting Has No Bounds
paras: God tells you to go toward the cause. I wonder how you have thought of my ways of doing. Man says: “From now onwards I shall be looking at You and shall not go toward the cause and its treacheries”. God tells him: “If I send them back, they will return to same old ways and actions: and you are weak in your promise and repentance: as stated in the Quran: if they were sent back to the world, they would return unto which they are forbidden. Lo they are liars: wa lou ruddu la-‘aadu lima nuhu ‘anhu wa innahum lakaazibun: An’am, 6: 28).

“But I do not think of that. I show mercy. My mercy is very broad, and I make use of it. I do not look at your false promise, but forgive you and grace you with My grace, whenever you call Me. There is only benevolence and grant from My side, and from your side? It is only breach of promise, forgetfulness and wrong.

The sum and substance are you are entangled in the cause and effect. But you are helpless, as you have seen only this in your life. The caravan was wonderstruck at this miracle and asked: “O Muhammad, O the one large like the ocean, what is all this? You made a small goatskin as a means and made the Arabs, and the Kurds sink in water.

chapters.title: Black Man Turns White
chapters.subtitle: Goatskin of the slave getting filled with water with the Prophet’s miracle, and his becoming white with the command of God.

paras: Then he said to the slave: “O slave, you may see your goatskin full of water so that you may not have to speak unwell things. The blackman was wonderstruck at this miracle and his faith started to develop from the spiritual world. He saw a stream that was flowing in the air. His goatskin became a means for it. This had opened up his eyes to things occurring without apparent cause. He had seen flowing water in an invisible stream, through his insight. The slave’s eyes were full of tears which made him forget his master and his place. His hands and feet felt tired of walking on his way. God caused a great earthquake like turmoil in his soul. The Prophet dragged him from this situation of insight to normal sight as though he said that this searcher of benefits may become normal and go back to his place. This is not a situation of feeling surprised. Situation of surprise is about to come, which is to gain smartness and sense to come on the right path.

The slave caught hold of the hands of the Prophet, kept them on his face and made many loveful and respectful kisses on them. The Prophet rubbed his prosperous hands on his face and also made his face prosperous. That blackman of Abyssinian descent became white like the white full moon and his dark night became a bright day. He became handsome and graceful like Yusuf and was told to go to his village and narrate the event. He left in great enthusiasm being unaware of the movement of his hands and feet. He went fast with two goatskins full of water towards his master’s settlement, who was waiting for him on the way as his slave had not come for such a long time.

chapters.title: Wisdom and Angel Were One
chapters.subtitle: Refusal of the Master to recognise his slave, telling him that he has killed his slave and God has got him arrested at his hand

paras: The master looked at him from a distance and was taken by surprise; and he called the people of the village, and said: “This goatskin and the camel are ours, but where has our black slave gone? The one who is coming is a full moon whose light is falling on the day. Where is our slave? Perhaps he has run away or was caught by a wolf and killed. Or this bad natured fellow killed him; and by God’s grace, the camel has brought him here”. When the slave came nearer, he asked him: “Who are you. Are you a Turk or Yemeni (being so fair coloured)? Tell me the truth. What have you done to my slave? Tell me, if you killed him. Do not plead excuses.”

The slave said: “Why world I come to you, if I killed him. Why would I put my feet in the matter of a murder?” The master said: “No, no. what you say is unacceptable. You should tell the truth. Your arguments are not valid. Where is my slave?” The slave said: “I am your slave. The hand of the grace of God has whitened me. I have looked at the leader of the world and he has made me a full moon and one of a high grade and value.” The master said: Be careful about what you say. Where is my slave. Tell me the truth. Do not think that you can escape from my grip without telling the truth.”

The slave said: “You have some secrets with your slave. I can tell each of them right now. I can tell everything you have done from the day of buying me to this day; so that you may know that I am the same in my existence, even though my dark night is changed into a bright morning. The colour is different, but the colourless soul is the same. This is not made of the four elements (of air, fire, earth and water) and colour. Those who look at the external physical body lose their knowledge very soon. Drinkers of water give up goatskins and tumblers after drinking water. Those who look at the soul are not dependent upon numbers. They are sunk deep into the limitless and unexplicable ocean of oneness. (like the prophets and saints.). Become one like the soul and identify the soul through the soul itself. Become one to see the reality of the friend clearly and not speculate and fall into doubts. Like the angels and wisdom which are connected with each other being from the same source but have become two different entities for some purpose. Both of them are of the same substance, but they are in front and behind of each other like head and tail. Angel has developed wings and feathers and developed the faculty of flying, but wisdom has given up wings and feathers but resorted to grandeur and greatness by remaining in its own place. Both the wisdom and angel are together and supporters of each other and have become the front and back of each other. Both of them are capable of recognising God and therefore both of them became supporters and worshippers of Adam (and his progeny).

sections.heading: Nafs and Satan Are One
paras: Similarly, nafs and Satan were one in the beginning; and they were enemies and jealous of Adam. The one who looked only at the physical body of Adam misunderstood and refused to obey Adam: But wisdom and angel who saw Adam as carrying a trust of God, bowed before him. The eyes of the wisdom and angel were brightened with the inner qualities of Adam, and the other two of Satan and nafs did not see anything other than mud (failed to receive brightness).

“What all I have said on this point has become like a donkey walking upon a sheet of ice and has to be stopped as the New Testament cannot be taught to the Jew. So also, the facts of H. Umar cannot be told to the Shi’ites. So also, music cannot be played before the deaf. Yet this much of my saying is enough for a person in the corner of a village who feels what I said to be sufficient for him. For the one capable of understanding, even lumps of mud and stones become good explainers and talkers. He learns from the tongueless objects.”

chapters.title: Create Need and Meet Demand
chapters.subtitle: To explain that all creations: heavens, earth, substances and accidents — are upon requests and needs. And that one should make oneself a claimant of other things so that God may grant, as God has said: who responds to a desperate person when he calls Him. He has made your desperation as a witness to meet your needs

paras: As the Quran says: Amman yujibul mudtarra iza da’ahu wa yakshifu alsuu’uu: who listens to the soul distressed when it calls on Him and who relieves, its sufferings: (Naml: 27: 62).

sections.heading: Message Without Words
paras: It was H. Maryam’s humble submissions humble silent entreaties and anguish that made a child started talking. A part of her body, without her directions talked for her. Every part of body also talks without your any permission from your side. Your hands and feet speak of and give evidence of your acts, how much ever you may try to deny. If you are not worthy of being talked to, it means that your oratory has failed and gone waste. Everything that has grown on the earth is for those in need, so that whoever wants whatever, may get it. God has created the heavens to meet the requirements of the needy. Whoever searches for a thing gets it. Pain is the investment and the root of mercy for the suffering ones. Medicine reaches the place where there is sickness and materials reach the place where there is shortage. Answers go to the place where there are questions. Water reaches the farmlands.

sections.heading: Needs Reach the Needy
paras: You should not go in search of water, but create thirst within yourself, so that water may come to your from above and below. Until the baby with soft throat is not born, mother’s breasts cannot produce milk. Go and run in the heights and vallies so that you may go thirsty and become warm in the body upon which you will hear the sound of the water flowing in the stream like the sound of the beetle of in the air. Your need should not be less than that of the grass, where water reaches as much as the grass needs. You may also take and draw water Toward the dry farm to freshen it.

Similarly for the farmland of the heart there are many hidden gems and the clouds of benevolence full of the water of kauth(s)ar, the heavenly stream of grace. Pronouncement of the happy news comes to those hearts from their Lord for slaking their thirst, as stated in the Quran: wa saqaahum rabbuhum sharaban tahuran: and their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink: (Al dahr: 76: 21). Therefore, become thirsty, the water of inspiration will come to you, of its own. And God knows best.

chapters.title: Jibra’iil Teaches the Child
chapters.subtitle: Coming of an idol worshipper women to the Prophet of God with a suckling baby who talked like Jesus Christ as a miracle of the Prophet

paras: Sometime later, a woman from that village, the black slave’s village from among the infidels come to test the Prophet. She came before him and hidden under her covering mantle was a two-month-old baby. The baby said to the Prophet: salamallahu Alaika: Peace be upon you O prophet of God! We have come to you. “His mother told him angrily to be silent. Who has put this evidence of prophethood in your ears? Who has taught you this that your tongue has become like that of Jarir (the famous Arab poet) at such young age?” The child said: “God taught this to Jibra’iil who taught this to me. I am like Jibra’iil in this respect”. The mother said: “Where is he?”. He said: “upon your head. You are not seeing him. Lift your head: Jibra’iil is standing upon your head. He has become a guide to me in a hundred ways”. She asked: “Do you see him”. He said: “Yes. He is shining upon your head like a full moon. He is teaching me about the character of the Prophet. He is lifting me from low level to higher levels.”

Then the Prophet said: “O milk suckling child! Tell your name and be obedient”. He said: “My name before God is Abdul Aziz, but before these worthless incompetent people, I am Abdi Uzza. I am rid of and disgusted and cleansed of Uzza (a God of Arab idol worshippers). I swear upon that truth that has made you His Prophet.” A baby, two months old resembling the full moon was speaking like a grown-up person from among the great men.

At this moment a compound of perfumes from paradise came and both child and mother smelt it. Both of them said that the fragrance is so fine that one can sacrifice one’s life to possess it. A thing which is praised by God Himself is such that both the living and non-living beat their drums in praise. One who is praised by God Himself, is approved by both the living and non-living. One whose protector is God Himself, gets the birds and fishes as his guards.

chapters.title: Reflections of Prophethood
chapters.subtitle: An eagle’s taking away of the Prophets shoe in the air and turning it upside down and falling of a black snake

paras: People were waiting for the call of Azaan; and Mustafa heard it from an elevated place. He asked for water for fresh wuzu and washed his hands and face with cold water. He washed both feet and sought for the shoes, when one shoe was carried away by an eagle. He stretched his hand for the shoe, but an eagle snatched it from his hand and flew away with it to a height and turned it upside down; and a black (poisonous) snake fell down from it. With this gracious act, the eagle became his well-wisher. Then it brought back the shoe and said: “Please take it and go for salaat. I did this wrong as an act of necessity and as a token of respect. I feel ashamed and dried up like a broken apart twig for doing this without command. Fie upon the one who stretches his feet without any need before the honourable. And also, upon him who gives a judgement without any need just to show his superior knowledge”.

The Prophet thanked the eagle and said: “We took your act as a cruelty, but it was a great act of grace. You took away my shoe and I felt wronged. But later you kept away a matter of sorrow, and now, I am sorry for it. Though God has revealed all hidden things to us, but at that moment my heart was engaged with myself (and therefore the knowledge of the hidden things was hidden from sight)”. The eagle said: “This not knowing is far far away from your status. My seeing hidden things is also a reflection of your light. My seeing the snake in the shoe from the air above is not my job. It is a reflection of your light. Reflection of the spiritual light is perfect; and reflection of the darkness is like a burning furnace. Reflection of the man of God is a perfect light, but the reflection of the one away from God is blindness in entirety. Understand the reflection of everyone and see in whose company you want to sit.”

chapters.title: No Regret upon Losses
chapters.subtitle: Lesson to be learned from this incident is to know with certainty that: verily with every difficulty there is relief: inna ma’a al’usri yusran: (Inshirah 94: 5)

paras: There is a lesson for you in this incident: that you should have consonance with the wish of God, so that you may be wise enough and possess good hopes when you see some sudden difficulties. Others may go pale with their fears, but you should be smiling like the flower in both loss and gain. If you remove the petals of the flower, it does not stop smiling and does not become black. It says: “Why should I feel sorry for the thorns? I have learnt smiling from the thorns”. (It thinks that its fate has already been decided in the other non-material world of commands. As a result of the decision of fate, if anything is lost from you, you should be sure that it has saved you from another trouble. When asked: “What tasawwuf is”, the answer was “Finding of pleasure in the heart when trouble comes”.

Consider that trouble to be that eagle, which, with its kindness snatched away the shoe in order to save the Prophet from snake-bite. That wisdom is great that remains happy with fate without any cloud of doubts and suspicions around it. God said: la ta’asow ala ma fatakum: you may not despair over matters that pass you by: (Hadid: 57: 23). You should not grieve if a wolf comes and takes away your goat.

Do not mourn upon what has been lost as when an old thing goes a new one comes. Do not grieve if a calamity falls upon you; and do not be sorry for any less, as one calamity puts an end to other calamities; and one loss prevents the coming of other losses. Know this, that the loss of wealth causes protection to life as collected wealth itself becomes a burden of life.

chapters.title: Language of Animals
chapters.subtitle: Request of a person to H. Musa for the learning of the language of birds and animals and acceptance of it with God’s approval

paras: A young man asked H. Musa to be taught the language of animals saying that there is a possibility of learning lessons about the religion of God from the words of the domestic animals and wild beasts. Because the tongues of all the children of Adam are engaged in the talks of bread, water and treacheries. It is possible that animals might be talking of other matters like the matters relating to the time of passing off from the world.
H. Musa told him: “Turn away your mind from this desire, as it has great dangers before and behind you. Seek lessons and awakenness from God and not from books, words and movement of lips.”

The young man became all the more anxious upon H. Musa’s warning as it is human nature that man wants to do what he is prevented from doing. He said: “O Musa, ever since your light appeared, everything that existed since, has got something from you. Do not keep me deprived of this desire. You are a generous person. It does not suit to you to refuse to accept my request. These days, you are the representative of God. If you deny my request, I shall be put to hopelessness.”

H. Musa said to God: “O God, I am afraid, the accursed Satan has put this peculiar desire in this simpleton’s heart. If I teach him that, it will cause great loss to him; and otherwise, he will be heart broken”. God said: “O Musa, teach him that as we do not ever reject a prayer.”

H. Musa said: “O my Lord, he will feel many sorrows. He will bite his fingers and tear off his clothes. Getting authority and power is not suitable for everyone. Weakness is a better investment of the pious, as poverty brings about pride that is never lost, as it is the poor hand which holds on to piety as it is not capable of doing anything bad”.

That is why wealth, and the wealthy are always condemned as it is not possible to hold on to self-control and patience when they have the authority to do certain acts. Humility and poverty provide peace to man; but nafs full of greed and worries is troublesome. Unwanted desires enter into the rich man’s heart which put him into unnecessary cares, which make him a prisoner of Satan. One who eats clay desires for clay. He will not desire for the sweetness of sugar.

chapters.title: Authority Bestowed to Man
chapters.subtitle: Inspiration to H. Musa from God to teach a little of want he wants

sections.heading: Man Alone Has Authority
paras: God told Musa: “Fulfil the desire of that man and open up his hands on the sought-after authority. Authority adds salt to obedience and makes it tasty as without its own authority even the sky is rotating. Its rotation does not provide it godly rewards or punishment as in the case of man, because at the time of counting of man’s acts by God (on the day of resurrection), it is his authority that is taken as the standard of good and bad. The entire universe is celebrating the praises of God by implicit obedience. But that praising and obedience is compulsorily ordained upon them. They cannot disobey as they have no authority, and therefore they do not get any reward for obedience. Give the sword in his hand, and put an end to his helplessness, so that he may become a victorious soldier of God or a dacoit.

sections.heading: Use/misuse of Authority
paras: It is due to the authority bestowed upon him that man became worthy of being considered in the category of those “we have honoured” (karramna) as stated in the Quran: wa laqad karramna bani Adama wa hamlnaahum fi albarri wa albahr: we have honoured the sons of Adam. We carry them on the land and sea: (Bani Israil: 17: 70). Half of him is a honeybee and the other half is a snake. The faithful with good deeds are like the bees possessing the mines of honey and the rejectors are like the snakes possessing the mines of poison; as the faithful nourish upon good plants, so much so, even their saliva is like the saliva of honeybees and becomes the life-giving water. The rejector has drunk the juice of pus, so much so, even his food creates poison in him.

Those who receive inspiration from God are the fountains of the water of life; but those who have polished themselves with vicious desires are deadly poison. All praises, appreciations and commendations in the world are due to the exercise of authority, its exhibition and caution. All the wreckless going into the prison of hell, also become pious, disciplined and callers of God, but this is not with authority but under compulsion. As they lose authority after death, these acts of theirs are unworthy. Be careful to hold on to your authority during your lifetime, as your authority will be snatched away by death.

Be careful! Your authority is the investment for profit. Take care of the time of authority and see that you ride upon the white horse of “karramna” (we have honoured), and the reins of this horse are in the hands of wisdom.

Thereafter, H. Musa again advised him with all affection saying that the achievement of his desire will make his face go pale. “Give up this madness and fear God. Satan with his mischief has taught you this wrong lesson. Be careful! Do not purchase this headache as your desire will put you into hundreds of difficulties.

chapters.title: Cock Eats Grain but Not the Dog
chapters.subtitle: The Youngman’s remaining contented with the language of domestic rooster (cock) and dog and H. Musa’s conceding

paras: The young man said: Teach me at least the language of the dog which is at my door and of the domestic cock which is a lazy bird. H. Musa said: “Alright you will know the language of these two.”

Next morning as a verification, he stood at the door waiting for their talk. His maid brought the dining sheet and shook it, whereat the left-over piece of bread of the last night fell. The cock fell upon it and took it away like a pawn broker taking away the pawned material. The dog said to the cock: “You have committed cruelty upon me. You can eat a grain of wheat, but I cannot. I can eat only a bread of wheat. You can eat other grains also, but I cannot. This piece of bread is my share of food and you have snatched it away.”

chapters.title: Animals Foresee Some Events
chapters.subtitle: Rooter’s reply to the dog

paras: The rooster said: “Do not talk so much and keep quiet! Because God will provide a better thing than this. The horse belonging to the master will die tomorrow. You may eat its flesh to your full satisfaction. Death of a horse is the feast for dogs. It provides plenty of food without putting efforts and work.”

When the master heard this; he sold out his horse and the helpless rooster felt ashamed before the dog. The next morning the rooster snatched away the piece of bread as earlier and the dog said to it: “O rooster, you treacherous liar, you speak such lies. You are cruel, liar, and unreliable. Where is that horse about which you said it would die. You are a blind astrologer. You cannot see the stars and are deprived of the truth.”

The well-informed rooster said: “His horse died, but in a different place. The master sold out the horse and saved himself from loss and put it on someone else. But tomorrow his mule will die, and it is a great gift for dogs only”.

Hearing this, the greedy master sold it out and got rid of the sorrow of loss. The third day the dog told the cock: “O leader of the liars telling lies along with the beating of drums and time proclaiming bells. How long do you tell unacceptable lies? You are incompetent, and just like butter milk without any worth and nothing else. The rooster said: “That master sold out the mule all of a sudden. But tomorrow his slave will fall sick. When he dies, his relatives will spread breads like water on dogs and beggars.”

Hearing this the master sold out his slave, saved himself from loss and brightened his face in joy. He was thankful and happy that he was saved by three tragical events of the time. Ever since I have learned the language of the rooster and dog, I have put stitches on the eyes of misfortune.

chapters.title: Gains Provided by Losses
chapters.subtitle: The rooster’s feeling ashamed before the dog for making of three false promises

paras: Next day, the dog who was deprived of food said: “O blabbering liar, what happened to your predictions? How long you cheat and lie? Nothing but falsehood can fly out of your nest.

The cock said: “Impossible! It is beyond me and my community to tell lies! We are like the truthful Muazzin, the caller to salaat from masjids. We are the ones who keep their eyes on the sun and search for passing time. Wherever hidden may be from the sun, we watch and take care of its movements, even if you keep us under an inverted trough of water.”
In fact, it is the Aulia (saints) who have a constant look at the sun. They are the knowers of the secrets of God among men.

“God has created us to announce the time of prayer at dawn. We have been given to man as a gift for this purpose. If we are forgetful of this duty of calling for prayer, it becomes a cause for us to be slaughtered. Untimely call of “come toward goodness” entitles our community for disgrace and slaughter. Of course, cocks also commit mistakes. Those who are sinless and who do not commit mistakes are none other than the prophets, and saints; and that cock (Jibra’iil) who is the carrier of messages from God.

That slave who was sold by our master died after purchase by his new master. It was only his loss. Our master saved his property, but actually he has shed his own blood. One loss becomes an eliminator of many other losses. Our body and property are a releaser of our soul. In order to seek justice from kings you pay money (fine?) and save your head. As you are ignorant of your fate, you try to hide your wealth from God, because you feel that if your wealth is sacrificed for your sake, it is not a loss but gain.

chapters.title: All Acts, Done for Gain
chapters.subtitle: Cock’s information about the master’s death

paras: The cock continued: “But be sure the master is definitely going to die tomorrow. His heirs are going to slaughter a cow in his sorrow. The owner of the house will die and go away. Tomorrow you will definitely get fat food. Distribution of breads, clothing’s and feedings will be done in the street for all and sundry. Meat of the sacrificed cow and soft bread will be provided generously to the dogs and beggars. Death of the horse, mule and slave was a turning point in the fate of this inexperienced fellow. He ran away from the loss of property and pains. He increased his wealth and shed his own blood”.

sections.heading: Every Act Done for Gain
paras: Saintly people undergo physical struggles because they think torture of the body gives lasting life to the soul. So long as the one on the path of God’s knowledge, does not know about the lasting life, he would not think of the sicknesses and deaths of the body. A man will not even shake his hand for his own and others good, unless he is sure of getting a recompense for his soul. God is the only one who gives without expecting a reward or profit in return. Know this very well: it is God and God alone or a true friend of God who has adopted this quality of God who has also become a light and developed absolute brightness. Because he is free from needs. All others are destitutes. Destitutes never say take this without the hope of something in return. Until a child sees an apple to get, he will not throw the foul-smelling onion. All these people go to the markets and sit in their shops only in the hope of making money. They spread many beautiful things to attract the buyers to make profits. You will not hear even of salutations, which will not hold your hand to get salutation later either from the elites or the masses, which are not in the expectation of something. Wassalaun: (Now you may take my salutation).

sections.heading: Salutations Also for Gain
paras: The only salutation without expectation is from God alone. Be sure to search for it at homes, streets and all places. I have heard salutation from the mouths of Godly persons from whom I have heard the message of God and also the salutation of God. I hear from among the common people also which is highly fragrant. I hear it with all my heart and soul which is very dear to me on the hope that some among the common people may be of the type of Godly men. His salutations become those of God as he has set fire to his personal disqualifications. He is dead for himself and alive only for God; and within his two lips hidden are the secrets of God (which two lips upon meeting and separating from each other speak of these secrets). Killing of one’s body through worship and austerities is the real life. The tension of the body straightens up the soul.
The ill-natured master of the cock was hearing with all attention what the cock was telling.

chapters.title: Dangers Foreseeing
chapters.subtitle: That persons running to H. Musa for refuge upon hearing the news of his death

paras: When he heard of the news of his oncoming death, he ran fast to the door of H. Musa. He rubbed his face on the ground for his help in the matter. H. Musa said: “Go and sell of yourself and get relief, just as you sold other would-be-dying things. You have become an expert in this job. Jump out of the well. You may cause loss to the Muslims and fill up your purses and bags with money. I had seen this result from behind the wall, which could be seen by you in the mirror. A wise man see’s the end in the beginning itself through his heart what one without wisdom, sees in the end.”

Thereafter that man wept and said: “O good natured! Do not hit me on the head and put my face in shame. What I have done is totally unworthy but give me something worthy to recompense”. H. Musa said: “O my son, your arrow has left the bow and it is not the practice of God to return it to its earlier place. But I shall pray to the greatest of the just to see that you carry your faith with you; because if you go to Him with your faith intact, you are very much alive. It will be enough if you go with your faith intact.”

While this was being told, the master felt uneasy and was about to vomit. People brought the bowl for him to vomit. This was a disturbance of death in him and not a vomiting caused by indigestion. The latter vomiting gives relief but not the former one. Four persons took him to his house on a stretcher and he was rubbing his calf upon calf. You did not take the advice of Musa and took it lightly and hit yourself on a steel sword. The sword does not feel shy to taking your life. O my brother, this alone is your fate.

chapters.title: No Help Against Fate
chapters.subtitle: H. Musa’s prayer to keep his faith intact

paras: During the morning prayer H. Musa prayed to God. “Do not snatch his faith from him; show generosity and forgive him for the mistake, carelessness and excesses he has done. I had told him that this knowledge does not suit, but he ignored my words and thought them as lacking sense. That man should try to catch the python whose hands can make it a stick. Knowledge of the secrets should be had by one who can stop speaking by stitching his lips. Only the water birds should enter water”. This much is enough for him to think over. Had God knows best. That fellow entered into water when he was not a water bird. He sank. O God help him.

chapters.title: Hard Work Pays
chapters.subtitle: God’s acceptance of Musa’s prayer

paras: God said: “Yes, I have granted him his faith. If you like I can as well give him back his life. Rather all the dead ones of the earth can be given their life if you so want”. H. Musa said: “This is a destructible world. Take them to that world which is bright. This is not a lasting world. It is temporary and to be left off. It does not give benefits. Bestow your mercies on those who left this world, when they will be brought before you. That is what you have said: all will be brought before us: ladaina muhdarum: (Yaseen: 36: 32).”
I tell you all this to know that the loss of the body and of wealth is a gain of the soul, which is saved from troubles. Therefore, work hard, crush your body with austerities.

You will gain many things by keeping your body engaged in hard work of both this and that world. If you put your body into hard work without your intention, be thankful to God, as this also gives benefits to you. It is a matter of fortune if you get some hardship of the body, which becomes like unintended austerities. The result of both intended and unintended hardships is the same. Though you have undergone this with intention, it has happened under the command of God of Be (kun) as stated in the Quran: “Be, it became”: kun fayakun: (Yaseen: 36: 82). Think and be thankful that you were chosen specially for this. Command of kun and its results fayakun.

chapters.title: Rewards by God for Losses
chapters.subtitle: Story of the woman, whose children did not live: her complaint to God; and its reply that it is a recompense for your struggles

paras: Now, hear this story and hold on to the lesson therein so that you may not feel desperate upon pain and losses.

A woman gave birth to a son every year which did not live for more than six months. Who would die within six months? She wept and complained to God: “There is a grievance. I undergo nine months of pain and get a pleasure for three-four months. My gifts pass away sooner than the rainbow in the sky. She also used to present the grievance before the Godly people. In this way she got her twenty children imprisoned in the graves. There was great burning and fire in her heart.

sections.heading: Tangible Heaven Similitude of Green Garden
paras: One night she saw a paradise in a dream with unlimited number of fruits. I have wrongly spoken of a tangible thing like garden for a non-tangible gift; and green coloured one for an everlasting guest house. As otherwise, there would not be a reference to a garden, as that garden is such “which no eye has seen” as the noble Prophet has said in a Qudsi Hadith(s) through which God has said: I have kept ready for my noble servants that which is not seen by any eye, not heard of by any ear, and not passed through any heart. This, I have done on God’s own saying: His divine light as one like a lamp for the understanding of the people as He has said: the similitude of His light is as if there were a niche and within it is a lamp: masalu nurihi kamishkatin fiha misbah: (Nur: 24: 35). This is not a comparison but only a similarity so as to enable a confused person to see a means to understand.

sections.heading: Loss Here, Gain There
paras: Anyway, upon seeing this, that fragile woman felt inebriated. At its brightness she got into semi-unconsciousness. She saw a palace with her name written on it making her feel that it was hers. Then she heard a voice: “This gift belongs to one, who was bold enough to seek nothing but God”. One has to worship very much in order just to have a breakfast here. As you were not very enthusiastic in making supplications (after worship), God has given you troubles to recompense those deficiencies.”

She said: “O God, give me such trouble for a hundred years more and cause my bleeding.” When she entered further into that garden, she saw all her children. She said: “They were lost to me but not to You, my Lord. No man has been without two hidden eyes to see the hidden matters. You did not remove your blood by cupping, but God washed out blood through your nose that was in excess to protect you from other sicknesses. The pulp of the fruit is better than its rind. Consider your body as your rind and the pulp (soul) as your friend. Man after all, has a very strange pulp; and make a desire for it for some time.

chapters.title: Bravery in Battle Field
chapters.subtitle: H. Hamza’s coming to the battlefield without helmet

paras: During his youthful days H. Hamza, the Prophet’s uncle used to go for battle always wearing a helmet and coat of mail. But during his old age while going for jihad he was going without these protections and dashing upon ranks of the enemies and fight like euphoric with enthusiasm. With his chest open, body without coat of mail, he used to be in the front lines and pounce himself in the midst of swords. People asked: “O Prophet’s uncle, O destroyer of the ranks of enemies like a ferocious lion, and the king of the dashing braves, have you not read the message of God: and do not with your own hands put yourselves into destruction: (la tulqu bi qydikum ila tahlukati: (Baqara: 2: 195). Why do you put yourself into destruction in the battlefield? When you were young and hard, with heavy bow, you were not going before the enemy ranks without protections. When you have become old, weak and bent, you are singing songs of carelessness. Without care and caution, you are showing your valour into the battle with only the sword and spear. You know that the sword does not show any respect to the old man; swords and arrows do not have this kind of distinction between old and young. How can it be reasonable for such a lion like you to be killed mercilessly by the enemy?”
Not knowing of his inner spiritual condition, his sympathisers were advising him from out of their experiences.

chapters.title: Death: Stepping Stone of Next Life
chapters.subtitle: H. Hamza’s reply to the people

sections.heading: Death Is End or Beginning as One Takes
paras: H. Hamza said: During my youthful days, I considered death as departing from this world. Who goes towards death with pleasure? Who goes armless before the pythons? But, now with the light of Muhammad, I am not bound to this destructible world. Keeping myself away from this material world of senses, I see the army of the great King (God). I see the soldiers of God full of His light. I see the tents under tents and ropes within ropes of the tents. I thank the Prophet for waking me up from my dreams to see the secrets of the world, invisible to the eyes. The persons who think of death as destruction, may hold the command of la tulqu bi aydikum ila tahlukati (do not with your hands put yourselves into destruction). But for those who consider death as the opening of the door for the other world the command is: “Be quick in the race”: saari’u ila maghfiratin min rabbikum; wa jannatin arduha alsamawati wa al ardh: Be quick in the race for forgiveness from your Lord, and for a garden whose width is that of the whole of the heavens and earth: (Al Imran: 3: 133).

Those who consider death to be the end of everything should ignore this and run to God with due care to seek forgiveness from Him. This is death or end for them; but for the other, it is an invitation. They consider it to be a blessing. Those who consider it to be a calamity should mourn over it. Whoever that looked at the handsome Yusuf sacrificed his life for him and one who took him as an ugly wolf was deprived of guidance.

sections.heading: Death Appropriate According to Acts
paras: Know that the death of everyone is similar to his own self. It is a friend for the friend and enemy for enemy. It depends upon how one takes it. Like a mirror, it shows a beautiful face to the Turk; and for the black man it becomes black. One who fears death and tries to run away from it, should know that he his fearing himself. It is your face that frightens you and not the face of death. Your life is a tree and death is only like its leaf. It grew from you, whether it is good or bad. It is good or bad upon your heart because of you only and out of your own cause. If you are injured by a thorn; it is a thorn that is grown by you only; and if you are in silk fabric, it is because they are made by you.

sections.heading: Results of Acts Need Not Be the Same
paras: The results of acts are the acts themselves. What is rewarded for service is much lower than the award and gift. Payment for labour is not made by another labour. Act is a substance, and its accident is payment in terms of money. The labour is hard work, expending of human energy and shedding of sweat and the reward is silver, gold and money. If there is an accusation against you from someone, it is due to the curse of someone troubled by you. You say that you are innocent of the offence and have not made any such accusation against anyone. It may be so. But you have committed some other crime and received this accusation as a result of that crime. For example: you sow the seed, but you do not get the seed itself, but you get the fruit which does not resemble the seed. You committed fornication for which you do not get another fornication as punishment but a hundred lashes. But you say: I have not lashed anyone a hundred times. These lashes are a punishment for the sin, which are not similar to the sin.

sections.heading: Fruit Different from Seed
paras: The serpent did not resemble Musa’s staff. Pain does not resemble the medicine. Similarly you put semen in the womb, but it came out as a perfect human. This semen either became a good son and friend or a vicious son and enemy. The semen does not resemble your son. Sugar has no resemblance with sugar cane. When someone put the seed of bowings and prostrations, they became a paradise. When someone flew the praises of God with his mouth, the lord of cleaving asunder separated these praises and converted them into birds of heaven. Your praises and recitations were not like the birds; nor the semen of the birds had anything to do with air and winds. In spite of all this, they became birds. When you give something to others, it is as though you have planted a sapling of date palm there.

sections.heading: Heavenly Streams of Water, Milk, Honey and Wine
paras: The water of your rectitude becomes a stream of water in paradise; your friendship and love for others is a stream of milk; your taste of worship is a stream of honey and your pleasure and intoxication in goodness may be seen as a stream of wine. The cause of these streams is not the same as those very streams. No one knows as to why they have been kept there. As their causes were at your command, all these four streams are also obedient to you. In whichever direction you want to go, they will proceed. You take them on the same respective, qualities, according to which they came about. (That is, the stream of milk was a result of your love and friendship. Therefore, you take this stream toward love and friendship; and so on with others).

Your semen is under your command. Its product, i.e., your children also come under your command. Your son runs as per your directions, thinking that he is a part of you that was kept in his mother’s womb as a pledge by you. As the cause of these four streams were under your command in this world, they will also be there under your command. The trees there will also obey you, because they are also full of fruits because of your qualities. That is to say that, as these qualities were under your command in this world, and they are the rewards of your acts, they will obey your commands there also.

sections.heading: Punishments in Hell: Fire, Scorpions Etc
paras: Similarly, when an injury is caused to someone by you here, it becomes a tree of Zaqqum, (a thorny tree that produces bitter poisonous juice), which becomes your food. As you set fire in the hearts of others with your wrath, you become fuel for the fire of hell. As your fire caused burnings to others here, and whatever that came out of it also caused burning, your fire goes to other men and burns them there also. Those words of yours that caused bitings to others become similar to scorpions and snakes there, and bite you and suffocate you. You had kept your friends in waiting, and so you will also wait for your release from torture and suffer the pains of waitings.

Your breach of promises to do things on the next day again and again, become the cause of the knowing of your result on the next day and the next repeatedly, and make you anxious continuingly on that long day under the soul-melting-heat of the sun and accounting process. You had made the sky also wait for long by sowing the seed of ‘I shall do tomorrow’, which you said every day. Your anger is the seed of fire and hell; be careful to cool off the net of this fire.

sections.heading: Destruction of Fire
paras: Destruction of this fire is not possible without the light of faith. It is reported in a Hadith(s) that when a faithful man passes upon the bridge of siraat, the fire below asks him to pass off fast as its fire is getting cooled by his cool light. I am thankful to my guide whose light of faith has cooled down the fire of my anger. If instead of this light of faith, you try to cool your fire of anger with your own self-control, your fire does not extinguish fully but only remains hidden under the ash which may get into life any time. Your effort is only a lid and the moment it is shaken it is opened. There is no other way to extinguish this fire by anything other than the light of faith. Do not remain satisfied until you see the light of faith as otherwise the fire of anger kept under control by other means may rise up anytime. Consider this light is water and connect yourself with water, in which you will not have to fear the fire.

sections.heading: Saints and Pseudo Saints
paras: Water extinguishes fire; and fire by its very nature sets fire to the children and descendants of water which are animals and plants. You may go to the water birds for sometime so that they may give the water of life. And they are none other than the saintly men. But be careful, there are two kinds of saintly men in appearance. One is of the earthen character and other of the water character. They are opposed to each other and they are like oil and water. Both of them proceed upon their character. Their physical appearance will put you into confusion. One is a saint and the other is a pseudo-saint.

sections.heading: Difference Between Insinuation and Inspiration
paras: They are similar to inspiration and insinuation. Both of them are based upon wisdom and they are intangible. They cannot be felt by any of the five senses of seeing, hearing, tasting, touching and smelling. But there is a great difference between insinuation and inspiration. Insinuation is an indirect or devious hint or suggestion from satanic sources, but inspiration is a stimulation or arousal of the mind from Godly sources and is a product of the promise that all men had made before God when He had asked them, whether He was not their Lord. They all had said: “Yes. We do testify”; as stated in the Quran: Alastu bi rabbi kum? Qalu balaa; shahidna: Am I not your lord: they said: yes. We do testify: (A’araf: 7: 172). Both are like the sellers in the market of heart (consciousness), who are praising their products to attract men toward them. If you are a dealer of the purity of the heart like the verifier of gold, think over what they say carefully. And also like a seller of slaves, who knows the profitability, ability of each of the slaves before fixing their worth and value. If you cannot immediately determine the difference between them, take time like a buyer in such circumstances who takes three days to agree for purchase. Do not take them in haste and proceed thereupon, so that your life may not be put into difficulties. And you and your family may not be at loss.

chapters.title: Care in Dealings
chapters.subtitle: How to avoid loss in sale and purchase Slow Progress best and natural

paras: A companion of the Prophet (Munqad b. Habban) told the Prophet: “I face losses in my (commercial) dealings. Whoever sells me or purchases from me plays a trick with me, as though through a magic spell; and misguides me”. He said: “In a dealing you feel to be suspicious, make a condition of three days time for approval as delaying is from God and hastening is from the accursed Satan”. When a morsal of food is thrown toward dog, it first smells it and then eats. It feels with smell, and we have to feel with experienced wisdom.

These heavens and earth were brought into existence in a slow manner in six days by God, even though he had the ability to create them instantly by saying Be(kun) and they would have come into existence: (fayakun). That great Lord makes a man perfect in a slow manner at the age of forty, even though He has the ability to bring up fifty persons with one breath from non-existence into existence. Jesus with one blow of one breath used to make a dead man alive instantly. Cannot the Creator of Jesus instantly bring forward ranks and ranks of men.

The slow path is for the purpose of educating you as anything has to be sought in a slow and systematic manner. A narrow stream continuously flows without getting polluted and becoming dirty. This slowness increases prosperity and pleasure. It is like an egg and wealth is like a bird. The bird has no similarity with egg, even though it is born out of the egg. Wait! So that your parts may develop like the egg and finally bring out a perfect bird. Though the egg of a serpent is similar to that of the sparrow, but they produce entirely different creatures. You know that the letter Seen, and Sheen are similar to look at but the dots make them different. The seeds of greengage and apple are similar to look at, yet they are very much different in yield. Leaves appear to be similar in colour, but the fruits coming out of them are different. The parts of men are similar, but everyone has a different body. People going about in the market are the same, but some go with ambitions and some with troubles.

In similar manner we walk toward death in similar manner, but half of us are in loss and the other half go like kings. These talks have no end and let us talk later. Let us talk about H. Bilal and the crescent now.

chapters.title: Death Is Return Journey
chapters.subtitle: H. Bilal’s dying in pleasure and joy

paras: When H. Bilal due to weakness became thin like the new moon, the colour of death fell on his face. His wife looked at it and cried saying: “I am being looted”. But H. Bilal said: “No, no, it is an occasion of pleasure. Till now my life was in difficulties. But you do not know what a great comfort is death and what it is”. He was telling this and his face was blooming like the flowers of narcissus rose and lilac. The charm of his face and his sparkling eyes were certifying his words.

sections.heading: Black Iris, Most Important Part
paras: Every black-hearted fellow saw Bilal’s dark colour not knowing that blackness is not vicious. Iris of the eye is black and the most valuable. A blind person has a black face of misfortune and a man with bright eyes is like a mirror of the moon. O Bilal, who can understand the worth of this iris of the eye, excepting the Prophet who was increasing the light of the iris. And also his companions. No one else could know the worth of this iris, which being black is the worthiest part of the body. All others, than the Prophet and his companions knew of Bilal’s worth only upon hearsay like the great qualities of this iris. They knew his worth as they knew the worth of iris.

sections.heading: Death: a Means of Union with Beloved
paras: His wife said: “I am getting separated from you, the one of great character. He said: No, no, this is not a time of separation but of union”. She said: “You are going away like a lonely traveller from the family and getting hidden from all relatives”. He said: “No, no, today my life is going back after a journey to my own country”. she said: “How much grief and pain I feel today”. He said: “No no. It is a great pleasure for me to go back”. She said: “Where are we to see your face”. He said: “You can see me in the assembly of the friends of God. God has said in the Quran: fi maq’idi sidqin inda maliikin muqtadir: in the assembly of truth in the presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent: (Qamar: 54: 55). This assembly of the special friends of God is connected with you. This, you can see if you raise your sight above you and not below. In this assembly, the light of the lord of the worlds shines so bright as the gem does on a finger ring”. She said: “The house has turned into a ruin, and he told her to look at the moon and not at the clouds.

chapters.title: Death Provides Life to Others
chapters.subtitle: Wisdom behind the destruction of the body after death

paras: Man’s body was destroyed to bring about greater population as there were more men and the accommodation was limited. Like H. Adam, I was distressed, but with my progeny my life has filled the east and west. I was a beggar, and my house was narrow like a well, but when I became a king, I needed a palace. Then my soul could live in my small body, but when it became aware of its potentialities by knowing the secrets of life, it needed a large palace. But those with their narrow life who are like the dead, a grave, and a house to live in is enough.

This world was narrow for the prophets and therefore they left this world like kings and went to the large expanse of the other spiritual world. This world is a place of grandeur for the dead souls, which in appearance in very large in size, but in fact it is very narrow. Had this world been wide and large, there would have been no quarrels for its occupation. One who lives in for long time becomes bent at the waist, showing that his house is very small, and he cannot stand erect. When a man goes to sleep, he forgets the world and so he is happy in sleep: the cruel fellow gets rid of cruelty; and the prisoner forgets the pains of prison. Though this world and the sky appear very large, but if you pitch a tent, you feel it to be very narrow. This wide world causes great narrowness of mind. Its laughter is crying, and its honour is disgraceful.

chapters.title: Happy and Unhappy People
chapters.subtitle: Similitude of the world as apparently wide but in fact narrow and of the sleep as relief from narrowness

paras: When you enter into a hot bathroom, you feel uneasy, even though it is long and wide. Its heat causes pressure and disgustion on you. Until you come out of it, you do not feel pleased. This shows that long wide place is not a cause of pleasure.

Or you are wearing a tight shoe and moving about in a large forest. But because of the tightness of your shoe, the large size of the forest and open land appear like a prison to you. Whoever looks at you from a distance feels that you have bloomed like a lilac in the forest. He does not realise that from outside you appear like a cruel fellow who appears happy outwardly, but deep inside your soul is grumbling. You get relief only when you remove your shoes as your soul would be free from this hardship. Similarly, a man in sleep is as though he has removed his tight shoes.

For the Godly people (aulia), sleep is like a kingdom of comfort just as the people of the cave were in great rest for years together. From the worldly point of view, they were in sleep, but they were awake in the other world.
