paras: Such a magic is hidden within you, as there is a permanent magic through insinuations. Where there are such magicians within you, there are also their antidotes. Where there are poisonous plants in the forests, there are antiseptics too. This antiseptic is possessed by the saintly who tell you to shield yourself from poison, as they say: “I am closer to you than poison.”

What these insinuations say is a magic causing loss to you. My words are also magic, and they reverse the spell of bad magic. The noble Prophet has said: “Certainly, there is magic in spoken words”. This great leader’s statement is very great. This magical statement is a spoiler of the magic of magicians and it is a wealth of the antiseptics. These are the statements of the prophets and saints, which are entirely devoid of the material sensual demands.

The sum and substance is i go away from the poison of the lowly Nafs and drink fast carefully the antiseptic provided by the guide. Shatter the impacts of the inner magic of the Nafs and create holes toward the treasury of the perfect guide. This talk requires great elaboration; Let us go to the starting point of the guest of the mosque. Leave it and come toward the mosque and narrate the story of that guest.

chapters.title: Advice: Also in Self Interest
chapters.subtitle: Repeated advice of the preventers to the guest of guest-killing-mosque

paras: The people told him: “Do not show your bravery gentleman! Do not bring accusations against us and the mosque. If an enemy tells the Qazi tomorrow, out of enmity for us, you will be putting us in fire. He will tell the Qazi that some cruel fellow throttled and killed this hale and hearty man by taking him into the mosque as an excuse and put the blame on the mosque it is well known for killing those who sleep in it. This, he has done to keep himself free of the charge of murder. Therefore, O brave man, do not become a cause of accusations against us as we are well aware of the designs of enemies. Take care! Do not show your boldness and engage in foolhardy deals. Sky cannot be measured in terms of yards (or meters). Many like you have boasted like this and ultimately put themselves to shame. Better go away. Put an end to these arguments. Do not put us and yourself into trouble.

chapters.title: Petty Fears Do Not Frighten Strong Men
chapters.subtitle: Reply of the guest, by citing the examples of a guard of a farmland who wanted to chase a camel with the help of a tambourine upon whose back battle drums of Mahmood were beaten

paras: The guest said: My dear friends, I am not among the devils whose steps would be weakened by your recitation of La howl once (No strength other that with God). A young boy who has guarding the farmlands, used to beat a tambourine to fly away the birds. The bird’s would fly away and the farmland protected. When the graceful Sultan Mahmood went on that way, he set up a large tent, with such an army of many soldiers who matched the number of stars on the sky, well organised, destroyers of the ranks of enemies and conquering of countries. There was a camel of a good pedigree which carried the war drums and marched in front of the army with great sound. Day and night, and at the time of marching and return, the drums used to be beaten. That camel came over into the farmland and that boy, to protect the wheat crop, started beating his tambourine.

A wiseman passing by told him not to beat the tambourine, as the camel is a carrier of war drum and it is accustomed to loud sounds. What is the worth of tambourine for it? It is a carrier of a drum twenty times as large as your tambourine.

Citing this example, the guest continued: “I am a lover who has sacrificed himself for the world of non-physical (spiritual) existents. My life is a drum house of difficulties. Your warnings to me are like the tambourines as against the difficulties that I have seen. My friends, I am not among those who go away from their path merely on imaginary troubles. I am among those followers of H. Ismail, who do not fear anything. I shall get my head severed off just as H. Ismail had done to meet the command of God by his father Ibrahim. I do not have any desire of grandeur and ostentation.

sections.heading: Sale and Purchase for Profit
paras: “He told me to come (qul ta’aalaw) as stated many times in the Quran. The noble Prophet has said: “While giving loan to someone, that man has shown generosity and grace, who believed in its return in the next life.” One who sees a hundred times of return, goes very fast in giving to others. People are held up in the markets so as to give over their materials to others to earn profit thereof. Another has kept money in his purse waiting for it to be given to another in order to gain profit by purchasing something thereof. Another loves to protect his commodities, but when he sees that the commodity by going out of his hands, gives him profit, his love for the commodity goes, and he sells if off. He keeps his material with him so long as he does not see profit in its disposal. It is with profit in view that he loves the commodities.

sections.heading: Love of Artisanship and Professions
paras: This is the case with knowledge, artisanship and other professions. They are loved only because they provide gains. It is not out of the love of these. So long as they do not become more lovable than life, they are kept up. As otherwise life is more lovable. When they appear to be better than himself man takes the risk of his life, to get them.

sections.heading: Child’s Love for Dolls
paras: A lifeless toy is the life of a child until the child becomes old enough to love himself and procure living children. These thoughts and imaginations are like the dolls and they are needed so long as you are childish. When your soul passes off childhood, such thoughts and imaginations vanish.

I do not have those secret knowers with whom I can share my secrets. Now, I remain silent on this, as God knows better as to who are in consonance with Him. Materials and life are like ice, which are being melted by the laws of destruction. God is their purchaser as He has said: Inna Allah ashtraraa min almuminina anfusahum wa amwaluhum bi anna lahumu aljannata: God has purchased of the believers, their persons, and their goods, in return in the garden of Paradise. (Tauba: 9: 111). This melting ice and getting obliterated is better than the profits, but you doubt this betterment. You will know its worth only if God provides confidence.

sections.heading: Suspicion, Knowledge, Certainty, Sighting, Observation
paras: You have a strange suspicion in you which makes you mean, which does not fly toward the garden of certainty. You should know, O young man, every suspicion is thirsty for certainty, which flaps its feathers and wings to fly high towards progress. When it reaches the stage of knowledge it gets settled; and then his knowledge makes it run toward certainty. Thus, there are three stages— starting with suspicion it reaches the stage of knowledge and then onwards to certainty. These are the time-tested stages: knowledge is higher than suspicion but lower than certainty. Be sure to know that knowledge searches for certainty, and certainty again searches for sighting and in-depth observation.

Search for this in Surah Takassur (102) by noting “laow ta’lamuna” (were you to know) after the word ‘kalla’ (But, nay). The full context is: kalla sawfa ta’lamuna, summa kalla sawfa ta’lamuna. Kalla low ta’lamuna ilma alyaqini, latara’unna aljahima summa latara unnaha aina alyaqin (Ayats 3 to 7).

This Surah, Alhakumu altakasuru (Rivalry in worldly increases, distracts you) insists upon the words ilm, (knowledge), ilmaalyaqin (sure knowledge) and aina alyaqin (behold it with sure vision. That is progressively from knowledge to sure knowledge and from sure knowledge to sure vision.
The translation of five ayats cited supra (3 to 7) is as follows.

Nay, 2) Nay, but you will come to know 3), again: nay but you will come to know 4) Nay, would that you know (now) with a SURE KNOWLEDGE. 5) For you will behold hellfire 6) Yes, you will behold it with SURE VISION.

Know this O man of knowledge, knowledge takes one to vision and if one attains certainty, one gets the vision of the hell. Vision comes without any obstruction after certainty, just as idea (thought) comes from suspicion. You may now be certain from this surah that certainty of knowledge leads to certainty of vision.

So, saying the guest continues: “I am above suspicion and certainty. By any amount of your condemning me, my head does not rattle. My mouth has swallowed the sweet, my eyes have brightened, and I have seen everything. When I enter into my house, I go with full confidence and without anxiety as I can see it with full sight. My steps do not shake as there is no fear at all. God commanded the flower, and it bloomed and laughed and similarly He has made my heart a hundred times bold. I have been tall and straight like the cypress, and fragrant like jasmine and sightful like narcissus. He has made my life and soul sweet like sugarcane and made my mud into the city of Chagil of Turkistan which has beautiful residents and expert archers. He has made my eyebrows sharp and piercing and my face red like the beautiful pomegranate flower. He has taught a hundred magic spells to my tongue and my ears are pure like the gold of the days of Jafar Bamakki which is well known for its purity. When I opened my magazine of arms the mischief of my eyes became sharp like arrows and made it mad of the love of sugar and sugary things. I love the one who is the Master of all properties and every wisdom and soul owes its origin to Him. I am not boasting; and if it is boasting, it is worthy, because it is capable of extinguishing fire like water.

“How can I steel anything from His treasury when He is watching it? And when He is behind me, I should not consider myself as quite strong. One who is warmed by the sun’s heat is very strong he neither feels shy nor fears. He is like the sun itself which burns. His enemies and also protects. This is all due to grants of the sun. And the prophets have been bold on the support of God being capable of destroying the armies of enemies, all alone. A prophet does not turn his face aside out of fear or sorrow but pounces upon the enemies all alone. Stones are hard and fearless, and they do not fear the lumps of mud. Stones are made by God while lumps of mud are made by men.

“Their opponents are like sheep and countless, but the butcher never fears them. The prophet is like a shepherd who protects the sheep. You are all like flocks of sheep and the prophet like the shepherd. The shepherd also does not fear the sheep but protects them from all good and bad situations. If the shepherd shouts at the sheep, it is due to his love for them. This is so with the prophets.”

The guest further continued: “New fortune tells me that even if it gives some pains to me, I should not grieve. I make you cry and grieve so that you may remain hidden from the bad people. I cause irritations in you out of sorrows in order that vicious sights may not fall on you face. God further tells me: if you are in love with Me, you should crave for Me. You are My servant, and you should be obedient to Me. You think of coming closer to Me as you are helpless in your separation from Me. Your pain struggles to search for a meeting with Me. Yesterday, I had heard your cool sighs of separation. I can, as well show you the way to come to Me, without the anxiety of waiting, so that you may get out of the whirlpool of the world and step into the treasury of My closeness.

But the pleasure of sweetness and tastes of meetings come after underdoing the pains of journeys. What you get without efforts is also given over by you to others in an easy way. What is obtained with difficulties remains closeby and is held strongly. You will enjoy the return to your friends and city, when you return after undergoing pains of journey. Therefore, my dear young man do not run away from difficulties. Hear this narrative as an example and recognise your status.

chapters.title: Pains Are Prelude to Success
chapters.subtitle: Citing the example of the peanut’s anxiety and disturbance in a vessel on a burning stove, and its efforts to come out of the vessel just like the hurry and anxiety of the faithful man to get out of difficulties and the housewife’s preventing the peanut from going out

paras: Look at the peanut in the pot, which jumps up from the low level in boiling water, out of the disgustion of heat. It comes up again and again as the heat increases and makes a hundred cryings, though asking the housewife: “why she has put it on fire. You have bought me for a price from the market, but you are destroying me”. The housewife moves fast the ladle saying: “No. Take more heat and do not run away from the one who has set the fire. I am not heating you for the reason that I hate you, but in order to make you soft and delicious; so that you may become food and get mixed up with life. This trial is not to degrade you.”

sections.heading: Sufferings Lead to Elevation
paras: You were drinking water when you were fresh and green in the plant. That drinking was for the purpose of getting heated in the fire. There is a Qudsi Hadith(s) as per which Allah says: “My benevolence is prior to my wrath.” (Rahamati sabaqat ghadabi). His benevolence is prior to wrath so that the object of benevolence may become fit for trial. This is also for the reason that: one may possess the needs of existence. Also, for the reason that skin, and flesh cannot be formed without benevolence. If these do not come into existence, there is no scope for one to fall in love with anything to suffer melting in the heat of love. So also, that, when troubles come as a demand of love, you may sacrifice that wealth of existence. So also, that God may grant benevolence again as a recompense for these troubles telling: you have now cleaned yourself of all dirt, you may now get into the stream.

sections.heading: Great Rewards for Sacrifices
paras: The housewife continued: You have taken all benefits of the spring season as a grant of God’s benevolence. You may take this pain of burning for a guest and serve him; so that the guest may thank you and report to the Lord of your sacrifices for him; so that instead of the grant, the Lord of the Grants may Himself come to you; so that all other grants may feel jealous of your great status. I am like Ibrahim Khilal ullah, you are like my son Ismail, and I have got the knife and ask you to give me your head. I say that I have seen in my dream that I sacrifice you. inni arani azbahuk as stated in the Quran. H. Ibrahim said: “O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice you. So, look at what you think”. He said: “O my father! Do that which you are commanded to do. God willing you will find of steadfast.” (Saaffat: 37: 102).

“Therefore, with all your mind and satisfaction of heart, you may place your head before me for this torture so that I may cut off your head as done to Ismail. I am cutting off your head, but this head is one, which cannot be cut off, as this is not killing, but giving a lasting life. By this cutting, I am giving you a lesson of total submission to, and consonance with God. In this manner, you should become a submitter to God as should be the submission of a Muslim. O Peanut, undertake the taste of this heat so that you may lose your life and yourself entirely, and you become one to live with God. Your earlier situation was pleasing. You were smiling in the garden. But now you are a flower of the garden of life and sight.

sections.heading: Evolution from Low to High Level
paras: “When you were separated from water and mud of the garden you became the food of man and entered into the living beings and now you may become the food and power of these thoughts. You were only soft milk earlier and now you may become the lion of the forest. Thus, you get elevated to the highest level of man. You were a product of the work of man, and you become one like him to produce other things. You have come out of the water of clouds and energy of the sun from the sky. All these have contributed for the growth of plants and now all these have entered into man with you and become a part of him. You came from the character of rain and sunshine, and now entered into a cleaner character. From the level of sun, cloud and stars, you have become a part of the spirit, acts, words and thoughts of man. The life of animals comes with the death of plants. That is why, in order to get everlasting life, Mansur Hallaj said: “Kill me my friends. There is a victory in our defeat”. He further said: “Kill me as there is life after getting killed.” In the game of chess, the loss of all pawns except the king is considered as half defeat. But when all others are lost, but only the king remains surrounded by enemies in such a way that he cannot move, it is considered as full defeat.

“True acts and words become the food of the angels and they reach the heights of the heavens. Similarly, the morsel of food that becomes man’s food gets elevated from the level of dead minerals to the higher level of living beings. The detailed explanation of this fact will come some elsewhere (later). Caravans of the souls come down from the sky for earning good or bad in the world and going back. Therefore, you may go back in a nice manner with a happy face and not like a thief with bitter and forlorn face.”

sections.heading: Bitter Words Cause Betterment
paras: The housewife continued: “I tell all these bitter things so that you may get rid of your bitterness. The grapevine becomes frigid and cold in actions due to excessive heat of the season, but becomes hot and active, when cold water is provided to its roots. With my bitter talk you become angry and hot and get fully rid of your bitterness. One who does not show patience in troubles will not attain the status of pride before the abode of pride. A man’s showing patience upon hearing bitter things is like the putting of vinegar in honey, in which case vinegar becomes sweet like honey. A dog wearing the belt of ownership of a hunter, becomes an honourable hunting dog instead of being a loafing one. Only those who undergo troubles become worthy just as raw grains become soft and delicious, after getting cooked.

chapters.title: Comforts Cause Disobedience
chapters.subtitle: A man becomes faithful (mumin) upon knowing the secret of patience upon troubles

paras: The peanut said to the housewife: If that is the truth my honourable lady, give me more and more of heat and help me to get elevated, as you are making me worthy by heating me. Hit upon me with your ladle as you hit very well. I am like an elephant. Hit upon my head and injure it so that the elephant may not dream of its native country, India and its forests which excite it. When it is out of India, upon which its tamer hits upon it, and brings under control. So that upon getting heated, I may offer myself to troubles to find out the way to success. Man also becomes arrogant when he has no fears and cares. He becomes rebellious like a dreaming elephant and refuses to obey the master.

chapters.title: Incapables Get Misguided by Quran
chapters.subtitle: Housewife’s speaking of the wisdom of cooking to the peanut and seeking its pardon

sections.heading: Up and Down Progress
paras: The housewife said: “Earlier I was like you as a part of dead earth. When I put on the dress of the fire of love and beauty, I become acceptable and worthy for others. For a long time, I was cooked from outside and for a long time I was cooked within the vessel of my body. With these two cookings I got the power of senses and then I became a soul, so as to become your teacher to teach you the qualities of things and inner meanings. When I was in the condition of minerals, I told myself that I am progressing from this low level, so as to get the knowledge of matters and become one with soul. Similarly, I tell you that when you also become the animal soul of man and again get boiled to pass on from the level of animal soul to still higher levels.

But be careful and pray to God to make you realise these points in depth, so that you may not think that just as you have progressed from material level to the level of man’s soul, you can progress further to become one with God’s essence for the reason that may people have been misled to believe like this. Many people get misled through the Quran itself. This is a rope to go higher but they held it and went down into a well. There is no fault in the rope in this regard. When they got misguided by the Quran, they are liable to be misguided by my Math(s)navi. They got down into the well, because they did not have capacity to go up.
Now let us go back to the narration of that uncontrollable lover (of God) who put himself under trail in the mosque.

chapters.title: Misunderstandings About Math(s)navi
chapters.subtitle: Continuation of the narrative of the man-killing-mosque and the guest’s determination and holding on to truth

paras: That guest, searcher of the upper world said: “I shall sleep in this mosque. O mosque, I want to see whether you can became the place like Karbala for me where Imam Hussain was killed, or you will become Ka’ba for me to fulfil my desire of meeting God. O my advisers, permit me to sleep in the masjid and allow me to play with the rope on the scaffold as Mansur Hallaj played and got killed. Even if you are so important to me just as Jibra’iil was when he wanted to protect H. Ibrahim from Nimrod’s fire, I shall not accept your support. O you people anxious to help me like Jibra’iil, I tell Jibra’iil to allow me to get into fire like ambergris so as to spread my fragrance all around. O my friends like Jibra’iil, though you are helping me and protecting me like brothers, know this well that I am very fast in fire and my soul is not that, which would get reduced or increased in worth. Animal soul of the man that develops and progresses with food, is itself fire and it gets destroyed like fuel. If it were not like the fuel of passions and wrath, it would continue for ever and also influence others to live for ever. Consider this fuel of passions and wrath as a burning wind emanating as reflection of fire and not as fire itself. The real fire is in the sphere of fire and what is seen on the earth is only its effluence: and naturally effluence is not lasting due to its instability, and soon it returns to its place of origin. Your tallness is due to your stability; but your shadow becomes long and short at different times; as your shadow has no existence of its own, but dependent upon you; and therefore, it returns to you.

Let me be careful and talk no more on this. Mischiefs have already started. What is the right path is known only to God? Mischiefs have destroyed the world. East to west people have become victims of anxieties. When truths have stopped coming sufficiently to the heart from all sides, everyone is in fight against the other. I have said very much and now I am silent. I accepted their suggestion and stopped talking, as many people raise objections on my Math(s)navi as a useless job. Yet, if you ask me about the reasons for the mischief, and the grief in the people’s mind. I would explain the reasons for mischiefs.

chapters.title: Comments on Math(s)navi and Quran
chapters.subtitle: To explain how people of lesser sense start speculations

paras: Well before the story of the guest to that mosque ends, jealous people have raised smoke and stink against the Math(s)navi. I am not grieved at this, but I am afraid that these remarks may impact wrongly on the minds of simpletons. That wiseman from Ghazni, Hakim Sanai has said very well, which is a good citation for the deniers of truth. He said: “If they see nothing but words of the Quran, there is no reason to be astonished; because a blind man does not get any light from the sun but gets only heat.” A foolish man brings out his hand from the stable of donkeys and starts raising taunts, saying that: “This Math(s)navi is a lowly version of the prophets and their followership. It does not contain any discussions on high level mysteries and their clarifications upon which the aulia (friends of God) may march forward from their seclusive life to the state of annihilation in God, in a step-by-step manner. It does not explain about all states and stations in the matter of sulook (elevation towards God), so that a curious enthusiast may fly with the feathers provided by the masters. Everything is nothing but stories and non-sense for the children having no inner and outer wisdom.”

When the Book of God (Quran) came, similar remarks were made upon it by the kafirs that it has only old stories and narratives without any depth and fresh information. Only children can understand them, and there are only commands regarding appreciable and condemnable matters. There are references to Adam wheat grains, devils and snake, and to Huud, fast wind, Ibrahim and fire. Narratives of Noah, ark and deluge. And of Kan’an and of the people, turning the faces against the commands. There are stories of Isma’iil, his sacrifice and Jibra’iil and the intentions towards Ka’aba and elephants. There is story of Yusuf and his curly tufts; and of Yaqoob, Zulaikha and their sorrows. There are the stories of Bilqis, Sulaiman and the people of Sabaa, and of Dawood, Zabur and Ooria; and also, of Taloot, Shuaib and his fastings; and of Yunus and Luut, and their peoples. There are also stories of Maryam, her Pregnancy and fastings, labour pain and date palm and of Zachariah, John and the gardens. And also of Saleh, she camel and distribution of water, and of Idris and Uzair and his death; and of Qaroon, earth and his getting buried in it. And of Ayub and his rectitude in miseries and of the Israelites and their wanderings in the unfertile land of Tia. And of Musa, the mount of Toor and his staff, his removal of shoes, addresses of God and His grants. There is also the story of Jesus and his elevation upon the sky; and of Zulqarnain, Khizr and Armia. Then there is also a narration about the excellence of Muhammad of very great character and his miracle of the splitting of the moon in two parts. All these things are known to everyone. But where are the statements in it which would make the wisdom get lost in them.
But the Quran says: All these things appear to be easy to you, O speaker of the great matters. And also challenges all Jinn’s and humans and great men to bring out one ayat of such easy matter.

chapters.title: Seven Hidden Meanings of Quran
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of the Hadith(s): inna lilquraani, Zahiran wa batanan wa libatnihi batnun ila sab’ ati’abtunin: Quran has apparent and hidden meanings and its hidden has further hidden meanings up to seven hidden meanings

paras: Know this that the words of the Quran are apparent, and within them there are dominant hidden meanings. And within each of this hidden meanings, there is another which make human thoughts and sights astonished; and in this manner there are seven hidden meanings. Under each of the hidden meaning there is a third in which all wisdoms get lost. Nobody has gone up to the fourth excepting the unexemplifiable and partnerless God. [Scholars and researchers have gone up to some levels but with differences of understandings as per their knowledge; and some have attained different grades according to their levels of understanding of God. But all these meanings, interpretations and grades are not to be opposed to the apparent words of the Quran. Hazrat Ali used to go to such deeper levels that other companions of the Prophet used to be astonished — Qazi Sajjad Hussain]. Therefore, my dear gentleman, there are seven hidden meanings, which may be counted from this hadith(s).

Therefore, do not go simply after the apparent, as Satan had seen Adam as nothing but clay. The apparent of the Quran is like the human body, the marks of which are visible, but his soul and his qualities are hidden. Even his uncles living with him for a hundred years cannot see his inner qualities and soul.

chapters.title: Difficulty to Know Man’s Inside
chapters.subtitle: To explain that prophets and saints make resort in the hills and caves not to hide themselves, nor out of the fear of the people, but to guide the people on the right path, and encourage them to discard the world to the extent possible

paras: People say: Those called as the friends of God are settled in the hills so that they may remain hidden from the people. But it should be known that even while being among the people, they are above a hundred hills and they keep their feet on the seventh heaven. Then, why should you search for them in these hills. Their hills are far beyond hundred rivers and hills. There is no need for such great men to run away toward the hills. They are being searched by the heavens whose heavenly horses have got their shoes broken. The sky moved around, but it could not reach even the dust of their soul and accepting its failure it has put on the black mourning dress. There are fairies who are hidden from man’s eyes, but man is more hidden than the fairies. The hiding of the fairies is not that strange, as the hidden qualities of man. Wise men know that the fairy is a hundred times more hidden than man. When it is so difficult to know the hidden qualities of ordinary men, think of the qualities of H. Adam, who has the selected one from among those of the hidden, upper non-material world.

chapters.title: Cloud of Dust Has an Army Within
chapters.subtitle: Comparison of the face of the aulia with the staff of Musa and of their words with the breath of Jesus Christ

paras: Man is like the staff of Musa and also like the breath of Jesus. For the purpose of giving and decorating, the faithful man’s heart is between two fingers of the hand of God whose position is altered again and again by God. The same was the situation in respect of the staff of H. Musa and breath of H. Isa. The staff of H. Musa is just a piece of wood externally, but when it opens its mouth, the whole world becomes a morsel for it. Do not see the breath of H. Isa as wind and sound, but see that death ran away from the dead man. Do not see the soft sound of his breath but see that the dead man got up and jumped. Do not consider Musa’a staff as something obtainable umbrella easily, but see that it is the one which tore the chest of river Nile. You see a black from a distance, but when you go nearer to it you will see an army of potentialities under it. From a distance what you see is only dust. As you go nearer, you see troops on the march. The dust raised by the army brightens the eyes to show brave soldiers who can turn the hills upside down. When H. Musa came from the boundaries of the forest, the mount of Tur danced in pleasure to welcome him.

chapters.title: Accompaniment of Hills and Birds
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of the ayat: Yaa jibaalu awwibi ma‘ahu wa altair (O, you hills and birds echo his psalms of praise)

paras: H. Dawood’s face brightened with the grace of God and hills cried out after him. Hills became the chorus for his songs, and all of them were intoxicated with the love of the King, when the command of:”O you hills accompany him” came to them. All sang tighter in chorus. This was because God had told Dawood: You are a lone traveller, and your heart is filled with the fire of the enthusiasm of love. You needed co-singers and a gathering. I shall bring hills before you to sing with you, so that they may sing and play instruments for you, and they please you with music. So that you may know that: when hills can create sounds, saints also produce sounds without the movements of their lips and teeth, and the songs of their soft bodies reach His ears every night. Those sitting beside them do not hear, but He hears them. That soul deserves blessings which loves the unseen objects. They feel hundreds of sounds within themselves which others do not hear. You have got hundreds of questions and answers in your heart, which come to you from the world of non-existence (beyond space) to you. You alone hear them with your inner ears, but others cannot hear even if they bring their ears very close to you. O deaf man, I know that you cannot hear, but at least when you see such things, you ought to believe. But even you do not do.

chapters.title: Sincerity Needed to Know Quran and Math(s)navi
chapters.subtitle: Answer to the critics of Math(s)navi

paras: O finder of faults, moaning like a dog, do not make a way for finding fault in the Quran. It is not a lion from which you can save your life; or protect your faith from the powerful grip of its hand. You dare not comment upon the Quran. Therefore, comment behind the Math(s)navi, which explains the Quran. O group of those sacrificing themselves upon their ignorance, know this, that the Quran is giving a call till the doomsday that: “you consider me to be a story, to sow the seeds of fault finding and rejection. Those of you who were finding faults have seen that they got obliterated and became a story of the past. I am the word of God and exist with the essence of God and the food of the spirit and a clear ruby. I am the light of the sun that is shining upon you; and yet I am not separated from the sun. If God’s essence is like the sun, its light is like its attribute. They cannot be separated. I am the origin of that pool of the water of life and whoever drinks its water falls in love with it and gets rid of death. Had not your greed spilled this kind of filth you are spilling, God would have sprinkled a little of its water of life upon your graves.
I am not going to stop writing this Math(s)navi yielding to the weak critiques of these people and turn myself away from this great job.

chapters.title: No Attention to Senseless Comments
chapters.subtitle: Example of a foal’s baby stopping to drink water upon the whistling of the trainers

paras: As that philosopher Sanai of Ghazni has said: a mare and its calf were drinking water. A group of horse trainers were whistling to make their horse’s attention to drink. The calf was also hearing this whistle, raised its head and tried to run away. Its mother asked: why you avoid drinking water and try to run away. It replied: “These people are whistling, and I feel frightened. When their whistles joins together and become louder, I get frightened and go out of control. I am afraid of the joining together of their sounds.”

Its mother said: “Ever since this world has come into existence, there have been people who do silly things. O my dear prosperous son, ignore them and attend to your own job. Shortly they will feel ashamed of their acts. Time is short and water is flowing fast, do drink before your joints get separated due to thirst and water gets exhausted. This is Karez, a stream which is specially made by bringing underground water overground to supply water to farms and gardens.”

Drink the water of life from the pond of H. Khizr. This is a life-giving water; do drink it. Words of the friends of God are also like the water of life. Do not be deprived of them. If you cannot see water due to your blindness, use your wisdom to find it out. Sink your vessel into water if you have heard of the existence of water in the stream. When a blind person cannot see, he should follow those who can see. Sink your suspicious heart like goatskin in water, so that you may know of its getting filled up through its weight. When you feel the weight, you get convinced of the existence of water. Then you will not be in need of blind followership. You have got the evidence of experience, because water of the stream has entered into the vessel. Earlier, it was light and now it is heavy. Then, your heart will not be satisfied with blind followership. Though the blind person does not see the stream, but he recognises the stream through the weight of his vessel, because water of the stream entered into the vessel and increased its weight. The vessel also says that earlier it was getting disturbed by the wind and now it is not so, as its weight has made it stable. Foolish people also get disturbed by any play of the wind as they do not have the strength of weight.

sections.heading: Search for Inner Light
paras: A mischievous fellow is like a boat without anchor, and he cannot be protected from the effects of the wind and is liable to get misled by anybody. A saint and teacher are like an anchor for the boat. For a wiseman, his wisdom acts like an anchor which protects him from disturbances. Therefore, you should try to get the support of wisemen to act as your anchors. When one gets the support of wisemen, one’s wisdom generously gets pearls from the treasury of his wisdom. In this manner your heart becomes full of capacities to progress and progresses further so that your eyes too become brighter.

This is for the reason that the light of wisdom first enters into the heart and goes toward the eyes. If the heart becomes sick, eyes also become sick and lose brightness. If the heart gets control over the lights of wisdom, it provides light to both the inner spiritual and the outer physical eyes. When this happens, water of prosperity starts from the heavens making the heart fit to receive inspiration and explain things in true manner.

We shall also drink water from the stream like the calf of the mare and shall not cast our eyesight on the fault finders and devilish insinuations. You are a follower of the prophet and proceed on the search of truth through their path. Consider the taunts of the faults finders as just blows of wind. Such of those masters who have passed through the paths, of the prophets have, never cared for the barkings of the dogs.
Then, speak of that clean hearted lion like a man who wanted to sleep in the mosque and also as to what all he found there and what all he did.

chapters.title: How Satan Frightens
chapters.subtitle: Remaining narrative of the Guest and the mosque

paras: That man went to sleep in the mosque, but how could he get into sleep? How can one sunk a stream and get sleep? Lovers sunk in the water of sorrows cannot sleep, like the fish in water and birds in flight. At midnight a frightened voice came: “I am coming, I am coming upon your head.” This voice came for five times tearing his heart into pieces.

chapters.title: Satan’s Power on the Weak Only
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of Ayat: waajlib alaihim bi khailika wa rajilika, wa shaarikhum fii alamwali wa alawlaadi, wa maa ya’iduhum al shaitanu illa ghururu: “make assaults on them with your cavalry and your infantry; mutually share with their wealth and children; and make promises to them. But Satan promises to them nothing but deceit. (Asra: 17: 64)

paras: [the unseen voice only frightened the guest. It was not something which would actually happen. Satan only frightens.]

When you take a decision to do some religious act, Satan frightens you from within your body itself, telling: “O misguided fellow, do not go that way. Think well. You will become a victim of poverty and difficulties. You will be deprived of friends because of your poverty; become helpless, disgraced and anxious.”

With the announcement of this accursed giant, you get frightened, and your determination takes reverse movement into misguidance. You will think: let me postpone the good act to tomorrow or the day after tomorrow, as there is plenty of time before me. Though you see death on your right and left dragging your neighbours, when loud sounds of cries come about from the dead man’s relatives, with the fear of death. You again decide to do the good act by considering yourself to be dead for some time. Then again you resort to protect yourself with the weapons of wisdom and knowledge that you should not delay in the commission of the decided good act.

Again, Satan treacherously gives a call to you with the sword of poverty, and warns you to revert from the decision. Then, you run away from the path of light and throw away your weapons of wisdom and knowledge. With this voice of Satan you continue to be his slave for years together and continue to live in darkness. In this manner the frightening voice of Satan has tied the people with him and choked their throats so that they do not eat the food that can give them spiritual force. This continues so much that their soul loses all hopes of attaining Godly light, just as the rejectors meet their death and enter into the graves.

When this is the impact of that accursed fellow, what can be the impact of God’s voice. You do not get the impacts of God’s voice, because you are not worthy of it. The fear of the falcon is felt by the pigeon. Housefly has no share in this fear, because the falcon does not prey upon the housefly. Houseflies are preyed upon only by petty spiders. The spider of the devil has impacts upon the flies like you, but not on the pigeons and falcons. The calls of the devils are the shepherds of the unfortunate weak flocks of sheep but the voice of the King is the protector of the aulia (saints), so that the blind do not mingle with the seers, and saltish water of the seas may not mingle with sweet water.

[Had you been worthy, you would have heard the voice of God just as the pigeon fears the voice of the falcon. But because you are mean like the fly, you respond to the voice of another weakling like the spiders. The devil’s voice has impacts upon the weaklings but not upon the strong Godly people about whom Quran says: Inna ibaadi laisa laka alaihim sultan: As for My servants, you shall have no authority over them: (Asra 17: 65) — further elucidation by Qazi Sajjad Hussain]

chapters.title: Meanings of Gold, Fire and Light
chapters.subtitle: Hearing of voice by the Guest in the guest-killing-mosque.

paras: After knowing about the impacts of devil’s and God’s voice, now hear about that harsh voice to which that brave fortunate guest did not respond. He was not shaken by it. He said: “Why should I fear this sound of drum beatings, which are beaten to announce the joys of the festival. It is the drum which should fear, because it is receiving the beatings. Even if it is a drum beating to announce death, Godly people feel happy with it as it is an announcement of their meeting with God. Therefore, O empty drum like fellows deprived of heart, in the celebration of the announcement of the festival of death, your share is nothing but beatings. Doomsday is a day of festival for us and the faithless are like drums. They receive the beatings, but we will be smiling like flowers.”

Now, you may further hear: when the empty drum gave its frightening sound, it actually declared how delicious foods of the festival are prepared in large vessels. Hearing this sound, that brave man said to himself that there was no need of fear at all but only of happiness. He told himself: “Be careful, do not allow your heart to shiver, as only the faithless, heartless fellows yield to such bragging’s. Time has come when I should conquer the country or fly away from my body.” He jumped up and shouted: “O bragging wrestler come to me, if you are bold enough. I stand before you to meet you.”

With this challenge the magic spell of that voice broke and there was a down pour of varieties of gold scattering all around. There was so much of gold that, that young man started fearing that it may reach up to the door and the way for him be closed to get out. The whole of the mosque got filled with gold and the guest was astonished at the schemes of God. Then, that brave lion got up and started removing out the gold till the morning. He buried the gold, and again removed gold, so that he filled up in the bags and felt much for those who missed this wealth out of their blindness and fear. This gold was not the metal gold, that can be seen by the eyes, but which came into the heart of every mean, greedy and blind fellow, which he did not value.

sections.heading: Wealth Is What You Consider as Wealth
paras: Children break earthen pots and call the earthen pieces as gold and fill up their pockets and play games with them. In the game of the world when you speak of the word ‘gold’, children consider it to be their pieces of earthen pots. Similarly, when gold is spoken of, worldly people consider this as metal gold. The gold that is found in the mint of God is so pure and everlasting and is the same for all. It means the radiances of the Lordship upon the hearts. Its worth, brightness and grandeur last forever and cause others also to be bright and grand. It makes one ever rich and contented and brighter than the moon.

That mosque was like the lamp and he was like the moth, which was sacrificing its life. He got his wings burnt, but he became much more worthy and prosperous. This fortunate person was like H. Musa, who saw fire in the direction of the tree. There were many grants of God upon H. Musa. He had taken what he saw as fire as light which was, in fact, light. As H. Musa was in need of fire, God projected His light as fire to call him to His attention. Therefore, when you see a Godly man, you see only his human qualities as human fire. What is seen in the Godly man is the seer’s own qualities. Fire, thorns, speculations and wrongs are seen by him in this direction. He sees in him what he himself is. That was H. Musa’s himself as tree full of light that he saw. Do not call it as fire but call it as light and be satisfied.

To understand the difference between fire and light, consider this fact that discarding of the world appears to be difficult and burning like fire for the searchers of God in the beginnings but becomes light for them later. Similarly, the fire from the lamp of the faith is higher than other fires. On the contrary, the worldly lamp appears to be light, but it sets things on fire. But the heavenly fire, though appears as fire, is in fact light, and acts like a flower. That is, the fire of love is fire from a distance but a flower for the lovers of God, and it brightens their heart. It appears as mass of burning fire, but it is a decorative clear light of the heart. For those who go nearer to it is light and those far away it is fire. There appears no end to this discussion. Now let us go to the narrative of lover of Sadar Jahan.

chapters.title: Love Begets Love
chapters.subtitle: Meeting of the Lover with Sadar Jahan

paras: Just as the guest of the mosque had decided to sacrifice himself for love, that man of Bukhara also set himself close to the flame of the lamp. But this trouble became easy for him because of his love. His hot sighs had reached the heavens resulting in love in the heart of Sadar Jahan who used to say to himself in the mornings: “O God, what is the condition of my man who has ran away from me and roaming about here and there. He committed a wrong, we found it out, but he failed to properly understand our regard for him. A person committing a wrong fears us, yet his fear contains hundreds of hopes. Of course, I frighten a shameless and foolish fellow. But how can I frighten a fellow who gets frightened on his own?

“Fire is set under the cold pot to heat its contents, but when it becomes hot and the contents boil, fire is pulled out from underneath. I frighten the non-fearing with my wrath, but I eliminate the fear of the fearing ones by consoling them. I put patches and stitches wherever it is required; and provide drinks appropriate to them as required in their circumstances. A man’s inside is like the root of the tree from which sprout its stem and leaves. Appropriate leaves sprout from the tree. The same is the situation in respect of wisdom and inner feelings of men as in the case of trees and branches. The fruits of sincerity of the trees reach up to the heaven, as stated in the Quran: asluhaa sabitun wa fari‘uha fi alsamaa: whose root is firmly fixed, and its branches reach to the heavens: (Ibrahim: 14: 24).”

sections.heading: Love Creates Love in Beloved’s Heart
paras: Accordingly, when the fruits of love have sprouted in the heavens, why not in the heart of Sadar Jahan. The waves of pardon were flapping one after one in his heart, as there is passage from one heart toward another heart. There is a way from one heart to another heart linking both but not two bodies which are different and distant. Just as of two different lamps are burning separately, but their lights are mingled in their expanse. There is no lover who alone is in search of the beloved’s company, whose beloved also is not in search of him. But only difference is that the lover becomes weak and slim in love, but the beloved becomes strong and fresh.

When the lightning of love strikes in the heart for another, be sure that it has happened in the other heart also. When the love of God doubles in your heart, it certainly means that God also has love for you. The sound of clap does not come unless two hands meet each other for the common purpose. A thirsty man cries and craves for water, so also water cries to seek someone to drink. It is the love of water that creates thirst in us, and we are for it and it is for us. The wisdom behind predestination determinism and free will is this attraction for each other which decides the fate and powers everyone. It is because of this eternal command that everything in the world is in pairs and each one loves its partner pair. Everything in the world desires for a partner exactly like the gum (kahruba) which, when brought near the scraps of grass, pulls them like magnet pulls iron.

sections.heading: Sky and Earth as Husband and Wife
paras: Sky tells the earth, welcome, come to me, I am like iron for magnet. If we think over, sky and earth are like husband and wife as earth takes care of everything that is poured upon it by the sky. When earth is in need of heat, sky supplies it. So also, where wetness and coolness are required, the sky grants to the earth. Different zodiacal constellations supply spheres of dust, wetness, clouds to earth; and even harmful vapours are absorbed by the sky to protect earth. Heat is provided by the sun which is red hot like a frying pan on both of its faces — front and back. Sky provides the needs of the earth as a husband provides for the wife. So also, the earth creates and takes care of the creatures just as the wife does for children. Sky also is busy in rotation as the husband does to earn for the wife. Therefore, take the sky and the earth as actually concerned with each other and perform their jobs as sensible persons do.

sections.heading: World Cannot Go Without Opposites
paras: Had not these two lovers been enjoying each other’s company, they would not have penetrated into each other like couples. Where can anything grow other than on the earth? What can grow out of the heat and light of the sun? Just as a woman would be without childless without man, earth without sun would be so; and sun would have been children without earth. That is why there is an inclination of the male and female toward each other so as to meet the purpose and completeness of each other and to continue the purpose of creation. Everything of the world is attracted toward another and their contacts create other things. Night embraces the day even though they appear to be opposite to each other. Both of them work for a common purpose. Everything loves the other as it loves itself to act to complete its job with the help of the other. Had there been no night, there would be no rest and refreshment to make earnings during the day.

chapters.title: Struggles of Four Elements Create Sickness
chapters.subtitle: Every genus drags its species which is engaged with species of other genera in the body of man due to love

paras: Four elements— earth, water, air and fire of which everything is made up, are in tussle with each other within the body of man. Earth tells the earth (mud) within the man’s body to give up connections with life and come back to earth like dust. You are of not of our genus, and it is better that you are with me. Therefore, leave the body and fly back toward me. But earth within the body says: What you say is good; but I am bound with others and feel the pangs of separation. Water of the world searches for the moisture in the body and tells it: you are separated from me. Come back to me. Similarly, the fire outside tells the body’s heat to adopt its original way and follow it.

There are seventy-two sicknesses in the body because of the ropeless pulling against each of the four elements. Sickness comes to tear apart the body so that the elements may separate from each other. These four elements are like birds tied in their legs which can be untied through death, sickness and pain. When these untie the legs of each other, the bird of every element will fly off. The attraction of these genera and species causes sicknesses in our bodies every moments to break this bondage to make the elements to fly off to their original place. God’s wisdom prevents them from doing so and drags them together till the time of death. It tells them: “the time of death is known only to Me and your fluttering before that time is of no use.” Every element wants to go back to the place of its origin. Imagine, how anxious the soul may be because of its separation from the place of its origin, particularly because of its being so sensitive also.

chapters.title: Original Place of Soul
chapters.subtitle: Attraction of the soul to the world of spirits

paras: Soul tells: O my earthly parts, my journey with you is very bitter as I belong to the world of spirits (empyrean). The inclination of the body is toward greenery and flowing water as that is the place of its origin. The inclination of the soul in towards everlasting life and the Hayy and Qayyum, the living and self-subsisting God. Its original place is the world of non-material existences (la mankan – beyond space). The inclination of the soul is toward wisdom and knowledge; and that of the body is toward gardens, farms and grapevines. Soul’s, inclination is toward nobility and progress and of the body toward food and drinks. The inclination of nobility and love is also toward the soul. It loves them and they love it similar to what God has said: yuhibbubhum wa yuhibbunahu: whom He will love and they will love him (Maida: 5: 57). This indicates that just as the soul is inclined toward the Creator, so also the Creator is inclined toward the soul.

If I explain in detail about this aspect, this Math(s)navi will need eighty maunds of paper. The sum and substance is that whoever desires for something, the soul of the desired one also desires him. Man, animal, plant and minerals are after some, such lowly objects. Undesirables go toward undesirable beloveds, and those undesirable beloveds drag them toward themselves. But love makes the lovers weak and humble; but the love of the beloveds makes them more beautiful and grander. The love of the beloveds brightens their cheeks, but the same of the lovers sets fire to the souls. Kahruba grass also, loves the scrap of grass but without any concern, but the beloved scrap of grass covers a long distance to meet it.

sections.heading: Reciprocity of Love
paras: Now leave this matter at this level and think of that man from Bukhara whose thirst of love shined brightly in the breast of Sadar Jahan. The smoke of love and the grief of the furnace of love reached the lord and made him concerned for him. But his honour, pride and status came in the way of searching for his beloved. He felt ashamed of expressing his love for that runaway man. His mercifulness had made him to go for him, but his kingship prevented him from showing that kind of kindness. Mind gets baffled to know as to whose attraction attracted whom. It is the Sadar Jahan’s love or the other man’s love that impressed upon the other. Stop further talk on it as you are ignorant of all this. Shut your mouth as it is only God, who knows this secret. I always shut my mouth to avoid speaking on such matters. I repent for a hundred times for somehow telling a little un-intentionally on such matters. If I say that God creates love in the hearts of the lovers to speak of His own love, common people will think that God is in need of our love and is dependent upon it. I would bury all this talk. Yet I am helpless. It is He who drags me to speak out of something, sometimes. I determine not to talk, and it is His power only that shatters my determination.

sections.heading: Who Breaks Man’s Determination?
paras: You go on accumulating so many things. But who it is that is dragging you do this? Why does he not leave you to do as you want but compels you to do that He wants. You make a hundred decisions, but He takes you in another direction. He turns the reins of the horse in all directions so the inexperienced horse may know the rider. An experienced horse is on a suitable speed as it knows that there is a rider on it. God has attached you with two hundred thoughts, then caused you failures and injured your heart, so that you may know His power. Some gnostics have said that the wish of God was understood by them through the cancellation of their decisions. When one wing of the decision was spoiled on the first occasion, only then the authority of the spoiler became known. When His decision broke the rope of your determination, how then can you say that it was not done by Him. Your programmes are destroyed by Him to make you know of His authority.

chapters.title: Obedience Under Compulsion and Volition
chapters.subtitle: Causing alteration and cancellation of decisions is to make man know that God is the Master and Dominant; and not cancelling sometimes and their implementation is to make man’s nature to act according to decisions; and again, break his decision so that he is warned again and again

paras: Your intentions and objects come to your expectations sometimes, in order to give intentions to your heart. At another time your intentions are not fulfilled. Were you to be kept totally disappointed you would have no hopes and desires. If he were he not to have any hopes at all, he would never have come to know of his humbleness? Wise people come to know of God upon their failures. Failures have led them to the paradise. Know this well, that the paradise is surrounded by undesirables as the Prophet said: huffati al jannatu lil makaarihi. If the objects of the people are not achieved, there must be someone who would meet with his objects. This has discouraged the truthful people. But lovers are an exception. They never lose heart. Wisemen become desperate due to their helplessness and they continue to do so. But those in love with God feel that there can be no desperateness but keep quiet due to their own volition and submissiveness. Wisemen are slaves of helplessness, but the lovers are not so. They voluntarily stop doing things. “Both of you may come under compulsion” (iitiya karhan) is the rein of the wise; “but both of you may come voluntarily” is the rein of those in love, as stated in the Quran: he told the sky and the earth: “come you together willingly or unwillingly”. They said: we do come together in willing obedience: Faqaala lahaa wa lilardi itiya taw‘an aw karhan, qalataa ataina taa‘eina: (Ha-mim: 41: 11).

chapters.title: Prisoners Get Angry
chapters.subtitle: The prophet’s looking at the prisoners, smiling at them and saying: Ajibtu min qowmin yujarruuna ila alljannati bissalasili wa alaghlali: “I wonder when people are dragged toward paradise in chains and handcuffs”

paras: The prophet saw a group of prisoners being taken away and they were crying. That awakened lion looked at them, and the prisoners were also looking at him with downcast eyes. But every one of them was angry, biting his teeth and lips upon the true Prophet. Inspite of this anger none was dare enough to rise up as they were all in the heavy weight of chains. They were being taken by the soldiers toward the city from the land of infidelity. They were thinking: “neither he takes ransome nor money; nor any intercession from any leader. He is called as the ‘mercy of the world’ but he is cutting the throats of the people”. They were all moving with all reluctance and making taunts upon him under their lips. They were thinking: we made so many designs, but none came to our rescue. His heart is no less hard than a rock. We are all thousands of brave lions, but are now in the hands of two three half naked lazy weaklings. We are so helpless. It is all due to our own wrongdoings, or the impacts of the stars, or maybe we were under a magic spell. Our good fortune is torn by his fortune and our throne got upset by his throne. If we take this as an impact of his magic, we also had done magic. Why was not our magic effective?

chapters.title: Defects of Infidels and Mumins
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of ayat: “in tastaftihu faqad jaa’kumul alfathu” (O unbelievers: if you prayed for victory and judgement now has the judgement come to you: (Anfal: 8: 19). Enemies were telling grant victory to us or to Muhammad, whoever is on the right path. This they said under the impression that they were on the right. But now, Muhammad, the selfless seeker of truth is victorious

paras: We had prayed to our idols and God: Uproot us, if we are on the wrong; and support him or support us, whoever is on the right and truth. We had made this supplication with praises before Laat, Uzza and Manaat that, if he is on the truth, promote him and if not, get him defeated at our hands, . But they see in clarity, it is he who is victorious and in light and they in darkness. This is your answer to our prayer that what you desired has come about and we were wrong.

Then they made counter argument to say with their cleverness that even this thought of ours is due to our misfortune, to destroy our morale to set the thought of his truthfulness in our hearts. If he is victorious on some occasions, it is not something to worried about. Time can make anyone victorious. We have also been fortunate and won victories on many occasions. Again, they would counter argue, his defeat was not like ours; it was not disgraceful and bad. His good fortune gave him a hundred hidden joys in the defeat. He never felt like a defeated person as he was neither grieved nor worried. The identity of the mumins is in their defeat as they feel that there is betterment in it for them as it would make them better, just as, if you break the container of musk and ambergris, the entire atmosphere becomes fragrant. On the contrary if you scatter the donkey’s dung the stink spreads to all houses nearby. None can think of the musk as of the donkey’s dung. So also, none can think of urine as water and the silk as jute. Therefore, considering the defeat of mumins as the same as that of the infidels is wrong.

chapters.title: Defeat, an Augur for Victory
chapters.subtitle: Secret behind the Prophet’s return from Hudaibia being called as clear victory by God: inna Fatahna laka fathan mubina: verily we have granted you manifest victory. (Fatah: 48: 1) as it is like the breaking the Musk gland to let free its fragrance and the benefits thereof

sections.heading: Htu
paras: Upon his return from Hudaibia the Prophet was anxious and worried. Suddenly from the lamp of the prophet the announcement of the wealth of inna fatahna came as stated in the Quran: inna fatahna laka fathan mubina: we have granted you manifest victory (Fatah: 48: 1). He received the message to return and not to be sorry for being prevented from victory. In this dishonour there are many victories to come to you: many forts and regions will be conquered by you.

See what happened to Bani Quraiza and Banu Nazir, two Jewish tribes. Their forts and other nearby areas were conquered with much spoils of war. If you cannot see this, see the other wonderful aspect. They are happy in trails and they take miseries and pains as lovable. They eat poison as though it is sugar. They feed upon the thorns of sorrow like the camels. The love sorrows for themselves on the hope that sorrows are followed by joys. They consider degradation as an elevated state. They are so happy in the depths of wells that they fear thrones and crowns as frightening. Every one of them in poverty is like hundreds of kings, and they are all like spring season in the autumn of hunger. Wherever they may be, upon the sky or under the earth, they consider themselves to be with their beloved God.

chapters.title: Closeness of Muhammad and Yunus
chapters.subtitle: Exegesis of the Hadith(s): Do not elevate me upon Yunus bin Matta: la tufaddiluni alaa Yunus bin matta

paras: The Prophet said: My ascension is not better than the ascension of Yunus. My place of ascension was on the high sky and that of Yunus in lowly earth. Nearness to God is neither going up nor going down. Nearness to God comes about by discarding of the worldly prison and self-annihilation (space wise) and not early or late (time wise). The workshop of the treasury of God is in self-annihilation. But when you are confused about life and existence, you cannot understand the meaning of annihilation.

The Prisoners continued: The sum and substance of their defeat at Hudaibia is not like our defeat. They are as happy in degradation and destruction as we are in victory and greatness. Total lack of means and subsistence is their wealth. Poverty and humbleness are their pride and greatness.

One of them said: “If he (Muhammad) were such an exceptional person, why did he laugh at us when we were bound and chained? And if you say that he is a changed person that his happiness was not concerned with our imprisonment or freedom, then why did he laugh at the enemies when they were defeated. Why has he become proud of this victory and success? Certainly, he is happy as he got an easy victory, control and upper hand upon brave lions. This makes us confirm that he is not free of worldly achievements; and he cannot be happy with other things than worldly gains. Otherwise, why did he laugh at us unlike other worldly persons who show goodness to both good and bad people.”
All this, they were talking in low tones, so that those guarding them may not fall on them or report it to their king.

chapters.title: No Secrecy with the Prophet
chapters.subtitle: The Prophet’s getting informed about their taunts upon his smiling at them

paras: Though the guards could not hear what the prisoners were talking about, but their words went into the ear of the Prophet, which was from God. The fragrance of the shirt of Yusuf was not felt by the person who was carrying it but was felt by Yaqub. Those devils upon the heights of the heavens do not hear about the writings of the Protected Tablet. But Muhammad lying down with his head on the pillow came to know what they were talking in secret. He eats the sweets who has a large supply of provisions, and not the one whose fingers are long. The star of piercing brightness became one to chase away the devils telling not to try to stealthily know the secret of God by looking at the Protected Tablet. But know the same from Muhammad. Thus, the one who spends the whole day from morning to evening to seek provisions from the shop should seek from God. Go to the mosque and seek from God.

chapters.title: Misconceived Victory
chapters.subtitle: Understanding by the Prophet of the words of the hearts of the prisoners

paras: The Prophet understood what all they said and said: “My laughing was not in connection with the battle. They are already dead and decomposed; and it is not a matter of manliness for us to kill the dead. Of whose account, are they? When I enter the battlefield, the moon splits. Even at the time when you were free and settled, I was seeing you tied in this manner.

“O those who are proud of the rulership and family! What you are proud of is like a camel standing on a ladder. Eversince the frame of my body fell down from the heights, whatever has to come in future is seen by me. I see the wine inside, when I look at a raw grape. When I look into the realm of non existence, I see those things that are to come into existence later. I look at the realm of the hidden world from those days when Adam and Eve had not even come into the process of creation. I have seen you in chains, reverted and degraded like the ants at the time, of ALAST (when God had questioned all the descendants of Adam yet to be born, whether He was not their Lord; and they had said: ‘Yes and we do testify’: as stated in the Quran (Al A’araf: 7: 172). What all I had known was nothing less than what all I had already known before the creation of the sky without pillars. (I know of everything well before the creation of the heaven). I have seen you reverted even from the time when I had not yet taken the shape of this frame of water and mud. I had not seen anything new that I should feel happy about. I had already seen this as decided in your fate: hidden and tied under domination and that too a domination like your eating poison wrapped up in sugar. If the enemy eats such poison as sweet, it is not a matter to feel jealous for anyone. You were drinking this poison with pleasure and your death had secretly blocked your ears. I do not go to battle for victory and world grabbing, as this world is a decomposing dead body and a very cheap one, and I cannot be greedy of it.

“I am not a dog which bites at the hair of the dead body’s tail. Like ‘Isaa (Jesus Christ) I have come to give back life to it. I have torne the ranks of the soldiers to save you from destruction. I am not cutting off the throats of the people for the purpose of grandeur, pride and domination, but I am cutting off the throats of a few to protect the throats of others. If you fell yourself foolishly and habitually in fire like moths, I drag you away with both hands from it enthusiastically. What you consider to be your victory is only like the sowing of the seeds of your disaster. You were calling each other with great stress to run your horses toward the pythons. You were committing cruelties upon others but that was a cruelty upon yourselves. You have been defeated by the lion of the time.

chapters.title: Selfless Love of God by Scholars
chapters.subtitle: To explain that the mischievous in his very domination is actually dominated, and a prisoner of his own victory

paras: A thief killed a rich man and was collecting his gold, when the police came to see the rich man. If the thief were to run away, the officer could not have punished him. But he did not run and was caught and killed. The dominance of the thief resulted in his own getting dominated. His dominance on the rich man became a net for him in which to be caught by the officer and avenged.

sections.heading: Temporary Victory of Infidels to Uproot Them
paras: O the one having dominance upon men, you are sunk in war and victory. God gives dominance to the infidels upon Muslims, so as to make them arrogant and get caught in the net. The arrogance of dominance becomes a cause of their defeat. Avoid to defeat them further and control yourself and do not shout at them as otherwise you will be humiliated. Their victory is only a trap for them to be caught in which they are dragged to face an attack upon themselves.

But victory does not give happiness to wisdom, as this victory itself is a cause of ruin. The far-sighting wisdom has very sharp eyes as God has applied His eyeblack in it. The Prophet has said that the people of paradise disagree with each other according to their wisdom and interpretations. This disagreement is because the high level of their wisdom. They look upon everything with suspicion: and not due to lack of wisdom, cowardice and weakness of faith. They had come to know of the secrets behind the wisdom of: lao la rijalun muminuna as stated in the Quran: Had there not been believing men and believing women whom you did not know that you were trampling down, and on whose account a crime would have accrued to you without your knowledge, (God would have allowed you to force your way, but he held back your hands) that He may admit to His Mercy whom He wills. If they had been apart, We should certainly have punished the unbelievers among them with a grievous punishment. (Fath: 48: 25). Therefore, they held back their hands.

sections.heading: To Protect Muslims Elsewhere
paras: Holding back of the hand from the accursed unbelievers was necessary to protect the Muslims who were living in Makka. Read the happenings of Hudaibia and “hold of your hand” (kaffa aidiyakum) in proper manner, as stated in the Quran: And it is He who has restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the city of Makka. After that He gave you the victory over them. And God sees well all that you do. (Fath: 48: 24).

sections.heading: Coersion to Do Good
paras: The Prophet used to consider himself to be under the trap of God even in victories. He believed in Maa ramaita iz ramaita walakinna allaha ramaa: when you threw (a handful of dust), it was not your act, but God’s. (Anfaal: 8: 17). And that victory was not at all his but of God. The entire truth is known only to God.

sections.heading: Voluntary and Compulsory Passing Toward God
paras: The Prophet continued: “I do not laugh at your chains having suddenly got you in an attack at night. I laugh for the reason that in these handcuffs and chains I am taking you to a garden of cypresses and flowers. What a strange matter it is that inspite of your being my enemies, I am taking you out of the fire toward green field under chains. I am dragging you with a heavy chain from the hell towards the paradise forever”.

In similar manner God drags every simple follower (muqallid) in good or bad manner toward himself. Everyone in the chain of trial and fear passes on this path excepting the Friends of God, who pass on with their own will and insight. These coercive methods are required for those who are not aware of the secrets of God. Therefore, put efforts and go on the path of mujahida (struggle) to brighten your sight so that passing on His path may be easy.

sections.heading: Simpletons and Scholars
paras: You take a child under force to school as he is unaware of the benefits of learning. When he comes to know of it, he feels pleased to go. The child goes to the school with reluctance as he does not see any return for his troubles. When a labourer puts a little money in his purse, he remains awake joyously in the night like a thief. Therefore, you may try hard to get the wages of your labour and then you will feel jealous of those obedients who have gained a lot (of money). The simple follower (muqallid) goes under compulsion in fear of punishment or hope of reward (Iitia karhan), but those who have understood and sincere go voluntarily (Iitia Tau‘an). That is to say: the muqallid is selfish, but the others do out of the love of God, and are selfless. The first one is like a child who loves his wet nurse for the sake of milk. But the other is like the one in love with a beautiful woman. The child is not aware of her beauty and he has no love for anything other than milk. The other one is in love with the wet nurse without any expectation. The muqallid is a friend of God out of fear and greed and he goes through the books to follow them. The other one is a lover of God out of a friendship which has nothing to do with gains and effects. In whatever manner or however he is, he is dragged by God. Whether he loves God for the sake of heaven or he loves sincerely without expecting anything, whether with the fear of separation or in the hope of companionship— either way this love is something created and given to them by God. The concern for God by both of them is due to God only. This is a compulsion of heart given by the beloved.

chapters.title: When Dying Is Pleasurable
chapters.subtitle: A beloved absorbs the lover without his knowledge, the lover no hopes, nor any feeling in his heart or apparent impacts, excepting hopelessness with fear and a permanence of desire

paras: Now we have come to the stage to consider: if Sadar Jahan had no hidden impacts of his Bukahri lover, why he would have felt impatience upon separation from him and run toward the prison. The truth of the matter is, even the beloved has inclination toward the lover; but it is unexposed; but the inclination of the lover is open and declared with two hundred drums and pipes. There is a story here to prove the point, but how long is the Bukhari to be kept in the difficulties of waiting. Therefore, we skip it, as he is in the search of his beloved whose face he wants to see before dying. And also, so that he may get relief from death, as sighting of a friend is like the water of life, which chases away death. A beloved whose seeing does not chase away death is not a beloved. He is a tree without leaves and fruits. O proclaimer of love, the real love is one in which death snatches you away. That is the test of true love.

Similarly, the proof of the reality of your faith is that which results in death and dying should appear good to you. if your faith is not of this level, it is not perfect. You will have to go in search of it. He only is your friend who gives up his life for your cause, without any hesitation and care. When it is with hesitation, it is no death at all. It is only death in appearance, rather it is just a transfer from one place to another. Death becomes worthy only when it is without hesitation. And if there is hesitation, it is simply keeping away but not death.

He only is a friend about whom God has said: you are mine and I am yours. Now you hear me: the lover reached the desired place. Love has taken him to the place where there is a twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre. Hablim min masad.

chapters.title: Love and Wisdom Do Not Go Together
chapters.subtitle: Appearance of the Bukhari lover before Sadar Jahan

paras: The moment he looked at the face of Sadar Jahan, he felt as though the bird of his life flew away from the body. He fell down like a dry log of wood and from the parting of hair to the finger nail every part was frigid. Those around sprinkled rose water on his face and spread over fragrant smoke to bring him to consciousness, but he did not move. No fragrant smoke from Bukahra did the job excepting the fragrance of that grand and bright king. When the king looked at his pale face, he got down from his horse and said: ‘A lover searches for the beloved with fasteness and enthusiasm and when the beloved arrives, he gets lost”.

sections.heading: Wisdom Vanishes When Love Comes
paras: You are a lover of God and when He comes to sight, not a hair of your body should remain intact. Before His sight hundreds like you have lost themselves. Perhaps you are also desirous of getting lost.

You are a shadow the lover of the sun like the darkness of night; and when the sun appears, its shadow, the night, passes away. When the tablet of the sun appears on the east, neither the night remains, not the stars. When love enters through the door of the heart, wisdom folds up all its belongings and throws them out. Just as when the lion has come before the deer, it falls down unconscious in all its humility as though love is like lion and deer like wisdom; or just as the strength of the mosquito vanishes when fast wind blows.

chapters.title: Harrasment of Mosquito by Wind
chapters.subtitle: Complaint of the mosquito against the wind before H. Sulaiman

paras: A mosquito came from the garden and grassland before H. Sulaiman and sought justice from him saying: “O Sulaiman, you do justice to the devils, humans and fairies.
