Birds and fish are under the protection of your justice. There is no misled fellow who has not received grace from you. Give justice to us as we are humble and weak and deprived of gardens and parks.

The troubles of ours can be kept away by you and we mosquitoes are well known for our weakness. We are well known for our weakness and broken wings; and you are well known for your benevolence and support for the poor. You are at the highest level of power and we are at the lowest level of weakness and misguidance. Do justice for us and keep away our sorrows. Your hand as a prophet is like the hand of God. Kindly help us”.

sections.heading: H. Sulaiman’s Great Power
paras: H. Sulaiman said: ‘O seeker of justice, tell me what kind of justice you want and what is your grievance. Who is that cruel fellow who with his pride has injured your face? It is so strange that even in our days there are those cruel fellows who are not within our chains and prisons. The day on which I was born, cruelties came to end, yet there is someone who appears to be left out. When light comes, darkness of its own vanishes which is the fundamental base and arm of cruelties. Many devils are engaged in our work, and the rest are held in our prisons. The cruelties of the cruel are rooted in the Satans. The great power of God, the Commander of the word “kun” (be) and the coming about of event “fayakun” has given authority to us on the world so that the people may not send their complaints high above the skies; so that the smoke arriving from the hearts of the oppressed may not reach the highest level of heavens and cause worry to the Pleiades. So that with the cries of the orphan, the seat of God may not tremble, and anybody may not fall sick. In view of this, we have made a law, so that the sound of ‘My Lord’ may not reach the heavens. O oppressed, do not look toward the sky as you have a heavenly king in the world who establishes the order as decided by God.”

The mosquito said: My complaint is against the wind, which has extended both the hands of cruelty on us. We are highly oppressed and are compelled to suck our own blood silently. Its cruelty is clearly visible, and we have no other means against it excepting speaking of it before you. Please show your justice and equity, O noble, generous judge.”

chapters.title: Existence Is Non-Existence
chapters.subtitle: H. Sulaiman’s order to mosquito to bring the accused to the court

paras: Then, H. Sulaiman said: “O you, the producer of pleasing tunes, you should hear the command of God with due attention. God has told me: “O judge, be careful; do not ever pass orders by hearing the version of one, without hearing the version of the other.” As long as both the parties do not appear before the court, the truth of the matter will not be known to the judge. Even if one party stresses a hundred times upon his case, be careful never to pass judgement without hearing the other party. I cannot disobey this command of God. Go and bring before your opponent before me.”
The mosquito replied: “Yes! What you say is right. The opponent in my case is the wind who is under your command.”

sections.heading: Mosquitoe’s Retreat upon Winds Arrival
paras: The king ordered: “O wind! The mosquito has complained against you for cruelty. Be warned! Come before your complainant, give your answers and defend yourself.” The moment wind heard this; it came fast: and immediately the mosquito resorted to leave off the place. Then, Sulaiman said: “O mosquito! Where are you going away? Stop! So that I may pass the judgement between you two.” The mosquito replied: “O king! The wind’s very existence is my death. This day of mine is black with its black smoke. How can I stay in a place where it has arrived because, as soon as it comes, it kills me?”

sections.heading: Man’s Search of God Ends in Annihilation
paras: In similar manner one who searches for the abode of God gets lost, when he reaches Him. Though your meeting with God is by your self-existence, both being separate, yet your existence co-exists with His. But initially you have to annihilate yourself in Him so as to exist for ever. Darkness that searches for light gets lost when light comes. How can wisdom exist independently when its Creator also exists? (Wisdom has to and gets merged in Him). That is the meaning of: kullu shaiin haalikun illa wajhuhu. (everything that exists) will perish except His own face: (Qasas: 28: 88).

One who gets annihilated in Him brings himself before Him, joins Him and remains intact for ever. This is a strange situation when non-existence comes about in existence. He does not exist because he is lost in Him but exists in Him. This is stage of understanding where wisdom loses its capacities and the pen of the writer breaks down.

chapters.title: Beloveds Also Love
chapters.subtitle: The beloved’s graces upon the lover to bring him to consciousness

paras: Now, I return to the affairs of Sadar Jahan, who was showing grace to his lover. He caught hold of his head and kept it in his lap and shed tears on his face, and constantly graced him, and brought him to senses to talk to him. He said to him in his ear: “O poor man. I have brought gold to spread and spill over your head. Open up your flannel to collect it. Your soul was in great pains because of separation from me; and when I have come to console you, why are you running away? You have seen so much of the good and bad things in my separation and are well experienced; you may yourself return to consciousness from unconsciousness”.

A domestic rooster in its foolishness invited a camel as its guest to its home. When the camel put its foot in its home it broke, and the roof came down. Our sense and wisdom are like the fowl’s home which get destroyed when the love of God comes about, as they are too small for such greatness. Consciousness is like Prophet Salih who desired for a she camel to support his cause. When it raised its head from out of mud and water, it became the cause of the destruction of everything of his community. Neither water, the cause of dispute, remained nor the soil upon which the community lived.

sections.heading: Man Took What Heavens, Earth and Mountains Refused
paras: The greatness of love deprived man of his sense and because of its increase, he became all the more ignorant and dark of mind; as stated in the Quran: we did indeed offer the trust to the heavens, and the earth, and the mountains; but they refused to undertake it, being afraid thereof, but man undertook it: — He was indeed unjust and foolish: innaa ardna al amanata ‘ala alsamawati, wa alardi, wa aljibaali, fa abaina an yahmilnahaa, wa ashfaqna minhaa, wa hamalahal insaanu: innahu kaana zaluman jahulan (Ahzaab: 33: 72). This trust can be considered as love of God.

sections.heading: Man’s Ignorance and Cruelty: Forerunner of Progress
paras: Man is ignorant; that, he tries to catch such a difficult prey as the rabbit trying to hold the lion in its armpit. How can he do so? Had it known the lion and seen it, it would not have thought of this. Man is unjust and cruel to himself and to his soul. Look at his ignorance that it has created principles of equity and justice. His ignorance has become a teacher to give knowledge and his cruelty has become a guide to justice; so much so, by falling in love with God, he destroys himself. Yet he considers that this cruelty to himself is much better than justice to himself.

Sadar Jahan held his hand saying: “His withheld breath will come back only when I grant him my breath. When that dead body gets life through my breath, it will be my soul only in his body and it will turn toward me. I shall make it more honourable as the life that I give will see my grants. His earlier soul was a stranger (na mahram) to me, and a stranger cannot see stranger’s face excepting of the one whose soul was once from its own source. I shall breathe unto him like the butcher who blows air into the slaughtered sheep’s body to separate the skin from the flesh. I shall blow air to separate him from his own soul”.

Sadar Jahan further said: “O soul that runs away from difficulties, come back! We have kept the door open for your meeting with us. Our existence is because of the loss of your existence and loss of consciousness. Your existence is always accounted for by our existence. Now I shall tell you certain ancient secrets in a fresh manner without the help of lips as the lips are physical things and what has to be said relates the hidden unspeakable secrets. These lips avoid saying them and the hidden secrets grow from the banks of streams. Therefore, open up your non-hearing ears to know the secrets of yaf‘alu allah maa yashaa: God does what He wills. (Ibrahim: 14: 27).

sections.heading: Love Revives Life
paras: When the dead body of the lover heard about the announcement of invitation toward meeting, it started shaking slowly. He was not less than the mud which responds to coquettish styles of the spring winds, puts on green apparels of grass by raising its head and coming into existence from the world of non-existence. He was not lesser than the air which upon the command of kun (be) entered into the womb of the peahen and other-sweet-chirping-birds. Not less than the fire which upon hearing the command of ‘secure’ salam became a garden for the sake of Ibrahim. Not lesser than the piece of wood which to crush the enemy became a python upon the command of God. Not lesser the rocks of the hills which gave birth to a she Camel like a normal delivery. Now forget all this and think: Has not the non-material from the world of nonexistence given birth to this universe and is creating even now moment by moment?

Hearing this the unconscious man got up and jumped with great joy, danced for a while and fell down in prostration. He looked at this, and his face brightened. In the situation of companionship, he became free, from the bonds of separation.

chapters.title: Great Impacts of Love
chapters.subtitle: Coming of the unconscious lover to senses and attending in thanks and praises of the beloved

paras: And he said to Sadar Jahan: “Thank God, that you have come back from the mountains of Qaf (Cacaucus) like that large bird (Anqaa) which circumambulates the soul. You are like the Israfil calling the world of love for the day of resurrection. You are the love of love and the beloved of love. (That is to say: love has to learn the lessons of love from you; and love itself falls in love with you). The first grant that you would give to me should be, that you should keep your ear upon my mouth to hear me in utmost privacy. Though with the cleanliness of your heart, you know what I would say: yet you, the protector of the slaves, may allow me also to say. O unique person, in the desire of your listening ears, I have lost my senses.

“You have been a listener to me; your attention toward my words was within life-promoting smiles. You were also listening to my mischievous words. My counterfeit coins were received by you as genuine. Your treatment for this incompetent, mischievous fellow with so much grace is very great. You may now hear me that, when I freed myself from your loop, my beginning and end were lost for ever. Secondly, I searched very much for another one like you, but I could not get the second. Thirdly, when I went away from you, I have become a believer of the Christian Trinity. Fourthly, when the farmland of my actions was set on fire, I am unable to distinguish between four and five. Fifthly, I have lost my five senses ever since I separated from you. sixthly, because of my eyes not being able to see your face, I have been put into sorrows from all the six directions. Seventhly, I am incapable of differentiating between seven and eight and I have been crying so much that even the sky is shedding tears of blood. Wherever you see blood, you can conclude that it is from the eyes of myself and the sky.

My words and the sound of my cries have become lightning’s forcing the clouds to shed rain upon earth. I am in confusion as to whether I should cry or talk or do what else. If I talk, I have to stop crying and if I cry I shall not be able to express thanks and praises to you. My king, you may see, what great injury is caused to my eyes that the tears are falling like the blood of heart.”

So, saying, he started crying so much that every good and bad man also cried. Such loud sighs came from his heart that the people of Bukhara formed a circle around him. He was talking and laughing while crying that all people, young and old, men and women were taken by surprise. The entire city started crying and shedding tears like him, and men and women were unaware of themselves as it happens on the doomsday. Sky was telling the earth to look at this doomsday if it has not seen it. Wisdom was baffled at the strangeness of love and the effect it causes, and it was not possible to decide whether this reaction of the lover was an impact of companionship with or separation from the beloved. The sky read out the message of doomsday and the galaxy in the form of its own religious and cults tore off its dress. Love has no concern for both the worlds; madness is much better than this.

sections.heading: Strange Madness of Love
paras: Love is a very hidden thing, but its wonderful impacts are quite clear. Its madness is entirely different. It has seventy-two kind. It is a great secret, but its exposition is clear. Prophets who are the emperors of the soul, crave for it. The thrones of the kings are just a collection of wood in its view. The singer of love plays its rhythms with it. For it, slavery, prison, and mastership are all a headache. What is love then?

It is an ocean of annihilation. The feet of the wisdom break here. Slavery and kingship go behind the curtain when love comes forward. It would have been good if love itself had a tongue to speak about the lovers. Whatever is spoken by the existences of life puts another curtain on it. It does not reveal but hides it all the more. Just as it is impossible to clean blood with blood so also intelligence fails to understand love either by way of words or by gestures.

sections.heading: Impossible to Explain
paras: As I (Rumi) say that I am aware of the secrets of the madmen of love, I am trying to explain this. But my explanation is like blowing wind in a cage, day in and day out, which never get collected. It comes from outside and goes out from the other. O my life, you are very much intoxicated and unconscious and out of control. Tell me on which side you had slept on the last night, because what all you are telling are incoherent words. Yet, I warn you! take care! Before talking of it and find out the one who is capable of hearing it, because you will not get anyone for this purpose. You may talk but non can comprehend. You are a maddened lover simply blabbering which serves no purpose. What you say is so strange as a camel putting its steps on a ladder.

What I start revealing the secrets and fancies of love, sky cries out and tells: You are a beautiful wrapper of secrets. By trying to speak out you are putting more coverings of your words. But this covering up is like fire covered up by cotton and wool which results in greater revealing through burning. And when I try to hide the secrets of love, love all the more rises up like a flag and catches my ears to hide me. Come on hide me. Let me see how you can?
I tell it: “You are excited. Go away from me. You are hidden as well as apparent like soul. You may try to hide yourself in full”.

It says: “May be! My body, that is apparent, is imprisoned like wine in the vessel, but my soul makes its clapping sound in the gathering of people to release itself from the vessel. This is like the soul which is hidden in the body but expresses itself by various means.”

I say to it: Go away and hide yourself and put an end to all your expressions, as otherwise you will get pledged to me upon which, my intoxication will put me into difficulties; and my difficulties will be as well yours.

sections.heading: Love Wine and Cupbearer
paras: It says: I shall be with a very fine cup with you for the whole day but only till the evening prayer, upon the arrival of which, my evening will steal away my cup. I shall tell the evening to return it as my evening has not yet arrived. Do you not know that the Arabs call the wine as mudaam (everlasting need) as the need of wine never comes to end for the drinker? He is never satisfied and wants more and more. When one is not satisfied with this love for tangible wine, how can one be satisfied of the intangible wine of truth. [Love only takes one to truth. It is a cupbearer for the love of God. I, you sincerely search for God, which in possible with God’s support only. Love will become a cupbearer for you to provide the water of life (aab-e-hayat) and your body will become like a cup for love]”

When love increases the impacts of wine toward inclination for gods love, the force of wine shatters the cup of the body, as a result of which, it gets rid of the contents of the body; and love, lover and the beloved all get unified and become one, upon which you will say: God knows the entire truth.

All the qualities of the wine are a reflection of the cupbearer, which penetrate into the juice of grapes, as a result of which the juice gets excited and dances through those who consume it. You may ask that senseless, drinker whether he had seen the wine behaving like that. Everyone knows them through his clear, inherent sense that for one who moves there is someone who makes him move.

chapters.title: Difficulties in the Matters of Love
chapters.subtitle: Story of a lover who faced prolonged separation and trials

paras: A young man fell in love with a woman and got deprived of sleep for days and nights and of eating. He was unhappy, worried, maddened and tired but the occasion of meeting with her never came. Love had grappled him to the ground and it is strange that love gets inimical to the lover from the beginning itself. Love becomes murderous from the beginning itself so that one who is not firm in it may run away from it.

sections.heading: Total Loss of Peace of Mind
paras: When he would send a messenger to her, he would become envious and turn into a rival. When he sent a letter to her, her clerk would read it wrong. When he used the wind to pass his message, it would go black in its dust. When he sent the message by tying it to the pigeon’s feet, its feathers burned. All ways of approaching her were closed and the army of his plans got defeated. Earlier the fondness of his meeting with her was as a friend and sympathiser, but even that was upset later.

Sometimes he would say that this is an incurable disease and sometimes, that it is not a disease but the very soul of my being. Sometimes, his ego would rise up and advise him to ignore her; and sometimes he would taste the fruit of annihilation for her sake as very sweet. Sometimes, his sighs would go up to the heavens; and sometimes, thinking about her alone was his companion. When these feelings subsided, the hot spring of oneness with her would rush forth. When he developed consonance with all hopelessness like a journeyman without any belongings, this non-possession of any thing would come close to him. Thus, when he got rid of all thoughts, feelings and selfness like a scrap of grass without seeds he became a model of true love and guide for other lovers just as the moon is a guide to journeyman.

sections.heading: Outward Similarity, Inward Difference
paras: Many a times it can be seen that many persons who can mimic sounds like a parrot become silent and many happy persons mourn. Some are talkative but are mourning at heart. You may go to the graveyard for some time and sit there in silence and look at those good speakers who are silenced. You can see their gravies similar to each other. Similarly, among the living all the same in their flesh and fat, but one is full of sorrows and another of joys. You cannot understand them unless you hear them talking, as their inner feelings are hidden from you. Even in hearing them, you hear their words, but there are hundreds of layers under which different things exist. Our bodily frames are the same, but the character is different. So also, is the case of mud, but its qualities are different. So also, are the sounds. One is full of grief and another of many styles and ostentations. You hear the sounds of the horses in the battlefield, and while loitering here and there, you hear the birds. The sounds of the horses are different because of enmity and of the birds with affinity. one is with grief and the other with pleasure. One who is not aware of their different situations thinks that all the sounds are the same.

sections.heading: Similarity Causes Confussion
paras: Look at the trees. One tree shakes because of the hits that it receives from the axe and another with the morning breeze. Many a times I was misled to know the contents of a vessel with a lid on its mouth, with boiling contents on a stove, not knowing what was cooking in. Someone calls you with enthusiasm and pleasure, but many a times this invitation is not genuine, but with artificiality and high polishing. It is difficult to differentiate. If you do not have the eyes to see the genuineness, you should learn it from one who has the wisdom to differentiate between various fragrances: That is: such people of wisdom who are connected with the gardens to smell, and the eyes bright enough to brighten the eyes of Yaqoobs. Now, enough of this, we have gone away from the affairs of that man from Bukhara and Sadar Jahan.

chapters.title: Sure and Rare Results
chapters.subtitle: Holding of the beloved by the lover and of the fact that whoever searches, attains the object as stated by noble Prophet Muhammad. And of the statement of the Quran: anyone who has done an atom’s weight of good, sees it! And anyone who has done an atom’s weight of evil shall see it! Faman ya‘mal misqaala zarratin khairain yarahu. Wa man ya‘mal misqaala zarratin sharran yarahu (Zilzal: 99: 7, 8)

paras: That man was held up in search for seven years in the thoughts of meeting became lean and weak and ethereal like bodyless thought. Shadow of God falls on the creatures; and one who searches definitely meets one’s object. The noble Prophet has said: If you tap a door, at last someone will come out of the house. If you sit in the street of someone, certainly you will see someone there. If you remove mud from a well, you will reach the source of clean water. Everyone agrees whether you agree with or not: what you sow will be reaped by you someday.

sections.heading: Usual and Rare Events
paras: If you strike to rock with iron, sparks will come. This is certain to happen and not happening of it is very rare. One in whose fate there is no fortune and relief, looks at only rare events that so and so carried agriculture but could not get any fruit. So and so carried an oyster, but there was pearl in it. Worship and obedience were of no gain to the accursed Iblis and Bal’am bevoor. Thousands of prophets and guides do not come to the mind of that unfortunate fellow. He considers only these two who create darkness and ignorance. What else can his misfortune give to him. There are many persons who eat bread with pleasure, but it gets choked in someone’s throat and becomes a cause of death. If you consider these unfortunate cases, then, you accursed fellow, you should not eat bread so as not to become like those dead. Yet there are hundreds of thousands of people who eat bread and get strength and keep themselves alive. Therefore, why do you penetrate yourself into rare matters? You do this, because you are a child of deprivation and foolishness.

sections.heading: Pessimist Thinks of Losses
paras: This world is full of the light of the sun and moon, but instead of enjoying this, you have hanged your head deep into the well and ask it: there is light everywhere, why there is no light in the depths of the well. You should not be mean to blame others. Bring your head out of the well, you will see the light. The entire world has seen the light in the east and west; and so long you are in the well, it will not shine upon you. Leave this well and enter into gardens and palaces. Do not make mean arguments in this matter, as such arguments are the favourites of the unfortunate. Do not say: “So and so carried on farming in so and so year and the locust destroyed it. Therefore, why should I take up such a risky job. Why should I spread the seeds of wheat?”

Be warned! Do not argue! Go out and do the work with hope on God. One makes silly arguments falls with head down and never gets up till the doomsday. One who went to his farm and carried on the work will collect granaries full of grain and you will not even be looking at it. Now stop this discussion and go toward that young man.

When that young man tapped the door of that lady one day, without expecting any good result, he got the opportunity to meet her in seclusion. Out of the fear of the police officer, he hid himself in the garden and found out his beloved with a lamp. He thanked God, the causer of all causes saying: “O God, show benevolence to the police officer because of whose fear I entered the garden and achieved my object. You have made an unknown thing as a cause for me and took me from the gate of the hell to heaven. You have made him as a cause for my job so that I may not consider even a thorn as worthless.”

If God breaks your leg, he provides you with feathers and opens a gate for escape from the depth of the well. Whatever thing you see as unpalatable becomes a great benevolence if you look at its truth. God has said in the Quran: But it is possible that you, dislike a thing which is good for you, and you love a thing which is bad for you: Asa an tukrihu shaian wa huwa khairun lakum; wa asa an tuhibbu shaian, wa huwa sharrun lakum (Baqara: 2: 216).
Do not see whether you are on a tree or in a well. You look at Me and I am the key for all paths. If you want to know the rest of these affairs look for them in the fourth volume.
